They therefore specially sent me to offer an apology and brought several Brothers to help guard the Tang Clan. If the Wulin Alliance intends to act against the Tang Clan, they can also speak a few fair words to dissuade them.

The Abbot has been cultivating Buddhist teachings in seclusion; his mind is entirely clear, and he is not versed in worldly scheming. When he, the elderly person, asked you to stay, he hadn't thought about the consequences at all. He simply believed that if everyone sat down, had a cup of tea and spoke openly, there would be no problem‑he had no malice whatsoever.
But your Songshan Sect wasn't on our side either back then.
Naturally, we are here to help
I wonder how Brother Li, the Sect Master, suddenly paid us a visit.
Leader Li, at such a young age, commands the Number One Gang under heaven‑truly a hero emerges in youth. I wonder what important matter brings you to visit the Tang Clan today?
Hello, Sect Leader Tang
Hello, Dharma Master Fu Yun

Before any pleasantries, this humble monk must say solemnly: Dharma Master Shi Ming's words and actions have nothing to do with Songshan. I ask everyone to look into this carefully and not to blame a good person.
Good Fortune──
I'll go meet the visitors
The Gang Leader is coming in person; we must not be negligent. Please notify the Acting Sect Leader‑I'll go up the mountain to welcome the Gang Leader.
Ask Third Senior Brother later to arrange a different post for you; your position is too risky.
I'd be so scared I'd die; I couldn't possibly go up the mountain to report it.

I thought there'd be a crowd, that they'd be here to pick a fight. There are hardly any people ‑ what are you so worked up about? They're being polite to you and you're already this nervous. What will you do if you run into someone who's rude?
The people who came... are so... so... so few! And they're also very polite!
Why would the Beggar Sect's Sect Master suddenly pay a visit to the Tang Clan?
The leader of the Beggar Sect is here!
Fu Yun the monk also withdrew his request. How could the Beggar Sect Master suddenly visit the Tang Clan?
The Beggar Sect Master and Master Fu Yun have arrived!
I just took off my shoes and socks. Who's come‑why so nervous?
No, this is bad! Someone's here! Where's Brother Zhao? Wake up, don't sleep!
I shouldn't do anything else today. I need to calm down and think things through on my own.

If we don't act this way, who would respect beggars like us? We have to be fiercer and meaner than others; only then will people fear us and take us seriously. All those high‑minded principles are for the rich to worry about ‑ they don't concern me. I only care about loyalty.
Buddy, your killing intent is really strong
If Master heard me speaking so rudely, she would surely tug my ear and scold me harshly. Where on earth has she gone? Why won't she come and scold me...? I'm so lonely.
If Master heard her speaking so rudely, she'd inevitably be scolded again.
Got it
Don't drag your junior sister into this. Do you understand?
Now the junior sister is in for a rough time.
You, girl, come here. As your master, I'll teach you how to behave.
Shishi! Master!
How did I, as your teacher, teach you to speak?
Relax ‑ I'm on your side. Aside from those in green robes, the rest, damn it, will all be beaten without fail.
Oh... that really is simple and straightforward.
Woof woof woof woof woof!

There are plenty of people in this world with too much time on their hands‑strangers who, seeing you're easy to bully, want to kick you a couple of times. No need to argue; just bite them! Bite off a chunk of flesh and they won't dare to bark anymore!
Of course we must fight, Senior Brother
Of course I'll fight, Senior Brother
That is all I have to say; I will not say anything further to disturb you.
You can't refuse to take me far away, refuse to go along with the crowd, and still insist on staying here in the Tang family compound to wait for death, can you?
This is way too crazy

You and Liu E inexplicably get along, don't you? Why not‑while the Mud Cult still has some strength‑let me try to pull some strings; how about the Tang Clan actually forming an alliance with the Mud Cult?
Go on, tell me
I have a particularly crazy idea
The enemy of my enemy is my friend.
I... I was threatened...!

If, on the other hand, you don't use your brain and stubbornly go off and get yourself killed, then consider yourself out of luck. I'll go find an ideal suitor at least ten times more handsome than you and drive you so mad you'll jump out of your coffin.
As long as you don't waver and don't treat your life lightly, we'll have many good days ahead.
I wouldn't dare
You've already shown sincerity and offered enough enticements; anything more would just seem cheap. Don't treat me like a casual female.
......Miss Ying.
I know you won't leave the Tang Clan‑it's out of loyalty, and that's undoubtedly the right thing to do. But I still hope you'll give me a little more of your personal attention. I'm sorry.

When a Merchant offers more than the going rate, it's usually for two reasons: either they want to cultivate a friendly relationship with you, or they have an improper favor to ask. As for my ingratiating myself with you like this, it's both.
Enough, that's enough
I, Shangguan Qianjin‑the proud only daughter of the Shangguan family‑am now throwing myself into your arms and making advances; is that enough to prove my sincerity?
Yes. Is that so? I think so too.

Nangong Shen and I had been betrothed since childhood, yet both of us were very strict about propriety. I was proud and haughty and would never act so shamelessly; when they tried to hold my finger, I wouldn't let them.
I can't just let it stop, can I?
Your heartbeat is way too loud ‑ you're asking to be smacked.
Sorry
Your expression is so disgusting ‑ you're asking for a beating.

I‑I'm warning you, okay: I'm not good at flattering people or acting cutesy. I've already swallowed my pride and I'm doing my absolute best. If you so much as say one word of disdain about me, I will never show you any courtesy for the rest of my life!
Ying, Miss Ying... why are you suddenly so close?
Zhao Lang, I've followed you, and I've always had your best interests at heart. If there were any other way out, I certainly wouldn't be urging you to give up your ambitions like this.
Concise and to the point, very persuasive
I once believed Shangguan and Nangong were my family, but I ended up at the Tang Clan. If I were stubborn and rigid, clinging only to dogma, would I have come with you?
This is our home!

If Central Plains won't have us, why not just give up Tangjia Dayuan? The proverb as long as the green hills remain, there will always be firewood is so obvious‑I don't believe anyone doesn't understand it.
Withdraw into seclusion
You're loyal to the Tang Clan, and Ying'er admires that. But I gave up wealth and glory ‑ I'm not here just to accompany you to your death. You must promise me you'll carefully consider your future.

People who lack long‑term foresight will soon have immediate worries. I'm not discussing besieging the Mud Cult with you; I'm talking about the fact that sooner or later the Wulin Alliance will regard us as a thorn in their side.
......I believe.
Once the Mud Cult is eliminated, the next target will be the Tang Clan ‑ do you believe that?

The Tang Clan has brazenly defied the Imperial Court more than once; their record is riddled with misdeeds. It's only because imperial forces are tied up far away in Western Shu and external threats still remain that dispatching troops to suppress them is difficult. Now, with the Wulin Alliance serving as the enforcer, it will only be a matter of time before a deadly blow is struck against the Tang Clan.
I knew it... you really are stubborn.
Miss Ying, the Sect Leader has already answered this question for you.

Zhao Huo, although I was about eighty percent sure of your answer, I'll ask anyway‑could the Tang Clan possibly pledge allegiance to the Imperial Court? If you and Third Brother give the nod, I can immediately mobilize my connections...
Yes, yes, very much so. Except for your face, you're handsome all over!
The rest of me is more handsome than my face, so don't hit me.
Hahaha, when they begged for mercy they even pleaded, please don't humiliate me, yet you instead told people to humiliate them.
Pfft
Please, for the sake of this flower, don't strike anywhere except the face.
I've returned, and I've brought back this little flower whose color suits you.
One......Two~
No... I didn't do anything wrong, don't hit me!
I don't want to. You must want to hit me.
What the hell are you looking at? What the hell are you laughing at!
How can you be so soft‑hearted? If we have children in the future, you can't be the one to raise them‑an indulgent father often spoils his child.
What if I still can't bring myself to hit you?
It's truly terrifying...
But if what you say is unreasonable, I'll fight back.
Self‑indulgence is the real cruelty. Those close to the situation are often the most confused. If I've offended you in any way, please be sure to admonish me.
Are you serious...? Are you that strict with yourself, too?
Yes... When we get married, I'll give you a family‑discipline rod. You can use it to punish me then.
Owe what? Are you really planning on paying it back?
I... this is a bad habit of mine; it's hard to change all at once. I'll be more careful next time‑I'll owe you one for now.
Look, look ‑ you're making a criminal declaration again.
It's not like all I can do is hit people. You're asking for a beating.
Why do I get the feeling you're about to hit someone? Since I've been so obedient, if I do something wrong, please show mercy and hit me a little more lightly.
Oh (as you command)
...Zhao Huo, come here. I want to speak to you earnestly.
Oh, so you were here ‑ I was looking for you everywhere.
I always feel a little lonely. What can I do? Where will I be needed?
...Jinxiang Palace doesn't need me to risk my life to protect it; the Tang Clan doesn't either. If all I have to do is live my own life well, that's enough... isn't it?
That's good. Nothing else‑I'll head back for now; enjoy it. And be sure to keep a close eye on your wallet.
I'm this polite‑how could I possibly leave without saying goodbye?
If you're leaving, don't forget to come and say goodbye to me, or I'll look for you everywhere.
No way!
You'll get fat, you know
I understand what you mean, but I need to think it over... I'll think about it while I eat.
......Alright.
People will inevitably die; since it's unavoidable, they might as well live as they please while they're alive.
Afraid of dying as I am, I'm even more afraid of a lifetime of regret. To make sure things don't turn out that way, I'll give it my all.
You're so cowardly, and yet you still brag.
Oh, please ‑ who do you take me for? I'm not crazy; of course I'd be afraid.
Aren't you at all afraid of dying?
Of course I'll stay
What about you?
If my Brother Sect Leader decides to hold the Tang Clan and fight the Wulin Alliance to the death, Sister Xiang should go down the mountain alone.
Sorry ‑ I promised Lady Wen I'd take in Jinxiang, a palace attendant. As a result, we can't even keep ourselves safe.
You are your whole self ‑ just be responsible for yourself.
I know, I know... you don't have to say that.

You're not a Tang Clan Disciple; at most you're just a passerby. I'm a member of the Tang Clan, so I won't leave. You're not one of us‑what obligation do you have to live and die with the Tang Clan? No one asked you to do this.
But you're different ‑ you still have a wonderful life ahead; you don't have to wade into this mess.

The rise and fall of the Tang Clan is the inescapable responsibility of every Tang Clan Disciple. Do everything you can and then leave the rest to fate; if the Tang Clan is truly destined to perish, that too is ordained by fate.
Sister Xiang, listen to me
Anyway, that's it. Don't ask me. Does what I think matter? It's up to you to decide.

My master used to force me to study with a rattan cane, and I forget things as soon as I read them. If I can occasionally manage to come up with a few idioms, that's something‑don't put me on the spot.
This is a poem by Li Bai. Haven't you read it?
No, this is Li Bai's Xing Lu Nan.
You really seem to be able to do anything‑unlike me. Sigh.
No, it's not. You little liar.
That's right ‑ it's a poem I wrote.
That's right, this is a poem I wrote.
Is this a poem you wrote?

That's exactly it... This whole table of delicious dishes smells so good, yet I can't taste a thing. Not only have I failed to appreciate the chef's hard work, I'm ashamed before these Chickens that I swallowed whole.

The golden cup holds clear wine worth ten thousand coins, the jade plate bears delicacies priced at ten thousand coins. I stop drinking, put down my chopsticks, unable to eat; I draw my sword, look around, my heart in confusion.
A leaky roof suffers more when it rains overnight. At Fengyu Mountain, Sister Xiang's inner demon grew even stronger.
Like this...?

I've already... had enough of swinging my sword, and I don't want to see people I know die anymore. I want to retire into seclusion, but I don't know what I can do after sealing my sword; my life feels completely aimless.
Even now, they still dream of Uncle Wang, of Fengyu Mountain, and always want to avoid it.
Even now, I often dream of Uncle Wang ‑ I dream of the day your Senior Brother died, I dream of Fengyu Mountain, and I keep wanting to run away.
You used to always drag me into sparring matches.

This kind of Jianghu is disheartening, isn't it? I'm both furious and bewildered ‑ I want to seek justice, but the hand that holds my sword betrays me and trembles. I'm going to make my Father lose face.

Those with a large following speak with decisive authority; the isolated can only meekly comply. Those with superior martial prowess can ignore reason; people who flock to them, hoping for gain, risk their lives and obsequiously flatter them.
Yeah... to be honest, seeing them like that made me very afraid. The chivalry I longed for seems to have been nothing but wishful thinking, merely a fantasy.
This is difficult. Among them some are sensible, some would rather see the world in chaos, but most simply echo others and are led by the nose.
......I wish the Wulin could be a little more clear‑headed and not so frenzied.
Never mind what the Tang Clan wants‑what do you yourself hope for?
What happened?
If the Tang Clan wants to confront the Wulin Alliance head‑on, I will, of course, stand and fall with you.

Really

It's good that you want to work to earn money. Now please explain‑what's going on with this table of dishes?

Oh my God, Sister Xiang has suddenly attained enlightenment!
Verbal Attack

I'm that bad at performing‑what listener would be willing to be impressed?

Are you trying to make me play the xiao and sing for money at an inn?
If you don't take up the sword, don't you still play music?
Just let me be like this for now, okay?
...Yeah, I know, it's just... it's just... sigh.
Then just pick up a sword; pick it up and you'll be able to do anything.
You're way too kind ‑ not even my master has ever indulged me like this.

Isn't this kind of thing perfectly normal? If you want to do a good job, you must first sharpen your tools; even the most skilled cook can't make a meal without rice. Even an imperial palace chef, if not given pots or a spatula, can't come up with any fancy dishes.
Comfort
No. To my shame, I‑I realized that I seem to be what people commonly call a useless person. If I'm not using a sword, I really can't do anything; I'm completely good‑for‑nothing.
Any results?

I've been looking for you for ages‑how come you're at the inn?
......As long as the Young Lady does not intervene, this plan will surely succeed.
What a brilliant plan! My wife is simply amazing! I'll go tell Third Senior Brother!
What a brilliant plan! For Wei the Talented Woman to still say the strategy won't work is far too modest! I'll go tell Third Senior Brother.
Zhao Lang really wasn't someone who answered at my bidding. Every step he mentioned was not far from what Senior Brother Danxiazi and I had worked out.

However, the above assumes a situation in which the five major sects other than Kongtong are all hostile to the Tang Clan. In reality, the Songshan sect may not be able to excuse themselves, and the other sects are not in a cannot live under the same sky relationship with us.
Good ‑ of course we should go with the flow and draw the fire toward Qingcheng to smoke Shentu Long out. Once the fire reaches his eyebrows, let's see if he can still keep up the act.
Those who truly must be crushed in one fell swoop are the Shangguan clan, Qingcheng, and Emei.

Quanzhen and Songshan are made up of Daoist priests and Buddhist monks; apart from Shi Ming, the treacherous bald monk, they all believe in karma. Diancang's base is in Dali; unlike Quanzhen or Songshan, they don't have local adherents to come to their aid, so in a protracted campaign they'll inevitably be depleted. The Tang Clan may appear to be beset on both sides, but in fact it sits where the three sects‑Qingcheng, Emei, and Diancang‑meet the Central Plains official road. It can sever the three sects' ties with the Wulin Alliance, and even if besieged, rely on the terrain to hold out in the mountains.
There are the Kongtong school and the Tang Clan; if Jinxiang Palace can be persuaded to join them‑and with the Mud Cult looming on the sidelines‑it could form a tripartite balance of power.

The essence of being a hero lies in acting beyond the law, thus causing chaos. The Tang Clan seeks to rise up in rebellion, rallying these people to form the Western Wulin Alliance to counter the Wulin Alliance.

If the nation faces peril and both court and people are united without reservation, I too support Wulin heroes loyally serving the country. But if petty, short‑sighted villains use others' hands to eliminate dissenters and succeed, they will achieve the effect of kill the chicken to warn the monkey: the Jianghu will fall silent and dare not disobey, and chivalry will cease to exist.
They're completely different. The inferior option is mere bravado; the superior one requires that the righteous cause be on our side.
How is this different from the worst option?
‑declare open war on the Wulin Alliance
In that case, please hear the best plan I, your humble handmaiden, have devised.

This method may be clever... but it's not the Tang Clan's style. The worry is that even if it can be hidden for a while, people's resolve will evaporate; once time passes and circumstances change, no one will care what the truth actually was.
Given time to gather the evidence and lay it open before everyone, we will expose the petty scoundrels' lies and let them reap what they've sown.

Zhongce sought to divide and conquer by dispersing the Tang Clan throughout Jianghu, making it difficult for the Wulin Alliance to eliminate them all at once. This is bad. I reckon the Tang Clan disciple's thinking, nine times out of ten, will be limited to resorting to an inferior course of action.

The inferior strategy is to disregard the edict; let him do as he pleases, and I will follow my own path. If pressed too hard, we perish together. We pay no heed to the Wulin Alliance's edict; when they encircle us, we fight back to make them regret their actions.

Leave it to me

By sowing a good cause today and keeping your heart and intention right in the days ahead, you will surely reap good fruit. This old monk wishes to present this book to you, Benefactor.
Thank you, Master Uncle, for your enlightenment
Xu Puti, the past mind cannot be grasped, the present mind cannot be grasped, the future mind cannot be grasped.
Not yet
Then, Benefactor Zhao can also be counted as one of my Songshan disciples.
Yes

Amituofo, well said. In that case, we have our agreement: as long as the Jianghu is peaceful, the country prospers and the people live in safety, and the winds and rains are timely ‑ in short, while the world does not need Young Hero Zhao to sacrifice themself ‑ you shall come to Songshan to study.
Being allowed to study at Songshan would be this junior's honor ‑ how could I possibly refuse?
If it's just studying abroad, I'm naturally more than willing.
Respectfully seeing off the two Dharma Masters
Benefactor Zhao, farewell for now. See you again in Yueyang.
Everyone has their own fate. Since that's the case, this old monk will not force it. Now, this old monk and my master's grandnephew will take our leave of the Young Hero.
Allow me to refuse; I don't want to become a monk.
Perhaps. I'm only asking what your intention is?
Could there really be such a day?

I wouldn't presume to press you; I'm only asking. Someday in the future, if the Jianghu is at peace, the country prosperous and the people safe, and the weather favorable, Young Hero, would you be willing to come to my Songshan to study?
Master, please speak. So long as it is within my ability, I am willing to carry out your orders.
This may be sudden, Young Hero, but this old monk has an impertinent request.
Master, you flatter me. I only seek to live well in the present.
Excellent, excellent. Young Hero Zhao also possesses an exceptional root of wisdom; blessed to perceive the true principle, they are destined to attain the path of the sage.
Is there anyone in the world who isn't a mere mortal?

Young Hero Mo Qian, this junior disciple of mine is quite gifted ‑ an outstanding talent among Songshan's younger generation. They've mentioned Young Hero Zhao more than once, which shows you are no ordinary person.
How could I ever be compared to my senior brothers?

In former times I heard that the Flying Hero, the Ruthless Young Lord, and the Scholar Hero were all heroic figures. Then a Tang Clan Ugly Hero suddenly burst onto the scene, and the Tang Clan produced talent after talent‑Old Master Tang could take comfort in his old age.

Banruo Yuan, Damo Yuan, and Luohan Tang are all places within the Songshan School devoted to researching and teaching martial arts. Banruo Yuan broadly embraces martial arts from across the realm and maintains close ties with Zhike Yuan.
Young Hero, there's no need to be polite.
I, this humble disciple of the Wulin, pay my respects to Master Juexing.

Master Zhao, I have met up with my fellow monks. This will no longer trouble your sect. Before we depart, I would like to introduce you to this person; he is my master uncle and one of our sect's elders, Zen Master Awakening from Songshan Temple.
They're not the same person... That's it ‑ this one is the real one. The Wunian Monk only disguised themself as this elder monk.
The hairs on your skin stood on end, yet you saw the old monk with his hands clasped, compassionate eyes lowered, and not an ounce of hostility about him.
Monk Wu Nian...!

The Songshan monks and the Tang Clan had many karmic ties and felt considerable goodwill toward one another. They traveled together for a while, the monks also collecting alms; so as not to delay the Tang Clan's itinerary, the monks pressed their palms together in farewell.
We've encountered Songshan's forces!

When bystanders began to comment, you twisted the truth, escalated the matter into a dispute between two countries, and kept insisting it was meant to teach Quanzhen a lesson for siding with the Jin. The crowd immediately thought you weren't so hateful.
You picked a fight for no reason, defeated the elder Daoist who was leading the team, flaunted your martial prowess to show off, satisfied your vanity, and then left.
You choose to eat in silence and pay it no mind. After hastily finishing your meal and saying farewell to your fellow disciples, you set off early to avoid the Quanzhen Sect.
Live and let live
Driven by insecurity and intent on provocation and asserting dominance, you make a scene‑overturning the table‑and challenge the leader of Quanzhen.
How dare they look down on the Tang Clan! They're asking for a beating!

They took an avid interest in Jianghu affairs and never tired of them, yet failed to recognize the Tang Clan figure in the blue robe. Proud of being the leaders of the Six Great Sects, they scorned to come over and offer a greeting.

They didn't know you at all, but the moment they saw your plain blue robe they immediately recognized you as a Tang Clan Disciple. Especially you ‑ without being acquainted, they could tell at a glance that you must be the well‑known Tang Clan Ugly Hero. After a bit of small talk and getting to know you, they'll have plenty to brag about when they return.

They encountered the Quanzhen Sect. Although Quanzhen considers itself one of the Six Great Sects, it has sided with the Jin state; when its members saw you being escorted by Song officials and soldiers, they were even more ashamed to face you and all stepped aside to let you through.
They encountered members of the Quanzhen Sect on the road.

News that the Diancang Sect had been set back by the Tang Clan while on the road spread, and somehow it turned into a story that the Tang Clan had ambushed and treacherously plotted against Diancang. You weren't quick to explain; instead the Diancang Sect went around trying to dispel the rumors.
The Tang Clan was thwarted by the Diancang sect in the Wulin, completely lost face, and became a laughingstock.

But the relatives and friends who were close to your adversary all looked at you with gratitude. The feud between the two families won't vanish immediately, but you have sown seeds of kindness; the next generation of Diancang people will remember your magnanimity.

In the fierce fight, you still remembered to hold back, besting the powerful enemy with your short sword while sparing their life. The master of the Diancang sect couldn't bear to lose face and left sullenly.
Show mercy

In the fierce fight you didn't hold back; a Diancang expert fell beneath your short sword. Diancang was grief‑stricken and furious, but since they had initiated the challenge, there was no grievance over life and death. They said little then, merely cupped their hands and led the corpse away ‑ this grudge is likely only to deepen.
Murder
You want to fight? Bring it on ‑ I'll fuck your mother!

They wouldn't listen to reason. Putting the greater good first and unwilling to create unnecessary complications before the Wulin gathering, you stepped forward through the crowd, drew your short sword, crossed blades with the opponent's long sword, and accepted the challenge.
Select representatives for one‑on‑one sparring

Faced with the Diancang Sect's provocation, you put the bigger picture first and, unwilling to cause an incident before the Wulin gathering, chose to swallow your anger and yield, allowing them to be arrogant and taunt you once before you left.
Don't create unnecessary complications; swallow your anger and keep silent.
They encountered the Tang Clan's long‑standing enemy, the Diancang sect. Old grudges flared at the sight of each other, and the situation was on the brink of erupting!

They ran into the Tang Clan's long‑time rivals, the Diancang Sect. Someone shouted traitor! and the Tang Clan members drew their swords ‑ the situation was about to erupt.

They ran into the Tang Clan's sworn enemy, the Diancang sect. You encountered the Tang Clan's longtime rival, the Diancang sect. At first the Diancang forces, seeing the Tang Clan's colors, were eager to test them, but when they suddenly realized your party was being escorted by officials and soldiers they were taken aback and promptly stepped aside.

You led the Tang Clan Disciples in a hard‑fought battle against Kongtong's formidable foes. Seeing that you were difficult to deal with, Jinwu Shangren had no choice but to sound the gong and withdraw, reserving some strength for the Wulin Grand Assembly. Although you were angry, there was nothing you could do.

The Tang Clan suffered a setback at the hands of the Kongtong sect, lost all face, and became a laughingstock. Because you carried letters of summons‑having been summoned by the Imperial Court‑Jinwu Shangren did not dare to kill you outright. After mocking you thoroughly, they simply turned and walked away.

They agreed to meet again at Fengyu Mountain. The Kongtong disciples one after another bowed and cupped their hands to you. You cupped your hands and nodded, signaling the Kongtong disciples to go first. The Tang Clan juniors, seeing you calm and composed and already bearing the air of a great master, were all filled with admiration.

Having agreed to meet again at Fengyu Mountain, the Kongtong Disciples one after another bowed and offered the cupped‑hand salute to you. You dared not be haughty; you quickly clasped your fist in return and respectfully saw the Kongtong Disciples off as they departed.
Sect Leader Wei really doesn't seem like someone from the Wulin; they come across more like a government official.
When he finished speaking, Sect Leader Wei bowed with his hands clasped and withdrew from your sight. His adherence to ceremony was so strict it could rival the imperial court.

Those who head the branches must not crush their subordinates; the duties of the four branch masters amount to little more than obeying the branch leader's commands and giving their all in service to our sect.
All right, thank you for your hard work, Sect Leader Wei. Kongtong isn't affected by my being a titular sect leader; without you it really wouldn't work.
Kongtong can do without me, a sect head in name only, but without Sect Leader Wei it would be a disaster.
In that case, I will accompany Senior Brother Danxiazi, assist along the way, and submit my resignation to the sect master.

Xiao Ju is usually poised and composed; at this moment, their tender heart is fixed on you. After exchanging a few intimate words, they were overcome with shyness, couldn't bear to face you, and hurried away.
After the Great Martial Assembly, I will go with you to the Tang Clan and kneel before Sect Master Tang. From now on... we shall be true lifelong partners.

No... not in broad daylight ‑ it's far too embarrassing. Zhao Lang... Zhao Lang, please be considerate of your little sister; I still have to lead the Kongtong troops. If people see a young woman like me showing such coy, bashful behavior, how will I ever face anyone?
You needn't come; I, your concubine, will‑like Hong Fu Nu who threw herself at Li Jing by night‑rush to your side.
I'm afraid you'll change your mind. If you don't come soon, I'll have to go up to Kongtong and snatch you.

Although Wei Ju is a woman and was taught propriety and a sense of decency, how could she be fickle? Now that she has chosen Zhao Lang in this life, she will follow you wholeheartedly and never regret it.
I was so afraid that once you calmed down and thought it over for a while, you'd change your mind.
... But this humble woman was very pleased to hear it.

That's wonderful ‑ I've missed you every moment since we parted.

I have already taken charge of the Mystic Skill Sect and ensured the scriptures were properly handed over. This time I intend to tender my resignation to those who preside over the sect. After the Wulin Assembly, I will step down as sect master, go to the Tang Clan, and live with Zhao Lang...
Yes, Xiao Ju is here, Mr. Zhao.
Sect Leader Wei... Xiao Ju.
But as a man, what's the big deal about three wives and four concubines? No matter how many beautiful women there are, I can handle them all.
How should I tell her that my affections have moved on to someone else?
I, as your concubine, dare not be presumptuous; supporting my husband is a wife's duty.
As befits Sect Leader Wei, Kongtong's foremost talented woman.
Is that so? I had thought he kept insisting I was the head of the sect, yet he didn't take me seriously.

Brother Danxiazi has served on the front lines for many years; as a result the sect was nearly usurped by treacherous people, and they have been deeply troubled by it. It was never their intention to slight the Sect Master‑ I beg the Sect Master to be magnanimous and not to hold it against them.
General Daofa, wait‑ah, they've gotten away
Now that we have the sect leader's approval, I'll go at once to dispatch the men and horses!

Sect Leader Wei's words were a wake‑up call. If they can turn enemies into friends and bridge the rift between the two sects, this is indeed a golden opportunity. Otherwise, even if they don't fight openly, nursing resentment will mean that when they next meet in the Jianghu they'll inevitably have to settle the score.
Uh... I didn't think that far ahead at all.

Kongtong clearing the way is both a gesture of sincerity and a statement of position ‑ a solemn pronouncement from the Peerless. At the Wulin assembly, the two factions will stand united and closely allied; petty villains will surely be alarmed and won't dare act on crooked intentions. Please have your sect leader take notice.

Earlier Kongtong was misled by a scoundrel and grievously offended the Tang Clan. Although, because it was the doing of the sect leader, the members of the Tang Clan did not pursue the matter, the Jianghu will inevitably be rife with gossip. Now is a prime opportunity to make amends through meritorious deeds.
I would like to hear the details
I report to the sect leader that I believe Senior Brother Danxiazi's request is reasonable.

Our sect is already being escorted by officials and soldiers. If we then proceeded alongside Kongtong as well, the show of force would be a bit too grand ‑ it would indeed come across as ostentatious.
There's no need for this
Sect Leader, I humbly volunteer to serve as vanguard ‑ to lead Kongtong's men and horses forward, open the way for the Tang Clan, and clear the dangers ahead.

It's not that I don't love fame and fortune ‑ the problem is that a whole lot of people in Kongtong want to murder me. Rather than shamelessly clinging on and being resented, I'd rather retire after accomplishing my deeds and earn a good reputation.
No, how could I possibly do that?

How can I dare be called a leader? I'm only a young woman bearing an honorary title; when it comes to commanding troops on campaign, Kongtong rightly belongs first to the General of Daoist Arts. Now that I've been fortunate enough to meet the sect head, I will naturally follow their lead.
Kongtong is guarded by the three palm masters of Flying Heaven, Soul Stealer, and Iron Fist. Our group is led by Brother Wei, the Palm Master.
Indeed, heroes and heroic figures throughout the realm are likely all on the road at this moment; it's not just the Tang Clan and Kongtong.
May I ask, Sect Leader: since you are leading the Tang Clan's heroes on this trip, you are presumably headed to Fengyu Mountain in Yueyang to attend the Wulin gathering, aren't you?
The sect master said, Not at all. Although it's regrettable that my subordinate couldn't pay respects to Lady Lan, there's no need to apologize.
She prefers peace and quiet and seldom shows herself in public, so she will not come to see you; please forgive her.
Haha!
Is that so! Hahaha!
She appears and disappears like a ghost, secretly watching me, making me so on edge that I'm all jittery even when I step out to relieve myself in the middle of the night.
Isn't Lady Lan attending to the person in charge?
Ah ‑ and don't forget to inform Lord Song, and tell the officials and soldiers to rest where they are.
If the one who sent us doesn't give the nod, we're not going anywhere.
I'll go. Senior Brother Danxiazi, Sect Leader Wei, you two must wait for me to come back before you leave, okay?
I'll go tell the Tang Clan junior disciples to rest here. Kongtong are now friends, not enemies; there's no need to treat them like mortal adversaries.
At your command
Okay
Okay ‑ I won't be coming back for a while. I want to go find Xiao Zhu. Is that all right?
Xiaomei, please tell our fellow disciples to rest where they are. Kongtong are friends now, not enemies; there's no need to treat them as a grave threat.
What am I to do about this...?

Being Sect Chief is not merely a position; it is Kongtong's highest spiritual symbol, signifying the end of the chaotic era. As long as the Sect Chief holds the post, Kongtong can at last see clear skies and be bathed in sunlight. Even if you take no part in Kongtong's affairs, that matters not ‑ we will still regard you as our leader.

You two needn't be so formal. I never took over Kongtong‑I only made a big scene. Kongtong not holding it against me is already something I'm deeply grateful for; I wouldn't dare presume to call myself the head of the sect.
Please rise, both of you. I have already returned the Kongtong Divine Sword, and I am not someone sent by the Kongtong sect. You must absolutely not do this.
Senior Brother Danxiazi's admonition is reasonable; how could I, this humble woman, not know? But... it's so embarrassing... What if the head of the sect changes their mind?
Lady Ju, the title of the Lady of the First Palm Sect should take precedence over the Master of Mystic Skill. You're wrong about that.
Kongtong Mystic Skill Sect Leader, I pay my respects.
Danxiazi, a disciple of the Kongtong Flying Heaven Sect, pays respects to the Sect Head!
The Kongtong Mystic Skill Sect Leader pays respects to the faction head and Lady Zhu.
Danxiazi, a disciple of the Kongtong Flying Heaven Sect, pays respects to the head of the sect and Madam Zhu!
Oh, come on... you know I have poor eyesight.
Don't stare so hard; others might see it and assume you're holding a grudge and don't welcome them.
The Kongtong Mystic Skill Sect Leader pays respects to the sect's representative and Lady Mei.
Danxiazi, a disciple of the Kongtong Flying Heaven Sect, called on the sect head and Madam Mei.
A'Huo, look, it's Danxiazi Senior Brother and Wei Daoist Gatemaster!
Kongtong yielded the way and let the Tang Clan go first; thereafter they deliberately kept their distance and did not so much as harm the Tang Clan.
......Sect Leader Xiao Wei is really strict; it's just a pity she's female.
That's all I have to say. A mere upstart like you is not someone to be confided in; I, your little sister, no longer have the slightest hope for you.
You... how could you possibly know everything...?

Senior Brother Danxiazi, isn't it because you couldn't win the master's favor that you disregarded the safety of the Kongtong brethren, preferring to throw away this useful body, give up on yourself and throw yourself into the battlefield, as if you couldn't wait to die to bring grief to your kin and joy to your enemies? You call it for the country and the people, but you're still less reliable than that Young Hero Zhao, who looks after their family.
What does this mean now?
Those who let themselves fall into ruin are not to be reasoned with; those who give themselves up cannot be entrusted with any undertaking.
...I'm also hoping Kongtong will send a capable person to lead the sect.
In short, Kongtong's corruption is due to the lack of a sect leader. Only when a person of virtue becomes the sect leader will the Kongtong sect be well.
I don't know. Please don't be so pedantic with classical phrases‑I can barely make sense of military strategy, so how could I understand these lofty principles?

Mencius said: Only the benevolent should occupy high office. If someone who is not benevolent occupies a high position, they will spread their evil among the people. He also said: If the ruler is benevolent, everyone will be benevolent; if the ruler is righteous, everyone will be righteous; if the ruler is upright, everyone will be upright. Do you know what this means?
Sigh... The Kongtong Sect wasn't like this before.

If this younger sister is fortunate enough to die at the hands of the Tang Clan, it would at least return my life to the former sect master ‑ an act of utmost righteousness and compassion. Better than spending my life aiding a tyrant and defending thieves. The Kongtong Sect as it stands now is not worth saving.
Th‑this... after all, they are fellow disciples of the same sect; when one prospers, all prosper, and when one suffers, all suffer.

It was clearly the Kongtong Sect's fault, yet they insist on saving face, whitewashing their mistakes ‑ utterly shameless. I, as a younger sister, cannot speak up for what's right, and yet I'm forced to be an accomplice?

I've grown tired of cleaning up the messes left by the willful, vulgar ruffians in the Kongtong Sect. I only endured this long out of the previous sect head's instructions. But the matter of Jinwu Shangren has finally pushed me beyond endurance.
‑Because this little sister hates the Kongtong Sect.
All right. I swear to Heaven I will definitely keep it secret; otherwise, let me die on the battlefield.
Right now, throughout Kongtong, I only trust Senior Brother Danxiazi. I'm telling you this‑please keep it secret for me.
What is that?
...I, your little sister, still have one reason I absolutely must go, you know.
But you're the sect leader and a direct female disciple, so your status is far from ordinary. I can't help worrying ‑ why don't I go as the hostage?
Calling someone deep isn't a compliment. Senior Brother Danxiazi, how on earth are you, being so clueless, so trusted by your comrades‑in‑arms...?
I understand. No wonder‑Sect Leader Wei is truly inscrutable.

I'll go. If I press forward I can use Jianghu public opinion to clamp down on the Tang Clan; if I fall back I can show Kongtong's magnanimous spirit. The Tang Clan surely won't marshal the whole sect to bully a mere frail female like me, nor can they shut me out. Yes, this younger sister sincerely wants to join the Tang Clan.
Since I asked, I naturally want to hear the truth.
Senior Brother Danxiazi, do you want your junior sister to tell the truth?
...Sect Leader Wei, do you really want to go to the Tang Clan?
Then hurry up and leave
I'll still choose the Wulin Tournament

Senior Brother, are we just going to let this go? They've certainly been up to no good.
...I take my leave.
Young Hero Zhao, members of the Tang Clan, please go on ahead. We'll meet again at the Yueyang Fengyu Mountain Wulin Conference.
Yes

Ju Dongyin, Dharma Protector of Kongtong Mystic Skill, is at the sect leader's disposal.
Where is Kongtong's Wind Protector?
That is all. In this female's humble opinion, the two factions should not linger here. If there's anything to discuss, you might as well go to Fengyu Mountain and talk it over there.
What a ruthless character, what a master of advancing by retreating.

She's just a frail woman visiting the Tang Clan as a guest; turning her away would make the Tang Clan look petty. If they gave her a hard time, they'd provide fodder for gossip ‑ killing her wouldn't satisfy anyone and would condemn the Tang Clan to everlasting infamy.
Sect Leader Wei seems to demand perfection, but is actually using claims of righteousness and morality to pressure the Tang Clan.
Sect Master Wei speaks with cultured manners, yet her courage and judgment are remarkable; she is likely no less bold than many men. She can truly be called a woman of valor.
If someone from the Tang Clan kills or harms me, then the feud between the Tang Clan and Kongtong will be considered settled. From then on, neither side may retaliate‑isn't that clean and decisive?
It turns out the Eldest Senior Brother really went to Xiangyang.

...He once stood shoulder to shoulder with me in Xiangyang, forcefully breaking the Jin forces' encirclement and saving the people from disaster. I hadn't meant to mention it; saying so would make it sound as if I'm trying to curry favor.
Do you know our senior brother?
That's true, but... just like in Kongtong there are both good people and villains, how can you guarantee that everyone in the Tang Clan will be as bold and uninhibited as Tang Buyi?

I don't think so. Didn't you tell me the Tang Clan doesn't take sides between black and white and does things their own way, yet all their actions follow the chivalric code? Aren't they far more straightforward than the scheming, self‑righteous orthodox factions of the Wulin?
Why consult anyone about this kind of bad luck? Would anyone still try to compete with me? Besides, is it really dangerous for me to visit the Tang Clan as a guest?
Have you and the Third Sect Leader discussed this?
If it weren't done this way, how could it show the sincerity of the apology?
Sect Leader Wei, you are one of Kongtong's four leaders‑how can you, as the esteemed head of the Mystic Skill Sect, take such a risk!

Although we were wronged by others, it is an undeniable fact that we also disturbed the Tang Clan, and we cannot shirk our responsibility. But now that matters have come to this point, exchanging life for life would accomplish nothing; it would be better to seek reconciliation. Once the Wulin Assembly concludes, I, a young woman, will personally call on the Tang Clan with generous gifts and humbly submit myself to punishment.

Palm Master Wei's neigong is profound; she hears and sees everything clearly. Although she trusts your character, she still can't help shivering when she overhears the words spoken by the two Tang Clan disciples behind you.

Master Tang Clan's neigong is profound; she hears and sees clearly. The words spoken by the two Tang Clan disciples behind you have all been heard by her ears, though she does not know your true nature, she cannot help but be on high alert.
You beast! You animal! He must be coveting Sect Leader Wei's beauty and wants to have a baby with them!

...Young Hero Zhao, you're joking; Kongtong could never harbor such ambitions. I, a young woman, know you are filled with indignation ‑ it is only natural.

...Please forgive me, Sect Leader Wei; I'm not trying to judge a gentleman with a petty person's suspicions‑it's just that once bitten, twice shy.
The feud between the two factions can't be brushed aside with just a few words (said tauntingly).
Sorry
Senior Brother Danxiazi, you've been reckless

We are not blocking the road, and we certainly are not here to demand justice for Jinwu Shangren.

You can come here often‑it's all physical labor, and there's a constant need for workers. Many gamblers who lost a fortune and are in desperate need of money come here as temporary workers, earning money to gamble again.

This is the territory of the Iron Fist Sect, where various people reside, and the main source of livelihood is iron shops. It's too early now, unlike Colorless Square, which is bustling early in the morning for profit.
Haha, that's good. Even if you have such an idea, remember to make full preparations before taking action; otherwise, you'll die. Go on, next place.
I have the utmost respect for Miss Xiao Mei, with absolutely no intention of being offensive!
If A'Huo you intend to sell me or assault me, then you commit a crime.
For safety, I'll ask again‑taking me for a walk, haven't you violated any mountain sect's rules?
I'm afraid that if I go buy it, he'll have evil intentions again, and in the end, both legs will be gone.
You see, the vendor lost a leg, right? That's because he once tried to bind me down the mountain, but was caught by the Soul Stealer sect and had his leg amputated according to the mountain's laws.
Why?
By the way, the barbecue stand ahead has really delicious mountain delicacies, but I'm not brave enough to buy.
I also don't know whether you, A'Huo, are black or white.
Do you have someone like you to recommend?
Excellent!

If you have any living needs, you can come here to look around. If you're short on money, you can also take on some odd jobs. If you want to make quick money, there are casinos and fighting arenas here, suitable for people who want to get into bad habits.
It's just like a small village

This is the Colorless Market, also known as the Four Symbols Square. As the name suggests, it is an absolutely neutral ground where none of the four gates intervene. Although that's the case, the majority of people who have settled here are from the Iron Fist Sect.
A'Huo, Mei is really considerate, wahaha! Let's go, A'Huo. We'll start with the market first.
That's better!
You must remember the route we're taking carefully, you know. You wanted to practice, didn't you? Next time, come to Flying Heaven Hall to find me, and then we'll run together.
Are you serious? That's great!

That's settled! When we meet in the mountains, don't pretend not to recognize me. I suppose you're a newcomer, and Kongtong Mountain hasn't been fully explored by you yet. Today, I, Mei, will take on the role of your guide and accompany you on a tour of the mountain.
...No, that's all. Please don't push me down the stairs.

Which part are you dissatisfied with? Do you not want me to call you Xiao Mei and prefer A'Mei instead? Or is it that you don't want to be called A'Huo? Do you want me to push you down the stairs so your name no longer fits who you are?
Is this good?
A'Huo is truly straightforward! This aspect of Brother Mei's character I very much admire!
Alright!
Do not call me Senior Sister; you are not a genuine Kongtong disciple. Call me Xiao Mei, and I will call you A'Huo.
Oh, so that's how it is?
But you're different; you've only been here for half a year and have nothing to do with the Kongtong feud. I'm curious about you, so I came to play with you.

It is what it is; I was born exceptionally good‑looking, and my status is unique. Many people fear me, and quite a few are jealous of me. Those who approach me often have ulterior motives. I have many brothers and sisters, but none can truly be considered friends.
Is there any possibility?
Hmm～ I don't like people who judge others by their appearance. You might be shunned by others because of your looks, and so would I.
It's just... upon seeing Senior Sister, I feel utterly ashamed of myself. How could someone like me, with such poor appearance and demeanor, have the qualifications to discuss with Senior Sister Yu?
How could I dare!
No, there's no problem. I befriend whoever I like, and that's all. What's the issue? Unless you dislike me and don't want to be friends with me.
Have you met Sister Yu? But I'm not studying at Flying Heaven Sect, so Sister Yu must have mistaken me, right?
It's a mad crane with a unique spirit, trying all day to speak human language, which I'll introduce to you later.
Lying with one's eyes open! Who is Fire Lightning again?
Hahaha!

It's not me teasing you, Ah He Xia truly exists; he is Fire Lightning's friend. He fell and died, his soul returned and resides in my right hand. The one who spoke to you just now was Ah He, not me, hahaha.

Yes, I have already met the Fire Dragon Immortal Monarch and am temporarily registered as an apprentice at Flying Heaven Gate. I thought Ah He Xia was which high‑ranking figure, it turns out it was Yu Sister‑in‑law playing a trick on me.
My master is Fire Dragon Daoist of the Flying Sky Sect; you must have already met them.
So, a formal self‑introduction. It's a pleasure to meet you. I am Yu Xiaomei, a direct female disciple of the Flying Heaven Sect.
Ha ha ha～
This isn't something to be rejoiced in, is it?
However, it's a relief that after meeting, I'm confident I won't treat you as a person!
It's different; I like dogs more than people.
In your eyes, are all those who flatter you like dogs?
You should be a bit more emotionally excited, like the other senior brothers did when they saw me, showing faces as eager as dogs to flatter me.
Otherwise, how should I do?
It's clearly praising me but very cold! Mei was greatly hurt!
Hmm, the miss indeed possesses the beauty that makes the moon hide and the flowers blush.
Are you okay?
Just joking!
Wait, really?
Wow, your expression is a bit scary. Mei is shocked and already wants to go home.
Truly enchanting
This girl is indeed very beautiful, like plum blossoms blooming in the snow, white with a hint of red, pure and charming.
Yes
Ha ha ha～
This isn't something to be rejoiced in, is it?
However, it's a relief that after meeting, I'm confident I won't treat you as a person!
It's different; I like dogs more than people.
In your eyes, are all those who flatter you like dogs?
You should be a bit more emotionally excited, like the other senior brothers did when they saw me, showing faces as eager as dogs to flatter me.
Otherwise, how should I do?
It's clearly praising me but very cold! Mei was greatly hurt!
Hmm, the miss indeed possesses the beauty that makes the moon hide and the flowers blush.
How's it going? The girl introduced by Ah He Xia, are you still satisfied? Is your little heart spontaneously racing uncontrollably?
This elder is truly interesting
I'm sorry to the person who snores loudly. I'm sorry to the person who sleeps without clothes.
Oh, right. I'm sorry, I often overlook others' feelings.
Alright, alright. I'll go out. Senior, please quiet down, there are still many people asleep.
Come out to play! Come out to play! Come out to play!
This Crane Hand Elder's entangling technique can match the senior brother's. No, not the same... she at least extended an invitation from outside, but the senior brother would rush in to kidnap me.
Come out to play! Come out to play! Come out to play!
Then you're definitely going to come out and play. Don't even think about running away; I know your name and where you live. I'll come bother you every day until you come out.
Still, I implore you, senior, to spare me. The less they know, the longer one lives. I came to Kongtong Mountain merely to study martial arts diligently.
Oh... you really might be pushed off the mountain by someone.
I am naturally not afraid of idle chatter, but if the young lady mentioned by my senior is too beautiful or has too good of a reputation, I often end up being envied and beaten afterward.
You are upright in heart, merely forming ordinary friendships; why worry about others' gossip?
I do mind; you can imagine how I'd be used as an example‑like the toad wanting to eat a swan.
What if she herself doesn't mind?
Even though we're all Jianghu folks who don't mind small details, you see... I mean, I do look like this, after all.
That's not about whether you like or dislike it; this is for the girl's sake. The elder mentioned that if the girl is too kind and gets into a tangle with me, it would also affect her own reputation.
Indeed, she is quiet and gentle, like cotton‑soft and gentle is better.
Is being too lively not good? Don't you prefer quiet Females?
Being too lively isn't good
Well, strictly speaking, it's not really very pretty, just okay, right? Being outgoing and lively is an advantage; is that satisfactory for you?
It's better not to compare if someone is too beautiful; men and women should not be too familiar.
Okay
Yesterday you practiced, today you rest‑this is called the balance of tension and relaxation. Hurry up and come out.
Ha ha ha! What Mei says is naturally sound.
Senior, your guidance is spot on. I'm bowing in complete humility.
Your name is Zhao Huo, right? If you don't understand carpe diem, then you're not living up to your name. You can only be called Zhao Huxi at most.
You're overworking yourself, feeling so distressed and wronged, and angry. You've been enduring, even though you know tomorrow might not get better?
I? How am I supposed to use it? I'm a person, not a prop.
Really? Then you aren't using it that way either.
No, just saying the stairs aren't used like that...
Stairs are like weapons; they have no inherent good or bad. It's the person standing on the windward side of the stairs who decides whether to do good or evil.
Wasn't the staircase meant for this? Moreover, the staircase isn't only for helping good people, is it?
The staircase is the most selfless accomplice to each pitiful person who longs for revenge.
You can take matters into your own hands; even if you can't beat them, you can still push them down the stairs from behind when they're not looking.

Living under someone else's roof, if you can bear it, bear it. Take a step back, and the sky will be wide and the space vast. Even if I can report to the Disciplinary Officer, once I report once, the next time someone else will come to bully me. As an outsider disciple, if I keep complaining about other initiated disciples all day, in the end, even the master will come to hate me.
You don't have to be strong. Just find an opportunity to push your senior brothers who bully others down the stairs, and that's all.
Filing a complaint is useless; those disciples come and go, usually not staying long. I need to grow strong on my own so that I won't be bullied.
Too much bullying! Are your sect's elders not paying attention?
They can just storm in and hit people. Scold me for still sleeping when the sun is already high, how not to do menial tasks to honor the master's gate?
You won't go out, what else can they do?
I've lost count. Later on, I just decided not to go out when I encountered people provoking me. But those who want to bully others would never just give up.
Could you believe it? Your misfortune happened not just once, but multiple times?
The second and third times I fell for this trick, I believed this ghostly talk that I'm different.
......I didn't mean to mock you, I'm not the same, come out.
Because this isn't a joke, to them, I myself am the joke.
This is really too awful... The Tang Clan's way of joking with people is really not funny.
If I protect that miss, you will quarrel and force me to marry that innocent young miss. If I am angry, it will become an opportunity for you to break off and fight with me.

However, based on my experience, when I enthusiastically agree, you will push out a girl who is also bullied for her ugly appearance. Then a group of people will come from all sides to mock us for being a good match.
Hey, that's great!

Hi, no problem. I just wanted to ask if you'd like to come out and play. I can introduce you to a beautiful young miss and show you around the famous scenic spots of Kongtong Mountain. Anyway, you've been here for days, and nobody has taken you around yet.
Oh... I wonder what the senior has to teach me. Why don't you let me practice?
I am the immortal crane that has practiced cultivation on this mountain for a thousand years, known as... Ah He Xia!
...Dare I ask, what divine being are you?
Yes, that's me!
You looked in the direction of the sound and saw a crane‑shaped cunning hand at the window speaking to you.
Look over there! Here.
Who? Who is speaking?
Stop practicing first, that guy in blue over there!
Good, the quilt is neatly folded. Today, I'll also put in more effort to practice the skills!

Since joining the Tang Clan, this has been the first time you've been so far from home, and a certain amount of anxiety is inevitable. However, at this moment, your heart is filled with determination and ambition, burning with passion. Your six‑month study period at the Kongtong Sect has officially begun.
Stop meddling!
Is this nickname a bit too long and awkward to pronounce? Just call it Lion of the Fiery Flame instead; it's smoother and easier for others to remember.
That's fine, that's fine! Then I'll be going first, as the younger brother. Master Zhao, please do as you wish, I'll be taking my leave now.
It's Senior Brother Flame Eagle Hu Lie, it's a pleasure to meet you again!
What a grand nickname! It must be self‑chosen!
I am Xu Sheng, the Flying Heaven Fiery Flame Divine Eagle.
Thank you, may I ask how to address the Senior Brother?

This is our sect's newly built guesthouse; you'll be staying in the southern Lingguang chamber. You may practice here as you please, and when you have some spare time, you can stroll around the colorless square market. You are registered under the Flying Heaven Gate's name; the entire Kongtong has no place you cannot go. Take advantage of the opportunity, Brother Zhao.
This Immortal Lord didn't expect you; you may leave.
Thank you, Senior! I will definitely devote myself to cultivation!
You have no further duties. Go back. During the six months at the Kongtong Sect, if you do not cause trouble and diligently advance, then the Supreme Immortal will teach you profound martial arts.

Today, this Immortal Lord will first teach you the Flying Heaven Sect's secret manual. You go down and study it thoroughly; after some time, someone will come to guide you in the martial arts from the book.

No problem, the method of this immortal being revered by ordinary people is originally without issue. If you truly have the heart to seek immortality and serve this immortal, you will need to wait some time to see your fate.
Dare! Threefold True Fire is my master's exclusive divine technique! You, a mere mortal, dare to covet divine arts‑what are your intentions!
Please, I also want to spray fire
Hmph, clinging to the mundane world, short‑sighted, pitiful and laughable. Well, the foolish dreams of ordinary mortals‑this Immortal shall break the norm and join them once.
I don't have, I just want to practice some secular martial arts.

Since you've drawn the Flying Heaven Gate's lot, it's also a sign of your deep fortune. However, the path to immortality cannot be achieved without decades of dedicated and arduous cultivation. What to speak of a mere half‑year?
Why did I almost get killed and still have to thank the criminal?
Um... Thank you, senior?

...You wretch, you look truly repulsive, scaring me half to death. If it weren't for my Immortal Lord's extraordinary composure and timely restraint of their divine technique, you would have been incinerated by the Three Flames of True Fire already. Hurry up and kneel to thank the Immortal Lord for sparing your life.
Uh!?
Junior Zhao Huo of the Tang Clan bows to the Flying Heaven Leader, the Fire Dragon Immortal Monarch, Senior.
Yes
Among those who joined the Flying Heaven Sect, there are also members from the Quanzhen Sect. This immortal doesn't want to pursue this empty reputation, merely to provoke the world's criticism.
Hmph, calling the current Immortal as Immortal‑you thing, though ugly, still has some discernment. However, during this period, you may address the Immortal as Senior along with others.
Junior Tang Clan Disciple Zhao Huo humbly greets the senior Fire Dragon Immortal.

Since joining the Tang Clan, this is the first time you've left home so far, and a bit of anxiety is inevitable. However, at this moment, your heart is filled with ambition and determination, brimming with fervor. Your academic life at the Kongtong Sect for half a year has officially begun.
Thank you... Ah, they've left, not even telling me their name‑how cold.

Just stepping into the Colorless Plaza, be cautious of thieves. If there's no summons from the master or elder, try to avoid the Flying Heaven Gate as much as possible. If you go there, first you'll draw suspicion from the Soul Stealer Gate, and second, you can't be sure you won't suffer disgrace. Take care.
This is our sect's newly built guesthouse; you will stay in the Mengzhang Chamber on the east side. You may focus on your cultivation here; when you have free time, wandering around is also fine.
Please have the fellow disciples take you to the guesthouse. All daily necessities are provided; after a few days, we will visit you again to chat.
Understood, I will never forget

The matters we have confessed to you today‑if you wish to report to the Flying Heaven sect, it is up to you. But if the Soul Stealer sect gains power, you will never set foot on Kongtong Mountain again in your lifetime.
Don't get too excited just yet; first courtesy, then force. Since I've given you this secret manual, no one can accuse the Soul Stealer Sect of being stingy. There's more unpleasant talk coming.
Thank you, both senior brothers
However, using your fingers instead of claws to practice this technique, I suppose it's also acceptable.

Our sect specializes in unconventional tactics, and it was meant for the sect leader to lead the mission to custom‑make a pair of iron claws from the Iron Fist Sect. Now that the sect leader is absent and we cannot summon the craftsmen from the Iron Fist Sect, we have no choice but to inconvenience you.
This is the sect's introductory secret manual. Now, the acting sect master is transmitting it to you.
Don't worry, the remaining three gates can do for you. With our positions within the sect, I think we can manage it.
But I've come all the way here‑surely I won't be sent back home right away, will I?
If there's no karmic connection to receive the transmission, then there's nothing that can be done.

Since both of you say I am half one of your own, then of course the important matters of the Soul Stealer Sect take precedence. It's true that I came to the mountain to learn martial arts, but to put it bluntly, that is just my own personal affair.
I see

The unique weapon of Jinwu Shangren, the Blazing Sun Hammer, is precisely the kryptonite of our sect's martial arts. The sect leader is absent because they have taken the sect's elite into a mountain cave for seclusion, striving to find a way to counter it. It has been six months, not intentionally neglecting guests.
If the Daoist general who left Flying Heaven Gate to join the military and fight does not return to compete for selection, the candidate sent by Flying Heaven Gate will undoubtedly be Jinwu Shangren.
Well, of course, a country cannot go a day without a monarch.

This is a major event for our sect occurring every thirty years. The current sect leader's term was not yet completed when they passed away; our sect has always attracted many extraordinary individuals, and we cannot be leaderless. No matter what happens, the sect leader election will inevitably take place next year.
Somewhat heard of
The upcoming election for the leader of the Kongtong sect, I suppose you've already heard about it.
What nonsense? Please enlighten me.
Brother Zhao, you have the fortune to enter my Soul Stealer sect, and you count as half a family member. Shall we get straight to the point and talk about it?
None of them are the master. The master is not in this place.
Uh... Pardon my bluntness, but may I ask which one of you is Senior Master Yao, the Soul Stealer Sect Leader?
Junior Tang Clan Zhao Huo, paying respects to the senior.
What's all this about overstepping? Don't be so overly formal‑just be straightforward!
Since the senior insists on this, then I dare to presume the honor of taking the initiative.
Good, Zhao Xiaozi, that's what's called having fun.
Good, Senior Brother Lei! Zhao Huo, the lad, please give me your guidance.
It's true, today there are outsiders, so they called the sect leader to avoid being laughed at. It made us feel very awkward.
After all, you don't know someone unless you fight; don't be too formal. In fact, these Iron Fist disciples have been used to calling me Senior Brother.
This master seems old and unrespectful, but is a kind‑hearted person.

After all, that's the gist of it. You get the idea. Who's to blame for the fact that my fellow disciples don't care at all? If I don't step up again, I fear the Iron Fist Sect brothers will be bullied even worse by the other three sects.
How should I know? It might be something you just made up. Grand Master... If you haven't read books, don't be stubborn.
What's wrong with it? This is called that thing, what stinks like a pig... can't be on the table? Is there such a proverb?
How can that be possible?

Little Brother, this time it's my fault. If you don't mind, don't call me the headmaster; just call me Senior Brother. I'm only a few years older than you, with a bit more beard. Being called the headmaster feels awkward.
Stop talking nonsense, who could possibly have such a thing? Enough, don't say anymore; the more you say, the more it doesn't make sense.
No, Master, he's always been like this

But my recklessness isn't something that happened just a day or two ago. You bunch of kids, not only didn't you stop me, but you even joined in the fun. Look at how you left that person in such a state of disarray‑how can I possibly make amends?
Er... yes, is that right? What you said seems to have some merit; this time, I was a bit reckless. Well... I'm sorry.
Master, I don't know that your Iron Fist Sect hasn't received the money. Let's talk properly. I'm also often exploited by people, so I can very much empathize with your situation.
You little guy, weren't you quite dissatisfied just now? Why not go down the mountain with those people?
I admit defeat, don't hit me
I must tell my master! I'm going home to tell my master! You'll see!
I'm done! I'll just go down the mountain! What a mess, what's so great about it! Teaching martial arts is enough, but they still hit people!

Since joining the Tang Clan, this has been the first time you've been so far from home, and a certain amount of anxiety is inevitable. However, at this moment, your heart is filled with determination and ambition, burning with passion. Your six‑month study period at the Kongtong Sect has officially begun.
Hahahahaha! Old man, I'm leaving. Brother Zhao, take our revenge by treating this guesthouse as your own home and turn it into a chaotic mess.
Fortunately, I drew the Iron Fist Sect! God bless!
How could that be? Not even spraying directly onto the dishes with one's behind already counts as considering the camaraderie of the same faction.
Oh my... This move is just too immoral.
This statement is as correct as it can be.
This move is powerful. Whoever provokes the eater is a fool, digging their own grave.

Through generations, it has become what it is today. If you encounter people from the other three gates who mock you, just ignore them. Report back to us, and we'll retaliate by putting nose mucus in their nice dishes.

The people of the four sects all need to eat; with more people, the demand for food and daily necessities increases. The other three sects were unwilling, and the situation escalated until the Iron Fist Sect made a concession, taking on the undesirable tasks that the other three sects refused to do. They lived simply, with just enough to sustain life.

That's not the case. Our sect's leaders through the generations have always been kind‑hearted. They took in people rejected by other sects indiscriminately, and over time, the number of people grew. Some are naturally lazy, just eating without working, which is very annoying.
Has the Iron Fist Sect always been treated so harshly?

This is our sect's newly built guesthouse; you'll be staying in the western sentinel quarters. You may stay there as you like. If someone calls you to join them for dinner in the mess hall, don't hesitate to go. If not, don't be surprised. When you hear the dinner bell, come to the construction site and join us for meals.
You, take Zhao Xiaozi to the newly renovated reception hall. We've put in the effort, but we can't enjoy it ourselves; this kid ends up with the benefit.

Oh, don't be so polite! This book is my own work; the handwriting is bad, so don't mind. That's all for today. You at least count as a guest, so when you're not working, you don't have to mix with us rough folks.
Thank you, Brother Lei
They say their own book is called a secret manual, they really do have thick skin.

Today, I'll teach you a complete manual that integrates our sect's External Skill with the art of smelting. You'll start learning on your own; if you have any questions, come to the blacksmith shop later, and learn by doing. The more you practice, the stronger you'll become! In a few days, I'll bring someone I know over to check on your progress.

This isn't even rough stuff! God damn it, weren't you here to practice martial arts? This is live combat training! It's a test! I'll knock you all senseless with one hammer if you don't take these damned young lords seriously‑those who don't worry about life and treat the Jianghu as a game!
What! You, you dare to rough up disciples from other sects?!

Who dares to mention donations? I haven't seen a single penny! If you hadn't said anything, I wouldn't be angry. If there really was money, it would be in that little girl from Mystic Skill Sect's hands, not for Iron Fist Sect to use! Brothers and sisters! Grab your weapons! We're about to fight!

You little brats, what are you saying! You little brats, go on then! I'll be honest, I've never been in favor of exchange students studying at other sects. But since Fire Dragon Elder has already said it out loud, I had no choice but to accompany him out of consideration for fellow disciples.
Is this still considered one of the Six Major Sects? It's nothing short of scoundrels! I'll make sure the Jianghu hears about this‑how the Kongtong Sect treats guests like slaves!

This brother is absolutely right. The Nangong family head clearly donated funds. If the Kongtong sect didn't want to join in the grand cause, why did they accept the donation in the first place? Once they've accepted the donation, they should do their part properly!

How absurd! We didn't come to the Iron Fist Sect on our own. Your Kongtong Sect disciples going to other sects for internships surely shouldn't be treated this way at all! Master's words are too cold to the hearts of fellow Jianghu martial artists!
Participate in a riot
This master seems old and unrespectful, but is a kind‑hearted person.
What's all this about overstepping? Don't be so overly formal‑just be straightforward!
Since the senior insists on this, then I dare to presume the honor of taking the initiative.
Good, Zhao Xiaozi, that's what's called having fun.
Good, Senior Brother Lei! Zhao Huo, the lad, please give me your guidance.

Don't call me the sect master. I feel too humble in leading the sect, and I don't have much ability. It's just that I fear the disciples of the Iron Fist Sect might be bullied by the other three sects, so I took it on. Just call me Senior Brother, and you can address the others as well.
I, a humble disciple named Zhao Huo, respectfully request your guidance, Master.
Good, you little guy, you're not bad at all. You're born with a fate of hardship, and it seems you fit well with our Iron Fist Sect. What's your name?
How could I dare, how could I dare.

This is what you said; don't blame us for not being hospitable when the time comes. I'll be straightforward; the funds from the Nangong Family's sponsorship this time haven't reached my hands at all. So you shouldn't blame me for being stingy.
That's fine; I'm in the Tang Clan and am used to doing odd jobs.
You little fellow, why aren't you leaving? I'm not here to play around. If you want to stay, you'll have to do something.
All the young Wulin members from various sects felt resentful upon hearing this, and soon left the mountain one after another.

Master Lei, I won't be staying any longer. Since you also say the Iron Fist Sect has no skills worth learning, everyone's wasting each other's time! All fellow martial artists, if you think I'm right, then let's go together!
If it's like that, this farce will end here. It's not that I don't respect your seniority, but I was born with a stubborn bone, unable to bend. Since I can't force myself, I'll take my leave!

Although unwilling, if I don't compromise, I can only return to the Tang Clan and never have a chance to rise again. I must endure humiliation and hardship. Even if the martial arts are elementary, at least there's someone to teach them.
Endure humiliation and bear a heavy burden

I had always known that Nangong Elder's idea was to impose impossible demands, wildly imaginative. Kongtong Sect not sharing their true teachings is not unreasonable, but the sect leader's demand for us to work the fields ourselves is an overly rude dismissal.
Did you get it wrong? What's this about?

I'm a rough fellow, don't know how to beat around the bush‑let me get this out of the way. The Iron Fist Sect has no free food, drink, or rice and grain; we can't accommodate high‑ranking disciples from esteemed families. If you've come, you must work to support yourselves; otherwise, pack up and leave early, return to your esteemed sect and report.
Uh...
Then what else can be done? If I pretend to be something I'm not, what if someone among them has higher martial arts skills than me and beats me? That would be even more embarrassing, wouldn't it?
Master of the Sect, don't diminish your own prestige!
By the way, although I am the sect leader, my martial arts aren't very good. I will still teach, but don't expect me to have any formidable martial arts.

To be honest, I don't mind if you find it amusing, but the Iron Fist sect specializes in tasks that nobody else wants to do. Forging iron, fixing feet, shaving heads, tailoring clothes, farming, checking weights, selling oil, and various other such jobs. Here among us are also some Little Misses, so I won't go into even messier ones.

It's just rotten, you know. Our Iron Fist sect's days have been particularly pitiful, not a secret at all. No need for any embellishment; if people are disappointed later, they'll blame me for not being honest.

Senior Master, you saying this isn't good, is it? No matter what, don't use the word 'rotten' like that. Don't say our fellow disciples will feel uncomfortable, and what would outsiders from other sects think?

Hahaha, my fellow sect members, this is truly an embarrassment. Although it's not proper for me to say so, the Iron Fist Sect is indeed the worst among the sects of Kongtong! The other three sects keep sending their rejects here, so there are a lot of miscellaneous people.

Since joining the Tang Clan, this has been the first time you've been so far from home, and a certain amount of anxiety is inevitable. However, at this moment, your heart is filled with determination and ambition, burning with passion. Your six‑month study period at the Kongtong Sect has officially begun.
So I shall take my leave then, Senior Brother Zhao. Please do as you please.

During Brother Zhao's time at the Kongtong Sect, he was a guest of our sect. I dared not trouble him with any matters, as his clothing and food were all supported by the Mystic Skill Sect.
