This intense training session continued until dusk to determine the winner.\nBoth winners and losers were utterly exhausted, but they had gained a great deal in terms of insight.

The Flying Stone Gang and the Tang Clan have interacted many times. We know that you are proud and refuse to accept handouts if offered money. So we went to Lu Weng to redeem the deed to the outer fortress of the Tang Clan, returning it to its rightful owner.\nThey can not only accommodate their allies for the West Wulin Congress but also express a token of apology.

You fought against Shangguan Family's lord wielding a large cleaver with your small sword. The waves of his blade surged back and forth, and you followed the flow to counterattack, matching him blow for blow.\nAlthough he has long washed his hands in a Golden Basin, his strength is not as formidable as it was at the peak of his powers. However, the Shangguan family's arts and techniques are exquisite, their momentum and dominance leaving no room for retreat. In today's world, there aren't many young practitioners who could withstand them. Moreover, he had a deliberate intention to kill, and did not use Cang Gang's Waves Reversing Blade Technique but instead resorted to his secret Sakra Blade technique. He struck out in the midst of the tumultuous waves, leaving no escape. By the time you were stunned by this sight, and as the momentum of his blade technique was still forming, he pounced and intercepted your attack. You were indeed shaken to spit out fresh blood, but in the chaos, you managed a counterattack, releasing hidden weapons to harm him.

You are alone in the outer fortress, checking on the injuries of your allies.\nAt this time, the war has ceased. The Wulin Alliance withdrew as agreed, retreating ninety li away. In areas affected by the conflict, countless farmlands were trampled and destroyed, and many houses were damaged or collapsed. They claimed not to have offended the people in any way, but they left behind a scene of devastation.\nYou were still worried that the elders and relatives might blame you, but to your surprise, everyone united in their support for the Western Wulin. Whether or not you have multiple hands, all sorts of food‑meat, poultry, fish, vegetables, and fruits‑were thrown at you all at once, hoping that the Tang Clan would eat well and gather enough strength before going to fight their mother.

You're far from as easy to intimidate as you look. The opponent was increasingly alarmed the more they fought against you and had no time to say even a few polite words before they were knocked unconscious to the ground.\nThe women then truly grew panicked and immediately stopped crying, no longer caring about propriety as they fled in a hurry.

The Golden Light Divine Fist hit you and threw you into jail.
You have the prison food to eat, while he gains a reputation. From this day on, another Great Hero has emerged.
Thanks to Shentu Long's testimony, your suspicion was quickly cleared. With Tang Fang and Ye Yunshang using their coins to grease the palms of those in power, the matter was smoothed over.
You spent only a few days in prison and were released without suffering much.

On the day she suffered her injury, the Second Senior Brother could administer strong medicine to regulate and expel the foreign True Qi in her body, helping her to process the uncontrollable True Qi within and eliminate the hidden danger.
The situation was starting to improve, but neither of them could have anticipated the sudden complications that arose for the Qingcheng Guild. Even with Tang Fang following to support them, they still fell victim to an ambush.
Peiban Fragrant Poison and the latent injuries are working in tandem; they cannot be rashly expelled. If we were to abruptly eliminate True Qi, the poison would lose its support and immediately invade the marrow sea, damaging one's mental faculties.
The person who used poison clearly has deep knowledge of pharmacology. By anticipating the Tang Clan's move and not knowing the countermeasure, this poison cannot be neutralized. With this plan, it would destroy Second Senior Brother's efforts and cut off Ye Yunshang's chances for survival.

Now I have no choice but to clean up after her, determined to go back and report to her brother Ye Yunzhao, carefully settle the accounts. If she doesn't get her comeuppance, you'll end up sharing her surname.
Reluctantly sighing, he prepared himself to take the blame.\nYe Yunshang saw that you weren't upset, and only then did she breathe a sigh of relief.

As she spoke, Sun Yi picked up the troublemaker Ye Yunshang and brought her in front of you.
The moment Yunshang saw your face, she cried out Brother and lunged forward. Surprisingly, you took a step back to avoid her.
Only because your living environment is filthy and unbearable, with nowhere to go and no home to return to. With dreams fading away, your heart has shriveled day by day. The Tang Clan uniform you couldn't bear to replace is now dirty and tattered, making you feel ashamed when you see Yunshang. Despite being so perceptive, she seems unaware of it all. The more you try to avoid her, the more you want to hold onto her.
Warmth lasted but a moment before Sun Aunty's smile stiffened upon hearing exactly what heroic deed she had done to anger her.
You internally groaned, realizing why she was acting so petulantly.
Don't you know the trick this Miss is pulling yet? Just by looking at her nervous expression, you can tell there's trouble ahead for you.

You don't have a good impression of this auntie.\nWhen I first arrived in Shu, I had no relatives to turn to, and being young, the money I earned each day barely kept me alive. To save on expenses for gifts that might please Tang Clan elders, I often went hungry one meal at a time, satisfying my hunger by smelling the savory aroma of pickled game. Sometimes, I couldn't resist sniffing it while eating plain porridge and steamed buns. Whenever Sun Aunty caught me doing this, she would fly into a rage, calling me ugly and stinky, worrying that it would affect her business.\nIt still pains you after nearly a decade.

They thought Fourth Senior Brother had eaten at someone's stall without paying and was coming to settle the debt with you. Unbeknownst to them, Fourth Senior Brother did indeed cut corners on the halva, but the reason they stopped you was for another matter.
Unable to stay any longer, he turned around to leave, only to be blocked by Aunt Sun, who sold pickled wild meat, on his way.

\nYou wandered the streets today without much to do and found yourself watching a performance of martial arts for a while, then listened to a free storytelling session. Unconsciously, you ended up at the Outer Wall, where the bustling activity has remained constant for decades. Today, with no particular task on your mind, you took a leisurely stroll through the streets and spent some time watching acrobatics. Then, without paying anything, you listened to a storyteller. Before you knew it, you found yourself at the Outer Wall, where the lively activity has been going on for several decades.\nThinking of the times when I used to live here and tried every possible way to get into the big courtyard, it feels like a lifetime ago, and sorrow weighs heavily on my heart.

He recently discovered a unique and unknown medicinal herb before. It is suspected to be the sovereign medicine of the Corpse Will from the Joyful Teaching in the past. This herb resembles both an insect and a plant, capable of parasitizing within young insects, spreading and growing there. When it fully occupies the host's body, it will forcibly control the host to burrow into the ground and commit seppuku. Only then does this grass‑like medicine begin to grow.\nTo discern the nature of the medicine, one needs prior evidence. Just as he was planning to descend the mountain and raid the prison to capture a few death‑row prisoners for experimentation, here comes Nangong Ji courting death by voluntarily walking into his den. With neigong and robust health, this container‑grown caterpillar fungus is destined to be his subject.

You were really curious and didn't follow the second senior brother's instructions to mess with any other medicine cabinets. You never expected that cabinets numbered one through ten all contained deadly mechanisms.\nSecond Senior Brother gave you three keys, but each can only open Drawer Four. Using any of the four‑number keys to open other drawers will trigger a mechanism and shoot out fine needles, killing anyone involved.

\nBased on Second Senior Brother's usual style, anyone who offends the Tang Clan would be decisively killed without mercy. Even if it's just Nangong Ji coming to take his life would be unnecessary; after all, killing is easy, but dealing with the aftermath is troublesome.\nIt's better to spare his life for another purpose. So, he threw a set of keys to you and instructed you to go get the medicine from the medicine cabinet.
You just promised to do your best, but once you got the words out, you went back on your word.

You are a veteran of the Tang Clan. Your Second Senior Brother's sternness towards you differs from that towards others, containing a profound intent to shape and improve you. Although you know that according to his style, those who offend the Tang Clan will be decisively and mercilessly killed, you still speak up to advise him.\nEven if it sounds offensive, Second Senior Brother cannot ignore it. If not for your shocked outburst and the unnecessary words you spoke by accident that damaged his image, he would likely have readily accepted your suggestion.\nNow, those who are accepted will be accepted, but you will inevitably suffer some physical pain as a warning to others.

Second Senior Brother did not seem pleased at all upon hearing this, and his dissatisfaction was evident in his expression.
He certainly doesn't treat you with respect, calling you a stupid pig and an idiot all the time without hesitation.
They do consider your opinion rather seriously, after all, you are a seasoned old‑timer of the Tang Clan. You should be intimately familiar with his way of doing things; knowing this, yet still daring to advise him respectfully‑doesn't that make one respect you even more?
Thus, we shall adopt half of it and spare this person's life, killing only half. As for the other half, naturally, you will bear that.

But what about when you left without saying goodbye and returned in such an unexpected manner?\nJust happened to witness this bunch of villains plotting their scheme, and now they're even pleading for mercy. With Second Senior Brother being suspicious of you, isn't that perfectly reasonable?\nBefore he could even attempt to deal with you, the accumulated fear from years of oppression had driven your soul out of your body. Panicked and desperate, you fled without thinking, tripped and fell, only to be pierced in the throat by a flying dart embedded in the ground from last night's battle, dying on the spot.
You truly cannot bear to see this person sacrifice their life, so you gritted your teeth and urged them to speak out.
Having exhausted all they knew, Nangong Ji stammered, unable to utter any useful information. The Second Senior Brother's gaze grew colder, and the killing intent had already been set.

Seeing that he could no longer get any useful information, Second Senior Brother sent him down the mountain in a hurry.
You were utterly astonished. According to Second Senior Brother's usual style, those who offend the Tang Clan are always killed without mercy. When did he become so lenient and compassionate?
Your second senior brother naturally isn't so kind; he has his own plans.
A few days ago, he discovered a rare and unknown medicinal herb that he suspects was the key ingredient in the former Joyful Teachings Sect's mind‑controlling venom. This herb resembles both an insect and a plant; it can parasitize within the bodies of young insects, spreading and growing until it completely dominates its host's body. At this point, it will forcibly control the host to burrow into the ground and commit suicide. Only then does the herb begin to take shape.
To discern the properties of a medicine, one needs to have prior evidence. Just as he was contemplating descending the mountain to escape from prison and capture several condemned prisoners for experimentation, here comes Nangong Ji courting death by rushing in. With his neigong and robust physique, this container‑grown caterpillar fungus is destined to be his subject.
This method might shock and astound, but if Huatuo wanted to perform craniotomy on Cao Cao to treat his brain disease, why wouldn't it also amaze the world! Breaking tradition to establish new methods‑should he be able to discern the properties of medicine and benefit future generations, Nangong Ji would also share in this glory. What difference does it make if life is worse than death?

As for encountering the Hell's Path Ghost Soldiers, it has nothing to do with them. At midnight, they only get more frightened than you, still suspecting you're colluding with the Tang Clan and the Mud Cult.

Young Lord Duan, who traces his lineage to Diancang, having ill intentions toward the Tang Clan is not unusual. But as to what he is scheming against Nangong, it's not something Nangong Ji can easily figure out.
Not only openly attacking the Tang Clan, secretly sabotaging the Nangong family, but also wanting to seize Ye Yunshang during the chaos to uncover the secret of the treasure.

He knew from a young age that he came from humble origins and to not be looked down upon by others, he had to work hard.
Work harder than others and be more diligent. To rise to a higher position, they also learned to bow, flatter, and fawn. After much effort, they finally gained the support of the tribal elders and were recommended to join the main branch in Jiangling.
Thought he had finally risen through the ranks, unbeknownst to him, he was instead assigned as the companion reader for the Second Young Lord by the head of the Nangong household.
This sudden turn of events was more than a thunderbolt on a clear day to him. You see, the Second Young Lord's birth mother was not even considered a concubine, and in truth, she was nothing but a mongrel. Following him offered no prospects; his treatment was both subtle and dismissive, which is why he harbored resentment towards the Nangong Family.
Despairing to the extreme, he could only seek blessings from deities and pray at temples. Following a rumor, he went to the Peach Blossom Grove, but was not fortunate enough to receive divine revelation. Instead, he inadvertently met the noble Young Lord of Dali who was traveling through Central China.
That young lord not only is the Qingyan Sword Guest of the Diancang faction, but also a cousin of the Dalin Duan family. His status is noble and distinguished, far beyond that of an ordinary Jianghu aristocrat.
Nangong Ji suddenly became enlightened: There's no place for me in the Central Plains; why not explore other paths and develop in another country instead? This thought sparked a desire to join forces with them.
This collusion with bandits of the Green Forest, using the name of Nangong to launch a night attack on Tang Clan, is his sworn bond.

\nYou went out to relieve yourself and came back to find Nangong Ji had suddenly changed. His eyes shone brightly, his smile warm and ingratiating, as if brainwashed into unwavering loyalty. He ceaselessly flattered Second Senior Brother, vouching with great confidence that he would speak nothing but the truth and reveal all.

You were babbling nonsensically and claimed to introduce Nangong Ji to the lascivious creditors of the Tang Clan in order to sell his skin for profit. This talk is shocking and left Nangong Ji utterly stunned.\nNot only does it trample his dignity, but it also ensures he will feel ashamed to reveal the truth later, forcing him to swallow his tears in silence.\nOf course, you're just saying that. Master Lu doesn't fancy men either, but Nangong Ji believed him. After all, the price of being stubborn is too high for him to bear.

You know that Nangong Ji is a clever person, so you can't extract information from him using ordinary means.
So he feigned surrender, glanced at his surroundings and diverted the conversation, thereby relaxing the other person's guard.
Seeing this foreign disciple talk so confidently about the future and not getting discouraged even when mocked, I can't help but change my opinion.
How could he not be someone who came from humble beginnings and was ambitious, hoping to rise above his station, only to fall short and thus give up?
Thinking of this, I couldn't help breaking out in a cold sweat: If he bets on this, and Tang Clan really slashes him with a knife, then Nangong Ji will forever be just an unknown minor figure‑no one will care about the name of that Nangong family retainer.
Immediately, I understood that your words were all a gentle and persuasive approach, intended to awaken him. His resentment towards you has dissipated, replaced by gratitude, causing him to confess voluntarily.
It's unavoidable; in the end, we'll still have to ask the Second Senior Brother to personally step in.
Seeing his rascal‑like appearance, I was so furious that my anger rose from nowhere, and I only wished I could stab this scoundrel with a knife.
You heaved a long sigh and left it at that. Having tried to persuade, you can at least console yourself with no regret.\nWhether he lives or dies is none of your business.

\nThe Nangong family's studies are based on Confucianism, emphasizing the cultivation of one's mind and nature, with self‑restraint as the foundation.\nYou've said all the good and bad things you could say, but when he's at a loss for words, he simply chooses to ignore it. Not a single word sinks in.

In your first torture session, you only thought that hitting hard enough would force anyone to talk. You didn't consider the severity of your actions and ended up killing Nangong Ji outright.
Fortunately, the alchemy room was just above in the basement tower. Second Senior Brother came running upon hearing the commotion and managed to provide timely rescue.
They managed to save Nangong Ji's life
He survived a near‑death experience and finally believes that the Tang Clan lives up to its reputation. When he goes all out, he doesn't spare even his closest relatives.
He truly could not disregard the bonds of family and friendship to strike him down. He couldn't afford to be so stubborn anymore; he confessed honestly.

He knows how to create a false impression, and so do you.
The sword kept jabbing at their vital point over and over, hoping to strike a fatal blow before trying to revive them.
Nangong Ji isn't a wooden stake; how could he willingly let you stick him? Seeing that you didn't greet him and kept hitting his vital points himself, he finally believed that the Tang Clan's reputation wasn't empty. When they get serious, they don't recognize their own kin, and can truly disregard their lifelong friendships to strike with lethal force. No longer daring to be stubborn, he admitted the truth honestly.

Torture may seem simple, but merely beating someone senselessly is ineffective. There are intricacies to it. First and foremost, one must be ruthless and unafraid of drawing blood. They need to know how to apply the right amount of pressure, using both gentle and harsh methods. Without a heart of iron or stone, it's impossible.\nWell, in the end, it still needs to be Second Senior Brother who steps up himself. After all, no one is as cold‑blooded and without emotion as he is.

You have a good temper, are not easily provoked, and are meticulous in your work, but your intentions are not upright. A hundred kinds of harsh tortures and poisonous schemes brew in your mind; after filtering out those that would result in death or disability, the remaining methods are few.
You have a good temper and are not easily provoked. You are meticulous in your actions and upright in your intentions. Seeing you volunteer, your fellow senior brothers will say no more.

You have a good temper and are not easily provoked. You also handle things with great care. However, as a Tang Clan disciple, you're perhaps too soft‑hearted and benevolent. This time, when you volunteered to take on the task, even your fellow senior brothers were taken aback. Seeing your firm determination, they said no more.
If the Second Senior Brother had arrived just a moment later, Nangong Ji would have been handed over to you.

You have decent cultivation, can tolerate your temper, and aren't afraid of being provoked, but you don't think things through when you act. You just remember to torture, completely forgetting to ask. Once someone is handed over to you, you don't say a word and start beating them immediately, with no sense of restraint in your actions.

You volunteered to take on the task. As for you, your cultivation is still okay, you can bear your temper, but you act without thinking, and you're bad. From the start, you didn't intend to find out anything; you just wanted to fight. As soon as the senior brother left, you didn't say a word and started beating him, with no restraint at all.

You volunteered to take on the task, even if you couldn't figure out the reason, at least you could vent a little. Unfortunately, your intentions were easily discerned, and they didn't dare hand over the suspect to you. Otherwise, given your explosive temperament, someone might accidentally provoke you with some harsh words, leading to unforeseen consequences.\nWell, it's still necessary to have Second Senior Brother handle this personally.

\nNangong Ji presumed that the Tang Clan, considering their bond of fraternity with the Three Great Noble Families, wouldn't resort to killing him outright. Captured as he was, he relied on his proficient neigong to withstand torture and refused to disclose the mastermind behind the plot.\nYour fellow brothers took turns beating him, and their hands ached from the effort. Yet Nangong Ji only felt pain without injury, still smiling and joking around. Everyone was irritated inside but couldn't truly inflict the cold‑hearted punishments of the Tang Clan on him, which made them feel frustrated.

This night finally came to an end, and we didn't set out until after having breakfast the next day. We have finally arrived home.
You will report this incident to the Sect Leader. The Sect Leader stroked his beard and listened, but did not comment, continuing to say,:
The Ye siblings can stay or go as they please, but once someone is part of the Tang Clan, no one in the world can touch them without permission.
Even if the Emperor of Dali were to personally come, this still counts.

Worry lingers like a tangled thread, making it hard to sleep tonight. Might as well go out for a walk. The night market is brightly lit, but you seem to avoid the light as if fearing it might burn you. You step into the dim alley, where an old, dilapidated temple stands in cold desolation.
Behind him, footsteps sounded not far nor near, quick and tense.
Don't underestimate this Miss's chaotic behavior; she follows her family's bloodline and is naturally deeply emotional and loyal. Since you call her brother, how could you bear to see her alone in the darkness, disappearing without a trace?
So she was clearly afraid, yet she still gritted her teeth and followed closely.
When you stormed off in a huff, she couldn't find you, but at least this time they can prevent future problems.
This dark and cold place is not where she should be, nor does it belong to you. She will be responsible for taking you home.

Close his eyes, and the cold faces of his fellow junior brothers from the same sect immediately flashed before his mind.\nEven a traitor, personally executing a fellow disciple is still a cruel thing. Everyone wants to live better; haven't you ever tried running away from home either?
Washed away the residual bloodstains and dust, but couldn't wash away the sensation of killing a fellow disciple with one's own hands.

After traveling another few miles, they had reached the foot of Meishan. Although their pace was slow, they were both physically and mentally exhausted.\nThe sun was setting in the west, and it was already too late to head up the mountain. They could only spend the night at a guesthouse in town first.

You worked together to defeat the traitors, deliberately showing mercy and not harming their lives, waiting for Second Senior Brother's judgment. However, those people had no intention of living.
Four people went off arm‑in‑arm, leaving only two to return. You kept silent, and the others didn't ask either.
The entire journey was silent except for the steady clip‑clop of hooves.

They returned home first, vanishing from sight. Your hearts sank with every passing day as you waited anxiously, and now the road ahead holds only unforeseen dangers, with a poor chance of survival.
Unexpectedly, we can meet again now, and I am overjoyed.
They were happy but also showed strange expressions, hesitating to speak. They pulled you and your senior brother aside to whisper, revealing that they had long harbored resentment towards the Tang Clan.
Thought he would be able to dominate both the black and white societies after joining the Tang Clan, exuding prestige everywhere he went; little did he expect that the Sect Leader would be a sickly tiger; the Senior Brother would be lazy and indifferent; the Second Senior Brother would be harsh and cruel; the Third Senior Brother would be weak and easily bullied; and the Fourth Senior Brother would be greedier than ever.
Witness the winds and rains of the Jianghu; martial artists from across the land converge on Jiangling to resist the Mud Cult's Beast Path. Even the Nangong family, a prominent clan, cannot ensure their safety, suffering heavy casualties. The Six Sects are in peril.
How can the Tang Clan, already dwindling in numbers, manage to keep itself untainted? Struggling to secure its own survival, the Sect Leader persists in his lone course, shielding the Ye siblings, this troublesome liability.
If the Tang Clan really coveted treasure, it would indeed be justified for people to despise them. However, the reality is different; in the end, they gained nothing but became the target of public criticism wherever they went.
They volunteered to go to Qingcheng this time with the intention of never returning after leaving Tang Clan. They were further bought over by Duan Zhixiu's generous offer and had only one condition: Don't return to the Tang Clan, could not have hit the mark better.
So you've been waiting in vain for a response‑there's a reason for that.
According to the rules of the Wulin, accepting bribes from an enemy sect and betraying one's own sect to an unfair extent is a grave taboo. Such traitors are universally reviled and should avoid it at all costs.
But after they spent the money frivolously for a few days, they inexplicably returned to their hometown and wandered around Meishan.
Seeing you all safely return is truly a mix of emotions‑both a relief and fear that you might seek retribution and report us to the Executioner for punishment. We exchanged glances and decided to buy your silence.
As long as you become accomplices and share the blame, they won't be considered thoroughly evil, right?
These words came from the depths of his heart, and both you and Senior Brother couldn't help but be moved.
Who doesn't want to be a great hero in the Jianghu? But here, none of us are cut out for it, and we all know it.
To die without a name is the same as just being a disciple of the Tang Clan‑what hope does life have left?
But if one were to toughen up and face reality, taking Ye Yunshang would ensure prosperity for countless lifetimes. Would that not be splendid?
If one does not act for oneself, heaven and earth will bring about their destruction. Their choice may be unemotional, but it makes sense. Without morality, at least there's money!
Everyone is a co‑conspirator; none of us are any more noble. We can still live together as we did in the old days, eating meals, drinking alcohol, and using the outhouse, laughing loudly.
But that future destined never to be realized, the pride of the Tang Clan, does not grow only on those with status and influence.
So what if you call me a 'disciple of the Tang Clan'? As a member of the Tang family, not one of you is not immensely proud.

After fending off the angry forest animals, the helpers finally arrived.\nYou couldn't help but burst into great joy as you focused your gaze: Are they not the fellow Senior Brothers who returned home earlier to summon reinforcements and subsequently went missing one after another?

That Daoist nun calls herself WOOD IMMORTAL. She has developed her own school of martial arts and her neigong cultivation is quite formidable. She excels at listening to sounds to determine positions and has studied many famous people's hidden weapons. Originally, she thought capturing you, a mere novice, would be an easy task, but unexpectedly, you have reinforcements arriving.
You couldn't help but be overjoyed as you focused your gaze: Aren't they the fellow Senior Brothers who returned home to get reinforcements and subsequently went missing one after another?
Immediately, their willpower surged, and they threw themselves into the battle with full force. Wood Immortal Nu had grown concerned that if the fight continued, she might not be able to retreat unharmed either. After inquiring about their names, she intended to flee using her qinggong.
Fortunately, Tang Fang spoke up at the right moment and called Yunshang out to explain, thus resolving the misunderstanding.
Mu Xiuju knew she was in the wrong, but considering her opponent to be a senior master, she couldn't bring herself to apologize. Taking advantage of your momentary relaxation, she suddenly spoke and threw a medicinal pill into your mouth, making her intention abundantly clear: You've accepted her gift, so don't go spreading slander about her elsewhere and damaging her reputation.

That Taoist nun refers to herself as Mu Xianju. Her martial arts have formed their own school, and her neigong cultivation is quite formidable. She excels at identifying positions through sound and has studied various masters' hidden weapons. Believing that capturing you would be a piece of cake, she did not expect your offensive to be as fierce as fire. You caught her off guard with your sudden attack.
Swinging the dust whisk, they used a circular force to intercept your attack. Reluctantly, she leaped back several feet. Today's encounter won't go well for you, but she'll remember your name. She'll call on her fellow friends another day to face this old beast who pretends to be innocent and eats tigers.
You should quickly attack Senior Immortal Timewither. Not only did this astonish your senior brother, but even the Tang Clan disciples who hurriedly came to support were left speechless.
You couldn't help but feel amazed as you focused your gaze: Are these not the senior brothers who disappeared one after another while going to fetch reinforcements by returning home earlier?

The man is accompanied by a group of bandits who look fierce and menacing. It's clear they are outlaws from the Green Forest Bandits.
Supposedly, the Tang Clan is notorious, feared by both the law and outlaws. Ordinary greenwood heroes would go to great lengths to avoid encountering Tang Clan disciples.
But this gang of bandits has a significant connection to your Tang Clan. They have been poisoned by your Senior Brother more than once and their hatred for your clan can only be repaid with fresh blood.
The disparity between us and our opponents is simply too great. You and your senior brother found that feigning strength was ineffective, and were just about to turn and run when suddenly a savior descended from the heavens. Upon closer inspection, you couldn't help but feel overjoyed: Aren't they exactly the senior brothers and fellow brothers who returned home earlier to call for reinforcements, only to disappear one after another?
Although we are still outnumbered, when your numbers are off, things can feel balanced even when you're fighting four against twelve.
First, the difference in martial arts skill was indeed significant. Second, the bandits were intimidated by Senior Brother and lost interest in fighting. After realizing the bones they faced would be tough to crack, the leader shouted wind's up, hit the road and they vanished without a trace.

The parrot was raised by mountain bandits, and through constant exposure, it learned nothing but bad words.\nHaving grown accustomed to the malice and harm from humans, hating them to the core, I swear we will never live under the same sky. I see passersby as targets for my wild boars to charge at and slaughter. You are next!
The one who blocks the way is not a person, but a parrot that can speak human language, driving a wild boar!

The roadblock isn't a person but a strange bird that can speak human language and is riding a wild boar!\nYou are ignorant and unaware of what a parrot is; you only think you have encountered a monster, which has made your faces pale with fright.

That nun has extremely sharp senses, able to discern one's origin through scents and smells. She detected the metallic and medicinal scent from your bodies and noted your activities in Sichuan, so there can be no doubt that you are disciples of the Tang Clan.\nHowever, among the numerous Tang Clan disciples, there was a subtle scent of feminine rouge that stood out awkwardly. The thought barely formed and immediately clarity dawned: It must be your group of villains kidnapping virtuous women!\nSince she witnessed such evil deeds, of course she couldn't sit idly by.
You've never met her before; when she opens her mouth, she's intimidating, making them feel very uncomfortable. They speak naturally, not worrying about hierarchy.
You dared not be remiss, so you hurriedly bowed with clasped hands, but your politeness didn't earn a favorable response.
The visitor was a blind Daoist nun with an ethereal demeanor, around thirty or forty years old, exuding the grace of a reclusive sage.

The narrow path was rugged and uneven, and Ye Yunshang, weakened by illness and frail in body, could not endure it. Thus, the carriage moved stop‑and‑go.
Everyone was anxious in their hearts and ultimately refused to call out to hurry them along. You see, the small path is not as wide and safe as the main road; bandits and wild animals often appear, making it very dangerous.
As expected, just after I finished ranting, a roadblock jumped out by the roadside.
You siblings chatted and laughed until Ye Yunshang was too tired to keep their eyes open, yawning repeatedly, only then were you urged to get on the car and sleep.
No need to mention it; deep down, you're completely in love with this lively and mischievous little sister. Even a treasure worth a thousand pieces of gold can't match her radiant smile.

You're not truly curious about the whereabouts of the treasure; rather, you are very concerned about it. But even if the treasure is valuable, it doesn't belong to you to salivate over.\nThe Tang Clan has strict family rules, and the Sect Leader's administration is impartial like iron. Under the guidance of the Sect Leader's edicts, who dares to speak out of turn? Fourth Senior Brother is the example!

You're not really that curious about the treasure's whereabouts; it's just that a gentleman loves wealth and acquires it in a proper manner.\nEven if General Yue left behind treasures, they would still be righteous wealth to save the country. Besides, acts of bravery and righteousness are what xi shi inherently embody. Whether or not she and her siblings are related to him, you would still not regret offering help.

Discussing the Yue Wang Treasure, Ye Yunshang spoke with careful caution and a hint of jest, though in reality, she was deeply uneasy.\nSince they got to know each other, she has become increasingly reliant on you, fearing that one day you might turn out like Duan Zhixiu, becoming selfish and unrecognizable.

Midnight, the clouds churned restlessly, unable to sleep, endless loneliness swept in, unable to wake Tang Fang, rolling up the curtain to see you sitting alone by the fire, a thought struck, dressed in moonlight, chatting with you side by side.

Those who say bad things about you often just brush it off with a smile; when it comes to discussions about the Tang Clan, if they don't offend anyone, people might just furrow their brows in disapproval.\nFacing you directly with false accusations about Ye Yunshang, yet how can I expect you to bear it silently! Even with good cultivation of one's character, you still have some pride.  Falsely accusing you of something about Ye Yunshang and expecting you to take it without a word? Even if your character cultivation is good, you still have some sense of dignity. If not for the greater good, you would desperately wish to tear the liar's mouth apart and reduce them to ashes.

Unfortunately, you can't approach to argue about it; it's obvious that any explanation would just create more trouble and expose your presence.\nI must endure and keep quiet to suffer this humiliation silently.

You can't defend yourself in this, but it pains you to not speak up. You can't just kill everyone.\nYou did make the move, but you're still not out of danger yourself. It's best to avoid stirring up more trouble and just bear it for now.

She went to gather herbs to settle and stop the vomiting for Ye Yunshang.
To watch over Ye Yunshang, unable to withstand her persistent pleas, he could only take her for a walk to the front tea shop. However, he overheard the guests inside discussing rumors about the Ye family.
The person who spread these rumors is insistent and convincing, swearing with great confidence that they witnessed it themselves. They claim to have seen Ye Yunshang's bare back as the location where the Yue Wang treasure map is hidden.
How comical it is that even Ye Yunshang herself cannot recognize him.

They did not dare to linger along the way and urged their horses to hurry. To prevent him from suddenly waking up, Ye Yunshang dispatched someone ahead to set fires on the road and forge their trail. This way, Duan Zhixiu would always believe that he was just one step away from success and continue pursuing them until the ends of the earth.
Even if he could cultivate his heart and temper his nature, sending men to pursue first and then rushing after them once the Qingcheng sacrifice concludes would still result in him falling into the trap.
No one would mistakenly blame him; he would first catch up to your group before meeting up with his own troops. Afterwards, he was brutally beaten and captured by your group, only to be taken to the Tang Clan.
This plan is fine in every way, except that it will still be a bit embarrassing for you. After all, you naturally attract harsh treatment; there's no one else in the world who would make as good a target. As for taking the hits, who else but you?
Ye Yunshang didn't say anything, but she was actually a bit uneasy about it. She feared he might accidentally get injured and specially sewed cowhide at the vital points in his uniform.
You're really bold. Except for the sect leader and Second Senior Brother, you dare to retort back at anyone who opens their mouth, not the least bit afraid, snapping back with a cutting remark.

You show no fear at all, your tongue is restless, and as soon as you open your mouth, you have nothing but harsh words. These monks are especially particular about cultivation; even uttering coarse language makes them stammer. How can you possibly be their match? Before the fight even begins, they're almost driven to death by your words.

You're only getting nervous now. The Tang Clan Senior Brother or Sister who beat you didn't spare you any mercy, but they've never killed you before. But these people from Qingcheng are a different story.

You've done too many good deeds in Qingcheng, and many people have been watching you with ill intent. Though their intentions differ from yours, they don't bother to compete with you. Now, at last, the opportunity has come to use the pretext of the segment exam martial arts display to resort to real violence. Everyone is bracing themselves, their eyes more poisonous than the poison in your pocket, their fists seeming ready to fly toward your face at any moment.

Qingcheng Zushi's birthday celebration is also an annual day for the Qingcheng School to test and compare their disciples' martial arts progress. Ten days before the event, messengers were sent to notify the local officials, announcing it through notices posted in public places. The mountain would be sealed off for three days, refusing visitors and worshippers.
Apart from those who have no choice but to shoulder responsibilities, all contemporary Qingcheng disciples gathered together.
After the morning bell rang on that day, a lineup and roll call were conducted in the wide square in front of Chang Feng Guan. Students took their seats according to their masters, and you, still somewhat confused, found yourself placed at the end of the line.

As she had anticipated, Duan Zhixiu could not withstand the provocation and, with a minor scheme, revealed the details himself. He admitted verbally that he was indeed the mastermind behind the collusion with bandits to raid the Tang Clan at night.
Sadly, she failed to account for Duan Zhixiu's behind‑the‑scenes mastermind, whose intricate schemes within schemes not only harmed Nangong Qingyu but also caused conflicts between the Tang Clan and Diancang. Even after such a long time, he was still able to use others as his knives, eliminating evidence.
Although there is no ironclad evidence to identify the culprit, fortunately, the Tang Clan has never needed evidence for their crimes.
As for who the mastermind behind the scenes is, we aren't in a hurry to uncover the truth right away.   The mastermind behind the scenes, we don't need to rush to uncover them immediately.
Wait until you all return safely and go home to report this to the Sect Leader. Then, kidnap Tang Zhixiu, the second senior brother can be tortured to know.   Translate: Wait until you all return safely and go home to report this to the Sect Master. Then, kidnap Duan Zhixiu and have Second Senior Brother subject him to severe interrogation to find out.
The next morning, the injuries from the previous day seemed like a dream to Ye Yunshang, who was now recovering with renewed vigor.\nShe immediately gathered her followers and held a secret meeting.

The next morning, after the injuries from the previous day seemed like a dream, Ye Yunshang appeared vibrant and well‑recovered. She pushed open the door and rushed in, only to find you dozing on the steps. Unprepared for this sudden turn of events, she leaped onto your back, biting hard into your shoulder. You barely avoided losing a piece of skin.\nYou originally feared that she might be hungry and thirsty at midnight, calling out but receiving no answer from heaven or earth. You spent the entire night guarding outside the gate, seeing her improve with a rosy‑cheeked appearance, you were immensely pleased and no longer cared about your shoulder injuries.\nYunshang saw Qiong Cai's pale and haggard appearance, even more unattractive than usual, and was moved beyond words.

The poison that had struck her was a variation of the Immortal Fragrance from the Beyond. The person who used the poison was highly skilled in their craft and anticipated that Tang Clan disciples could counter this particular toxin. Therefore, they set an additional trap by substituting one ingredient in the formula, making the nature of the immortal fragrance ambiguous. Tang Fang, driven by a desire to save someone's life, failed to notice this substitution at first and used a method known as fight poison with poison. However, this only made the toxicity even more intense.
Unless the person who used poison is caught and we can obtain the formula to counter it, there's no solution to this predicament. Even if Zou Bo's neigong is profound, it will eventually run out. The toxic blood will invade the heart meridian, and the little miss will perish.
Tang Fang had no other choice but to take a risky approach, unwillingly causing self‑harm and damage to herself as she performed the forbidden technique《North Dipper Needle》. She manipulated her lifeforce by accelerating the flow of qi and blood within Yunshang's body, transforming herself into North Dipper to guide yang energy deeper in and expel yin energy outward, taking the brunt of the peril on herself, thus managing to stabilize the situation.
Such a benevolent heart is still doubted by others, who say things like Don't exaggerate, and It's not that serious.
How can there be a doctor who has devoted their life to medicine and still feels discouraged after hearing this!

Tang Fang wiped sweat and pushed the door open. You and Duan Zhixiu immediately surrounded her from both sides, showing concern for her condition.
She had used all the knowledge she had accumulated in her lifetime, leaving her utterly exhausted. Yet Duan Zhixiu kept interjecting with phrases like You mustn't spread alarmist tales, and Could it possibly be that serious? He pontificated without understanding, trying to dictate as if he knew everything. Can there truly be any doctor who has devoted their heart and soul to studying the ways of medicine that could endure such absurdities?
Tang Fang immediately erupted with a thunderous rage, cursing vehemently without regard for her image. Duan Zhixiu was taken aback and about to protest when a slap across the face hit him, shocking and infuriating him simultaneously, though he couldn't help feeling a bit timid. Knowing that Yunshang's life was worry‑free, he calmed his mind and fled.
You've never seen Tang Fang get so angry before, and you can't help but secretly whistle in admiration.
Inquired in detail about Yunshang's condition, Tang Fang recounted everything in a soothing tone.

So you tricked him into believing that you are a distant relative of the Zhao clan from the Great Song dynasty.\nDuan Zhixiu shook his entire body. He was about to dismiss the idea, but a doubt had already arisen in his heart. The more he thought about it, the more reasonable it seemed. With this explanation, everything now made sense: The Ye family is full of loyal patriots, so it's no wonder she favors you if you are a royal relative of the Great Song dynasty!

The things Duan Zhixiu wants to ask you are as numerous as mountains.
First and foremost, I must ask who the honored guest claims to be.
From what he knows, Ye Yunshang appears to be a indiscriminate villain who harms everyone. In reality, upon closer examination, there are still distinctions in how she treats people.
Calling you my brother while entangling you to such an extent is rather uncommon.
What exactly do you rely on to win her favor? Among all the coincidences in recent days, what is most bewildering and hard to let go of is this.

\nWhen asked about the mastermind behind it, Duan Zhixiu hesitated to speak. He considered himself above others and could treat senior figures in the Jianghu with respect, but he could not tolerate his dignity being trampled upon. How could he bear to be set up and used by someone else?\nThey insisted on settling this worthless debt personally and absolutely forbade the Tang Clan from interfering. Thus, they were willing to use their family's secret treatise as compensation just to keep silent about it.

But you endured the torment from Second Senior Brother at home, gaining deep insight into using poison. With narrowed eyes, you scrutinized it meticulously and immediately detected the pattern.
Duan Zhixiu's words are not false. The letter once contained writing, but it was written with a special poison ink. As time passed, the ink gradually faded and merged with the paper and silk pouch, becoming part of what is now known as the Poison Fragrance.
The planner's methods are not only sophisticated but also astonishingly malicious.
Poor Duan Zhixiu was unaware that he had been manipulated by others. Now, even if he wants to clear his name, there is no evidence.

\nYou asked Duan Zhixiu for a lucky draw slip and brought it close to your nose to smell it. Sure enough, you detected a faint fragrance similar to that burned in the Zhengxin Hall. This letter has undoubtedly passed through someone from the Tang Clan's hands.\nNow that the poison incense has diffused, it is not strong enough to cause death. It merely amounts to a piece of white paper.

Both grew increasingly frustrated, wishing to settle their differences with a fight to the death, but Yunshang's fate remained uncertain, so they never dared to be far apart.\nStaring won't make him give in, so he suggested exchanging information. You ask one question, and he asks one in return, to ensure fairness.

You and Duan Zhixiu looked at each other with mutual disdain, harboring both public grievances and private grudges. Before Zou Bo could finish warning you not to cause a commotion, you couldn't contain yourselves and started fighting.\nZou Bo hadn't walked far. Hearing the sound, he turned around and was furious. He quickly stepped forward, using one palm to push past someone and scolded them harshly. Only then did the two opponents become a little more compliant.
He immediately felt his hands go weak, was pushed by you with disdain, tumbled back a few steps, and nearly lost his balance.
Now it's your turn to be restless; you immediately retaliate with force, countering his attack. If it weren't for Master Zou's intervention, you could have killed him on the spot.

Fortunately, she is at Qingcheng. Sect Leader Zou used the orthodox neigong of the Daoist sect to protect her heart meridians temporarily, and urgently sent disciples down the mountain to summon Tang Fang for emergency treatment.
Zou Bo stepped outside with an unusually grave expression. Known for his straightforward nature, he spoke his mind without reservation: Ye Yunshang suddenly fell ill because she was poisoned by the Tang Clan's unique poison, Pinyin: Bi'an Xianxiang.
Upon hearing the words, Duan Zhixiu's self‑blame and anxiety turned into anger. He grabbed your collar, wishing he had been harsher and killed you sooner.
Zou Bo continued, stating that this scent medium was not something else; it was the blank amulet that Duan Zhixiu had personally handed to Yunshang.

Duan Zhixiu thought she was weak and easy to exploit, but little did she know she was being manipulated from the very beginning.
Knowing what Young Lord Duan cares about, they deliberately stepped on the pain. By the end, their words sounded as if weeping, but aside from her, who truly understood how much sincerity was hidden in those words?
Duan Zhixiu was left speechless and humiliated. His elegant bearing had completely disappeared, and his defenses crumbled as he recounted in detail how he conspired with bandits to raid the Tang Clan at night. He then handed over a sachet of perfume to Yunshang.
He felt he had poured out his heart and soul, but when Yunshang took out the divination slip from the sachet, her face was still filled with doubt. The slip contained no words, only a faint scent of flowers remained.
Yan Hong's blood flowed out of her nostrils without her knowing, and Yunshang fell back with her head in the air.

Yue Yunshang was unwilling to be passively controlled by others and could not sit idly by while someone else suffered without taking any action. After hesitation for several days, she mustered the courage to deliberately put herself in a vulnerable position as bait. Sure enough, Duan Zhixiu immediately bit the hook, offering gifts and smiling to beg for forgiveness. Yunshang kept a defiant expression on her face, pretending not to notice.
Although they are now at odds, she and her siblings share a deep bond with Duan Zhixiu from their days as fellow disciples of Qingcheng. Duan Zhixiu believes that the girl is easy to persuade, and there may still be a chance to restore their former friendship. Thus, he persists in entangling himself without giving up.
Little did they know that Ye Yunshang even kept her composed and flirtatious expression as a facade. If not for her brother's example setting, she would never have taken such risks by aligning herself with the Tang Clan and Mu Ling, or involving herself without any backing.

She detailed the connection between her siblings and Duan Zhixiu to you. Only then did you realize that this person was the one who spread rumors about the treasure, causing the Ye siblings to have no choice but to rebel against Diancang and become homeless.
Duan Zhixiu has a request regarding Qingcheng, so he is unlikely to act rashly and provoke any incidents.
Then we might as well negotiate for now and ask someone to seek help from the Tang Clan. We can turn hostile once reinforcements arrive.

Duan Zhixiu made a bold appearance in Qingcheng, clearly having come prepared. He likely has set up a web of traps and ambushes. If you panic and flee hastily, wouldn't that reveal your guilt?\nConversely, if you remain at Qingcheng, you will always be guests. Even without considering how Sect Leader Zou would uphold righteous dignity and not tolerate Duan Zhixiu's unbridled actions, the entire sect has to consider its reputation in the Jianghu. They would not easily believe one‑sided claims and offend the Tang Clan.

Back to your room, you couldn't help feeling angry and frustrated. You hadn't expected Qingcheng to judge people by their appearance either; Ye Yunshang was similarly lost in thought. It took several calls for you to snap out of it.\nYou have never seen her so flustered before. This surprised him, and he steadied his mind to analyze the situation.
Returning to the room, you were still fuming, never expecting Qingcheng to be so judgmental based on appearances.

Returning to the room, you remained anxious and restless, fearing that lingering any longer would bring great calamity upon you. You paced back and forth, and Ye Yunshang, seeing you as useless, had to force himself to calm down and analyze the situation.

Duan Zhixiu turned the accusation around. He relied on the Diancang to back him up, and he could appeal to ascend to the Duan Family in Dali. You are accusing him without substantial evidence, which is an insult to his character and tarnishes his reputation. As a person of the Jianghu, as a swordsman, and as a member of the Duan clan, maintaining one's honor is perfectly acceptable. Even if I were to draw my sword and kill you, no one could blame me!
The Daoist with the Iron‑Crowned Hair heard this and promptly tried to defend Duan Zhixiu, shouting for someone to apprehend you.
Just as he was about to draw his sword and act, Duan Zhixiu shouted to stop once again, insisting repeatedly that: A man is not a sage; who can be without fault? Everyone should have the opportunity to correct their mistakes and start anew.
No one could have anticipated these words, yet he seemed to take them very seriously, demonstrating his broad and generous heart.
But he simply had a soft gaze and was smiling at Ye Yunshang, but his smile made others feel queasy.
The Iron Crown Daoist would not believe it themselves.
The Iron Crown Daoist won't believe, and Shentu Long himself won't believe either.

You recounted the incident where Duan Zhixiu gathered robbers to attack your hut at night and falsely accused Tang Clan of it. However, Duan Zhixiu denied everything, insisting that you were spreading rumors to frame him.
You're absolutely fuming, and without iron‑clad evidence, there's really nothing you can do for now.
Even if we capture the accomplice Nangong Ji, it would merely be your one‑sided account. Even if you bring all the leaders of several robber gangs to Qingcheng and confront them with him, it would still be in vain. After all, Tang Clan has a long history of misconduct, and there have been many villains from your clan who plotted against the Wulin in the past. Torturing someone into confessing guilt or framing innocent people‑these are your elders' specialty moves.
By ordinary standards, who would believe your humble words over those of this handsomely dressed and noble‑born prince from the Dali House of Duan?

Though he had injured his dominant hand, he was still a renowned expert from the Diancang School, with exceptional eyesight. Moreover, the two factions were long‑term enemies who had each put in great effort to decipher their opponent's techniques. Your fatal strikes completely missed their mark; instead of hitting any vital points, your punches and kicks only caused him to be shaken by his neigong, leaving him reeling.\nOne appeared serene and composed, while the other was in shambles. Which one has higher martial arts proficiency is evident at a glance.

It was Duan Zhixiu, who ended up taking the beating, who urged you. He didn't even consider you worthy of his attention; he didn't blame you for being difficult, only himself for being overconfident. One‑handed, he was evenly matched with you. If he let his superiors intervene, his reputation would be ruined.
Shentu Long won't offend their own senior brother for you, so they watch from the sidelines coldly.
Even with Shentu Long advising from the side, they still hadn't cooled down.

Diancang and Tang Clan are long‑standing rivals, both having put in great effort to decipher each other's techniques. They know each other's moves more or less, but your attacks often defy expectations. Within ten moves, nine out of them do not follow conventional rules. Duan Zhixiu focused solely on guarding against your small sword and hidden weapons, but found it difficult to defend against your punches, kicks, and headbutts, consecutively falling into your traps and losing all sense of dignity.\nYou were equally astonished by the opponent's neigong cultivation; each punch and kick struck him without causing any pain or itchiness, yet the force rebounded with an unusually great impact.\nThe Iron Crown Daoist saw his disciple bring shame upon himself and became enraged. He was not afraid of people criticizing Qingcheng for bullying the smaller party and intended to intervene to discipline him.

In the end, it was Duan Zhixiu, who was on the receiving end of the beating, who spoke up to advise. They didn't regard you at all; it wasn't your tenacity they resented, but their own arrogance. Engaging you with one hand and losing the match left them with nothing to say. If they allowed their mentor to intervene and protect them again, their reputation would be in tatters.
Shentu Long wouldn't offend his own senior brother for you, watching from the sidelines, as natural as anything.
Even with Shentu Long advising from the side, they still hadn't cooled down.

\nThe Diancang Tang Clan are long‑standing rivals, each having put in considerable effort to decipher the other's moves. They both have a fair idea of what the other might do, but your attacks often seem off‑kilter, deviating from expected patterns within the first ten moves. Duan Zhixiu was secretly impressed by this, as you concealed an elbow strike in your armpit and delivered a kicks that sent him reeling backward.\nThe Iron Crown Daoist saw his disciple at a disadvantage and, overcome by anger and shame, decided not to fear public disapproval of Qingcheng for using its power against the weaker. He was prepared to intervene and rectify the situation.
When enemies meet, their eyes are red with fury, but with the Qingcheng elder present, you can't act rashly, lest you give someone grounds for accusation.

Enemies meeting face to face turn one's eyes particularly red with anger. Without thinking much else, you draw out your small sword and move in to fight, at least managing to land a few punches before someone stops you.\nDuan Zhixiu remained completely unperturbed. Although he was injured on his frequently used right hand, he relied on his deep‑rooted family legacy and completely ignored you at all. Switching hands, he wielded the sword to block your Tang Clan's advanced techniques.

The thunder faded away, and Ye Yunshang couldn't wait to drag you out for a countryside stroll. By chance, they bumped into Iron Crown Daoist and his newly admitted disciple. You immediately recognized this person as the mastermind behind the pseudonym Nangong Xiu in the dilapidated temple.\nIt's not surprising that you recognize him. What is surprising is that Yunshang also recognizes him; with a single word, she revealed his true identity: Duan Zhixiu, the Young Master of the Pine Smoke Pavilion under Diancang.

Master Zou, who returned from Jiangling, remained melancholic and uncheered. Originally, he intended to emulate Kongtong's grand trial by extensively organizing the Qingcheng Dan Examination, encouraging exchanges among disciples of various sects, in order to boost support for Master Nangong's righteous deed. Unfortunately, fate was not favorable, and the Jianghu winds were continuously stormy, bringing one tragic news after another.
Jiangling is besieged, and the Old Master has perished. Now, in the Jianghu, various sects not only cannot reconcile their differences but are also on high alert for themselves. Zou Bo no longer had any interest in organizing a grand martial arts competition, so he consulted with the elders of his sect. As a result, Tan Kao was scheduled to proceed as planned, with each sect still assessing their disciples according to the old system. Only two favored disciples from each elder would participate in the trials to determine their responsibilities and compete for the flower bomb.
Huaisu suggested that although the two Daoists were in competition with each other and had no mutual discord, knowing that the battle at Jiangling did not go as well as hoped, not only did the Sect Leader have a worried expression, but even the eleventh‑generation disciples were demoralized. It was indeed inappropriate to mobilize a large group of people for this reason. Therefore, he proposed his agreement.
Shentu Long is also one of the Tenth Generation Elders, but he is too young for his position to gain widespread approval. Moreover, his heart is not in this matter. In theory, this matter should be resolved with just three people's agreement.
Little did they think that after a dozen years of seclusion in the Old Lord's Pavilion, practicing and avoiding the world as Iron Crown Daoist would emerge at this time.
He may not compare to Zou Bo in terms of position as Sect Leader, nor can his martial arts skills match Huaisu. He is also not envious of the two junior disciples. However, when it comes to seniority, there is no one in current Qingcheng Sect longer than Iron Crown Daoist.
A few decades ago, he was already known for acting superior just because of his age. After closing himself away for a dozen years or so, he still behaved in a sly and capricious manner. Furthermore, he sent one of his newly admitted disciples to participate in the sparring match, clearly wanting to have a say in it.
It might not have been a problem, but the difficulty lies in the fact that his disciples are those who join a master while bringing their own skills. Before entering Qingcheng, he was already a person of importance. Not only did he hold the position of Pavilion Master in the Diancang sect, but he was also a descendant of the royal family of the Dali Sang family. The uniqueness of his identity is beyond doubt.

Qingcheng Zou Sect Leader returned triumphantly from Jiangling with Shentu Long at the forefront. The tenth‑generation Elders of Qingcheng led by their eleventh‑generation disciples rang the bells and beat the drums as they formed a procession to welcome him.
However, what Master Zou brought back was more than just good news.
The Great Battle of Jiangling saw the Central Plains righteous factions unite to combat the Beast Path, culminating in a complete victory for the righteous Wulin.
Beggar Sect's Li Fugui acted with great righteousness to quell familial betrayal, and finally, the Dharma King of the Beast Path, Wang Erzhuang, was executed.
The old faction of the Beggar Sect rose up, driving out the Mud Cult and returning to the path of the righteous in the Wulin.
Unfortunately, the situation took a sudden turn for the worse overnight, and events swiftly deteriorated.
First, Old Master Nangong seemed to have died from excessive worry.
And the Mud Cult took advantage of the righteous factions gathering in Jiangling, launching a sudden attack on the headquarters of various schools. Upon hearing this news, Zou Bo did not dare to linger and, after paying his respects to Nangong's family master, set off urgently, riding hard all the way.
Only now do you realize that the Tang Clan's nighttime assault case from that day still has a sequel, and the matter is far more complex than it seems. It's not that others were intentionally keeping it from you; rather, you had been unconscious for too long, and by the time you woke up, no one was showing much interest in the case anymore.
Qilai and the senior brothers and sisters from Qingcheng have already explained the situation to Shentu Long and the other Qingcheng elders. However, the truth has yet to be fully revealed, so it's hard for people to believe just based on the Tang Clan's one‑sided account. Considering that the Nangong Family and the Tang Clan have always been good relations, and the consecutive bad news has already caused a significant loss of Vitality to the Nangong Family, as fellow clansmen, it's better to be overly cautious rather than take any risks.

Tang Fang saw you focusing intently and examined your complexion with some surprise. She seemed to be testing you.
You bypassed the reasoning and directly hit the core of the issue, but with such deep‑seated problems, how to treat them cannot be explained clearly.
Studying medicine is different from pursuing the arts; unlike in martial training, which emphasizes natural talent, it places greater importance on memory, attention to detail, experience, and hard work.
She entered the monastery since childhood and was guided by Second Senior Brother. Although they are referred to as brother and sister, their relationship is more akin to that of a teacher and student.
Those countless sleepless nights studying the intricacies of medicine, she knew all too well just how challenging it was. You have diagnosed to this point through your own merit; there is not an ounce of luck involved.
I can't help but develop a sense of respect for you. She passed down her secret techniques to your senior brother, who then transmitted them to you.
Not for any other reason, but so that if she and Second Senior Brother are no longer with us someday, there will still be you for the Tang Clan.

If it weren't for Second Senior Brother's prior diagnosis, you'd probably be confused and unable to make sense of things. The deeper you delve into the medical arts, the more self‑aware you become. Once you understand the vastness of heaven and earth, even the most arrogant person would hold back a bit.

Regardless of whether a doctor encounters complex and difficult‑to‑diagnose conditions, they are bound to feel curious. Given that you are genuinely concerned, why don't you take a pulse on Ye Yunshang to see if you can find any clues?
Her pulse was steady but not in optimal condition; she wasn't severely ill, but this merely indicated outward calm while concealing underlying turmoil.
When you send your True Qi into Yunshang's body, it seems to be like a clay ox entering the sea‑it dissipates instantly and can neither be pushed nor retrieved. This is not a common occurrence.
To know how lifeforce flows through the hundred veins of the human body, there must be traces to follow. Even if one's meridians are blocked, this rule does not apply unless the heart has completely stopped beating.
You exhale your energy towards the lake, and there should be at least some ripples; towards a stone, you should feel the recoil. Even if the target is an expert in neigong who deliberately channels their energy to resist, you should sense some resistance. There's no reason for this true qi to vanish halfway through its journey.

Her pulse was steady but not particularly healthy; there were no major issues. However, this merely indicated a calm surface, while underneath, hidden dangers lurked.
If not for Second Senior Brother's reminder, you would likely have been misled by appearances and made a wrong diagnosis.
Tang Fang felt slightly surprised but did not let it worry her. After all, Ye Yunshang belonged to a rare condition; ordinary doctors couldn't diagnose the reason behind her illness, and that was no rarity.
So, they no longer paid attention and followed Ye Yunshang with the needle.
Any physician encountering a complex and difficult condition would inevitably feel curious, especially since you were genuinely concerned, so you took Ye Yunshang's pulse.

Whenever a medical practitioner encounters a difficult case, curiosity is inevitable. After a meal, with nothing else to do, you might as well take Ye Yunshang's pulse. Even if you can't discern anything, the chance to openly examine her delicate wrist is rare.

Upon entering the door, Tang Fang saw Yunshang holding your wrist and had a lecherous expression on their face, convinced that you were harassing someone. Without hesitation, they launched an arrow at you.\nEver since you focused on Ye Yunshang, and unexpectedly, your senior sister decided to attack you with poison on the spot using Soft Muscle Powder from the dart, you were knocked out cold. You found yourself disoriented when you woke up the next day.\nThe room was still in disarray, and those two really did flee the scene, showing no intention of cleaning up.
After dinner, there was nothing to do, so you also learned to take a pulse, holding Ye Yunshang's pale, delicate wrist. Although you didn't understand the pulse, you couldn't help but care a bit.
Not to mention that you also hit someone's bottom earlier; now reflecting on it, it's even more delightful.

After dinner, there's nothing to do on either side. You've also learned to diagnose pulses, holding Ye Yunshang's pale, delicate wrist. Although you don't understand the pulse, just touching their small hand is nice. Usually, you haven't had the courage to do this before.

With the sun setting, you can't just watch the young miss go hungry. You'll have to go out and find her something to eat.\nThe Taoist from Qingcheng does not abstain from meat or fish; he always has vegetables and meat to eat. However, those who practice in seclusion only seek to satisfy their basic needs and do not indulge in food for pleasure. Thus, the dishes he cooks are never as delicious as those served at the town taverns.\nTo soothe her, you bought some rock sugar husks from the vendor selling snacks to pilgrims.

For other things, just give it a little nose tap and endure them.
But you can tolerate holding in your bowel and bladder, yet you cannot stand her faking an illness to trick your concern. Anger surged in his heart, and he grabbed her leg, delivering an unforgiving slap on her buttocks.
Following the societal norms and expectations, women should strictly adhere to propriety and emphasize chastity, considering steadfastness and purity as beautiful. Women should uphold chastity as a virtue, adhering to societal norms and propriety. They should prioritize chastity in their character while following proper behavior according to society's expectations. Although it is said that in the Jianghu world, one need not be bound by petty conventions, such ideas remain deeply ingrained. Despite your Little Demon Lord looking down on everything, she cannot escape this custom either.
She was after all a young and unmarried pure lady of the belle age, touched in such a manner by you; how could she not be ashamed and angry?
If it weren't for knowing that you have no ulterior motives and are only acting on concern, or considering your repeated lifesaving favors, she would weigh the pros and cons before saying anything to others. Without being reported to the authorities, you won't be able to hold your head up high in public either.
Shame begets shame, anger begets anger, but in order to protect your life and her honor, she decides to act dumb and foolish, putting an end to the joke.

\nOn this day, as usual, the embodiment of destruction stormed into your living quarters, singing a sweet but incomprehensible melody. Like a storm, it wreaked havoc inside the house.\nYour senior Sister Tang Fang also seems to have disappeared, and by the time Yunshang's appointed hour for acupuncture and medicine arrived, she still hadn't brought the person away.
