The elders of the Nangong family have all expressed their stance against supporting the Tang Clan. Nangong Shen couldn't go against the majority opinion, but he still considers you a friend. Whether you believe his justification or not, he still wants to do his part.

Shangguan Ying confides in you, sharing her deepest feelings. The sincerity worth more than a thousand taels of gold is carefully placed in your hands from this moment on. From now onwards, she will think only of you and will not let any doubts enter your heart. In front of the bustling crowd and in the presence of her former fiance, she adjusts your clothing with dignity, both to express her true feelings and because her own heart is pounding with joy and sweetness.\nFrom now on, I'll be responsible for you, hit you, and help you up. As for what others think, I don't really care about that much.\nNangong Shen watched from the side, feeling a surge of regret in his heart. But what could he say now that he had broken off the engagement with his own words?
Hearing his words, Brother Wei, the Sect Master of Kongtong, had also gone to the horse market to arrange mounts for the Tang Clan, but he couldn't outdo this person.

When you went out, Shangguan Ying was speaking with Nangong Shen. You didn't hear anything; just seeing the two of them together caused a pang in your heart. Shangguan Ying knew that you had misunderstood and felt both angry and amused. She gently but firmly tapped you on the shoulder and decisively stood by your side.\nOriginally, she had sent someone early in the morning to the neighboring town's horse market. Unfortunately, Nangong Shen had already acted first and secured all the horses yesterday, even hiring the carriage drivers. When Shangguan Ying tried to pay for them, he insisted on not accepting the money, which is why they were stuck outside in a standoff.

It was Nangong Shen, the newly appointed head of the Nangong family, who had prepared the horses for you. His father had just passed away, and grieving to the point of despair was not unreasonable. Yet this young lord possessed a resolute spirit, managing to hold back his tears and being attentive to every Jianghu friend, including the Tang Clan, without any oversight.

Just as they were about to step out of the inn, the waiter came to notify them that their horses and carriage were already ready.\nYou were taken aback by the words and had no choice but to follow him outside to see for yourself.
Pack your luggage and valuables, fill the gourd with water, and buy some emergency dry rations for the trip, then set off on your way home.

You heard a mix of emotions, and you're unsure how to feel about it.\nIsn't this the wandering Jianghu you've dreamed of for countless nights and daydreamed about becoming? But he is ultimately not you.
You heard this, and it's truly a whirlwind of conflicting emotions‑surprised and then couldn't help but laugh, a touch of jealousy, yet also felt a sense of contentment.
Such unparalleled achievements naturally made them the consensus choice as the Leader of the Wulin Alliance, with no one showing any dissent.
The young swordsman's name is Rui Sheng
That young swordsman was none other than Rui Sheng, the gauze‑robed young swordsman, the Life Twin Heroes who is known alongside you.

The day after early in the morning before setting out, you heard about the subsequent events of the Wulin Festival from a boy who dreamt of becoming a Great Hero.
I've heard that the Hell's Path from Donghai and the Hungry Ghost Path from Xi Shu were unwilling to sit idly by, and they gathered in Yueyang to attack Fengyu Mountain together.
The forces of good and evil battled with devastating ferocity, staining a large portion of Dongting Lake with their fresh blood. Despite the martial prowess of the Wulin cluster of heroes, they were unable to withstand the massive loss of Vitality; without clear leaders, the great sects and powerful factions found themselves leaderless and fragmented, retreating in successive defeats.
Just as the righteous faction faced a critical moment, a hero youth in flowing white robes raised his precious sword and let out a long howl. He transformed into a white dragon, entering a realm where none could interfere, slicing through a million fierce soldiers with a single stroke.
At the critical moment of life and death, all factions finally put aside their grievances and listened to one person's commands. United in purpose, they reversed the declining trend and defeated the second path, achieving a resounding victory.

You embrace each other under the moon, she feels as if her body is melting, feeling the instability of storms, inevitably feeling lost and uneasy, yet she still decides to support you, taking the place you wish to go as her own dream.

Xiaozhu constantly pays attention to you, knows your hardships, isn't unwilling to comfort you, but is clumsy, unable to say nice things. Words often linger on his lips, then he swallows them back into his stomach.

You woke up in the middle of the night to find Xiao Zhu beside you.\nShe hadn't come out since you entered the room and was truly worried. Taking advantage of the opportunity to deliver food, she sneaked into your room to check on you, only for you to have locked the door. However, the door latch was too weak and broke with a single push, leaving it clean and clear. She even thought you hadn't locked the door at all.\nSeeing you sleep so deeply that she didn't even notice her entry into your room, she put down the warm plate and was about to leave. But then, she heard you mutter her name in your dreams, both enjoying and feeling a pang of sorrow. So, she silently sat in the room writing her diary, wanting to stay by your side.

Cloud Shirt's childlike innocence had not yet faded. However, she had endured the torment of illness since childhood, narrowly escaping death many times at the gates of hell. This experience had made her indifferent to life and death, allowing her to see through worldly matters with clarity. While she may appear childlike, her inner nature was far more mature than what met the eye.\nShe never considered herself a part of the Jianghu; being with you was just an attachment. She is waiting for you to spend your youth recklessly, until she loses all hope. Then it will be your turn to spend the rest of your life traveling and enjoying nature with her.

Ye Yunzhao didn't pay attention to her because he has you.\nHe first surrounded himself with a flurry of movements, then used qinggong to return to Fengyu Mountain and observe the subsequent events of the Wulin grand tournament.

You woke up in the middle of the night, startled to find a small and soft figure in your arms, sweetly fragrant‑indeed it was Yunshang.\nYou were taken aback and didn't have a chance to question how she had sneaked into your bed and stolen your blanket before she accused you of being noisy first.\nYou have no idea how quick and agile Yunshang is; she sneaked into the room before you did. Due to your exhaustion, you didn't check around when entering, so when you fell asleep, she emerged quietly by your bed, planning to play a prank on you. But seeing how pale and tired you looked, she couldn't bear to go through with it and instead, out of rare kindness, covered you with the blanket. She snuggled up to you, hoping to warm your chest, but then fell asleep herself and took the blanket away from you.

You woke up in the middle of the night and suddenly found your junior sister sleeping next to your bed, which scared you so much that you jumped up.
She woke up, startled, and slightly blushed. Although you had dressed her in a robe before bed, the little junior sister defied all norms. Thanks to your bad example, she came through the window, and until now, she still believed that this was a tacit understanding between the two of you.
The little junior sister had planned to find you for a meal together, but seeing that you were asleep and muttering her name in your dreams, she figured you must be missing her. The thought made her heart slightly sweet. Throughout the journey, there was no chance to spend time alone with you, but now, undisturbed by anyone, she quietly snuggled into your arms and fell asleep without realizing it.
You've all been doing your best to defend the master's hall, but the Jianghu is too perilous, and life is difficult. It's not about relying solely on individual bravery to summon wind and rain; the harder you try, the more you feel powerless.
The little junior sister has matured a great deal from this journey with you, and now she has thoughts of retiring. She never sought fame or fortune; she just wanted to stay with her family and friends.

You're thoroughly exhausted. You didn't even eat a meal and are covered in dust; it's as if you've died when you sink into a deep sleep with your head on the pillow.
I could faintly hear Jinxiang Palace's innocent weeping, mixed with the enraged shouts of Wulin qunxia on Fengyu Mountain.
You look back and forth, finding yourself at a loss, struggling with anxiety and uncertainty. You fear making the wrong decision that could burden your teacher's school.
The deeper you dream, the more you return to the past. Everyone is still there; the sky will fall but someone will hold it up. There's nothing for you to worry about; just focus on yourself and continue dreaming of being a grand yet impractical Great Hero.

The world is ever‑changing, and people who seem fine can vanish in an instant. In the chaotic Jianghu, it's even more so. Little Mei appears much more uncertain and anxious than she lets on; one only sees her vibrant and full of energy.\nShe no longer has any family. Spending time with you brings a mix of youthful innocence and fear that one day you might leave without saying goodbye, leaving her alone in this world.\nAt the very least, I want to have your children. For the next few decades of my life, I can pour my heart into loving the few remaining family members she has left.

Xiao Mei came to call you for dinner and found that you were actually taking a bath. She was thrilled at the sight, so she pulled out a strand of hair, inserted a silver needle into the door crack, and then used a magnet to retrieve it back into her hand. With one in, one out, she had already hooked the door latch, and with a gentle tug, she disarmed you and burst into the room.\nShe had used this move countless times to rush into Xiahou Lan, Yu Zhu, and Hu Yanju's chambers since she was a child.\nYour frantic attempts to hide only make her more excited. Without removing your clothes, you jump into the tub and start pushing against each other, causing the bathtub to crack and leaving you liable for the damages.

\nYou had the waiter bring a bucket of hot water. You immersed yourself in the warm water as the late afternoon sun shone through the window, casting clear dust particles into the air.\nThe dust on his heart cannot be washed away, but he falls asleep as soon as he closes his eyes from fatigue.

You heard that a wanderer in the Jianghu should find pleasure in righting wrongs and live a carefree life, but the reality is not quite like that.
Entering the Jianghu reveals the coldness of life, and experiencing the vicissitudes of fortune truly brings about a bitter heart.
Rain and wind filled the sky; through long and arduous trials, you have transformed from an unknown soldier into today's pillar of our sect‑not by chance.
As responsibility grew heavier, his footsteps became deeper and more solid.
Shouldered too much, he finally stumbled, his steps no longer lightened up.

On Fengyu Mountain, the storms came and went, but the Tang Clan managed to emerge unscathed, with no casualties. It was truly a miracle.\nTaking just one wrong step could lead to the entire army's destruction. You still feel a chill of fear when you think about it.
Because of your decision, someone can no longer go home.
Because of your decision, many people died

You disband the team on the spot, letting your junior disciples and juniors rest and catch their breath so they can muster up more willpower for tomorrow.\nAs soon as you close the door to the guest room, your shoulders feel heavy, and in the solitude, you reveal the exhaustion that can't be shown to others.

Fan Xiaotian is a disciple of the Beggar Sect and has never stayed at an inn before. Additionally, he was leading a dog, which made him feel rather uncomfortable. Initially, he had planned to temporarily say goodbye and spend the night in one of the nearby shantytowns for beggars, but you insisted on dragging him into the shop.\nThe shopkeeper's face, originally as pale as iron, immediately broke into a smile when you handed over a heavy copper coin to him.

Fan Xiaotian was a disciple of the Beggar Sect, had never stayed at an inn, and was also carrying a dog, feeling extremely cramped and uncomfortable, so he temporarily bid farewell and went to a nearby beggar's den to make do for the night.

Long Xiang and Lady Wen were nominally master and apprentice, but in reality, they were like mother and daughter. Devoid of their overnight provisions and especially weary.\nThe white clothes were dusty and the person looked pale and emaciated, to the point that they couldn't even eat their favorite chicken legs.
But you're really reckless, completely ignoring the Wulin Alliance's threats.

You're not without worry, but during the day, the sky is turned upside down, and everyone shows signs of fatigue. They can't run far, and fleeing in disarray is both humiliating and reveals one's weakness, making it easier to fall into ambushes. Therefore, we cannot travel all night.
You have barely escaped the tiger's mouth, yet you still hesitate, fearing that upon the arrival of the tenth day, the Wulin Alliance will launch an attack.

\nComing down from Fengyu Mountain near dusk, they decided to stay in a nearby village for the night. Fortunately, there was still a tavern and an inn in this village, making it not too desolate. They feared it would get dark too quickly if they continued walking and wouldn't make it to the next town in time.

Although the Tang Clan was spared, you still felt a mix of emotions. The Tang Clan could still be accepted in the Wulin despite its tarnished reputation. But why couldn't the Jinxiang Palace, which had a far‑reaching reputation, face the same fate? Just because the palace mistress was the Dharma King of the Mud Cult, and merely due to her identity, all the good deeds she dedicated her life to were for naught?
You spoke out of genuine feeling, but when you brought up the Jinxiang Palace again, everyone had a somber expression, thinking that you were not attuned to the times and deliberately stirring up trouble.
Lady Wen hurriedly stepped forward through the crowd and whispered to you, urging you not to waste the deceased's enlightenment. Her words clearly acknowledged that her true self was not Jinxiang Palace Master.
You stood there speechless, offering a courteous farewell with clasped hands.

Remember all those who trust the Tang Clan, but instead of thanking them, consider them friends. Beyond that, in the Wulin, every being with two feet and the ability to speak human language will be regarded as an enemy of the Tang Clan. When you wander through Tang Clan territory, there will be no mercy.\nWord spread with such force that those who had thrown daggers in the dark couldn't help but feel a chill run down their spines. They recalled the terrifying legends of Tang Clan's glory days and shuddered.\nYou finished speaking and did not even turn your head, leading everyone to leave.

You're not happy about being unjustly accused and nearly voted out. Would you really thank everyone for letting the Tang Clan off the hook?\nYou were furious and immediately blew your top, clearly intent on revenge. You first questioned Shi Ming, the thief monk, claiming he was the Dharma King of the Demon Sect, forcing everyone to vote on whether he should be killed. Then you methodically cast doubt on everyone who had dealt with the Tang Clan earlier.\nOf course, you know they wouldn't follow through with it; they're just trying to be sarcastic. This is an extremely impolite thing to say. The crowd didn't expect your heart to be so narrow‑minded and vindictive, and their expressions turned rather unpleasant.

You're just not upset, speaking neither arrogantly nor humbly, though polite yet resolute. You don't have such a broad‑mindedness. Being wrongfully accused without cause, you almost got voted to death, yet later could still manage to thank everyone for letting you off.
You arrived at the scene, there's nothing to thank, with a poor attitude, causing the crowd's dissatisfaction.
Thus, I shall part ways
Then, the wandering hero also issued a death threat to the leaders of various factions who were unfriendly today.
You arrived at the gathering, paying respects and expressing gratitude to the leaders of various factions friendly to the Tang Clan, and saluting the wandering heroes.

\nShi Ming's schemes fell through, earning him widespread condemnation and leaving him ashamed. Unable to bear the loss of face, he sneered and deployed qinggong to escape the scene. This left Chao He without support, causing him to panic and evacuate hastily.

You took advantage of the chaos and turmoil caused by war, led your fellow disciples to charge toward the weakly guarded areas, and finally broke through the heavy encirclement to escape the battlefield.

During the Wulin Conference, surrounded by a circle of martial arts heroes, you let out a loud burst of maniacal laughter.
Since the decline of the Tang Clan, people in the Wulin have gradually forgotten about the shadows. Today, your loud laughter shook everyone to their core, and no one failed to feel a chill run down their spine.
Unconsciously, they both recalled the terrifying legends of the Tang Clan‑those who offended the Tang Clan would be hunted down no matter how far away they went.
If it weren't for the Joyful Doctrine back then, Tang Old Devil from the Tang Clan would have been the foremost evil cultivator of the present day.
Invincible in every battle, facing ten enemies leaves only one alive, and they all die with great sorrow.
The Tang Clan hero is known for his carefree nature and excellent relations in the Jianghu. However, his second disciple, Mr. Sharp Hand, is a feared individual whose mere mention strikes fear into people's hearts. He keeps to himself most of the time, but whenever he appears, it means that the Jianghu will inevitably face great calamities.
A chill ran through his entire body, akin to having a bucket of cold water poured over him, extinguishing the frenzied atmosphere in the room. Not a single person dared to stop him as he led his fellow disciples down the mountain.

Rushing to the foot of the mountain by Dongting Lake, the battle between the forces of good and evil raged fiercely. When Dharma King of Hell's Path and you met each other's gaze, both were taken aback.\nHe came here solely to rescue the Human Path. Although he arrived late, revenge is not too late. He also believes that you and the Wulin Alliance breathe the same air, harming Jinxiang Palace people. He almost slit your face with his sword. You quickly explained yourself, and he trusted your character, immediately letting you go. He then led the ghost soldiers to cover your retreat.
The Tang Clan isn't going to leave now, when else would they wait? So you raised your voice and followed, leading the crowd to break through the encirclement and descend the mountain.

Just then, suddenly a bandit group stumbled up the mountain, shouting loudly. Song Bei recognized them as bandits from the nearby Chase Wind Chase Mountain Camp. He was taken aback; this Wulin grand meeting only invited the White Dao warriors, and hadn't sent invitations to the Green Forest warriors. How had he ended up here on his own?\nOne of them was greatly shocked and pale‑faced. It turned out they were holding a large conference on the mountain. The Mud Cult's Hungry Ghost Path from Donghai and Hell's Path from Xishu could not sit idly by and surrounded Fengyu Mountain, planning to set it on fire.\nOn the mountain, the Wulin Wanderers were leaderless. Upon hearing the news, they immediately fell into chaos, rushing down the hill in a rush. The major factions and powerful sects also couldn't sit idle, hastily summoning their disciples to descend the mountain to meet the enemy.

You heaved a great sigh and threw the small sword. You knew that a direct confrontation would surely lead to your downfall, so you hoped that there might still be some wise members within the Wulin Alliance who could open their eyes and restore fairness to the Tang Clan.
You won't find justice in the Wulin; it lies with Divine Captive Song Bei.
He didn't just follow orders from the court in his official capacity; despite his high position and substantial benefits, he still volunteered to move about in the Jianghu for justice. How could he tolerate such injustice? While people in Wulin read less and had limited knowledge, he couldn't be swayed by this wicked monk.
This is no longer merely a matter for the Wulin. By mediating and upholding justice, he has not overstepped his bounds.
He was not protecting the Tang Clan; instead, he was targeting Shi Ming, the accuser. A few harsh words of rebuke had him in their sights, and the official's authority intimidated Shi Ming. The satisfied expression on his face vanished instantly, as beads of sweat formed on his palms. His eyes darted around, trying to use his status to intimidate them, but Song Da didn't care about his identity at all. With an imperial grant medal in hand, he dared to apprehend anyone who broke the law across the entire land, except for the emperor himself.

They say it's to discuss surrendering their weapons and clearing their names, but just as the Wulin Alliance doesn't trust the Tang Clan, how can the Tang Clan trust them? Relying solely on Shi Ming and Chao He's one‑sided word without any evidence, they want to forcibly detain someone. Once you're under their control, he could fabricate false evidence and force a confession through torture‑what difficulty would that be?\nGiven Tang Clan's many enemies, it would not be surprising if, upon the tenth day's deadline, when the officials lift their ban and the various revenge‑seeking families lay in wait along the road from all directions, they managed to utterly annihilate your clan's elite forces.
Though you led the Tang Clan to fight alongside the Wulin Alliance, the result was still that you turned your back on them in a moment of betrayal.

When you came, you had anticipated that the Imperial Court might have ulterior motives, yet you hadn't foreseen the Tang Clan turning into a public enemy of the Wulin, which can be described as utter despair.

Ye Yunshang was known for her mischief and devious schemes on a daily basis. Now she appeared eager and impatient, much to your surprise. You thought she wanted to vent her anger fully by cursing someone out, but instead, she pleaded softly, treating Shi Ming like a good guy. She claimed it was all a misunderstanding and had evidence to prove the Tang Clan's innocence. As soon as she produced it, anyone would instantly see things differently.
Shi Ming listened with a palpable sense of unease. If such evidence truly existed, wouldn't he be facing ruin both professionally and personally? Of course, he would have to fight tooth and nail to deny it and shouted in a stern voice.
Ye Yunshang saw that he was unwilling to look and considered calling Shangguan Jun and Song Bei over to see. Shi Ming became even more anxious; if this object fell into the hands of these two lords, his troubles would be just as grave. Thus, he patiently recited a Buddhist invocation and pretended to act solemnly, asking Ye Yunshang for evidence. In reality, he discreetly made hand signals to Chao He behind him, preparing to destroy the evidence at any cost before saying anything further.
Ye Yunshang reached into her pocket and pulled out a steamed bun. Just as she was about to say, The evidence is hidden inside this steamed bun, before she could finish speaking, Chao He snatched it away. You were furious and tried to retrieve it, but Shi Ming stepped in to stop you. After only a few moves, the steamed bun had already been devoured by Chao He in one greedy gulp.
The method he used to destroy the evidence was shamefully underhanded. However, with the evidence destroyed and him refusing to admit anything to the end, you would have no means of proving your case either way. You must still leave him here to explain everything clearly, no matter what. At that time, Shi Ming can pretend to help Chao He induce vomiting and use false evidence to put you all in grave danger.
Ye Yunshang's face paled as she became increasingly desperate, tears streaming down her cheeks as she begged for help from anyone. The Tang Clan had become an enemy of the Wulin, and when she and her brother sought refuge with them, they had broken ties with their old friends. Not a single person was willing to offer assistance.
Ye Yunshang, in a moment of desperation, blurted out ancestor of the Ye family, and mentioned map. Those who heard it gave it some thought and immediately changed color. They instantly recalled the Yue Wang Treasure. What other evidence could there be at the bottom of the earth that would instantaneously change someone's perspective, no matter who saw it? Only money, only bribes.
Better to believe in the possibility of something over dismissing it outright. Greed and curiosity spurred the originally indifferent Wulin to eagerly pursue and hunt down Chao He, hoping to force him to confess to the supposed evidence. The more people involved in this farce, the more believable the rumors became.
Even Shi Ming, who would normally defend himself, was too preoccupied to engage with you further. He loudly claimed the evidence belonged to him and started fighting with everyone else.
Yeyunshang turned around and pulled you close with a sly smile. In reality, where did she have any evidence? She led you by the hand and called her fellow disciples to quietly leave the mountain together.
This time, regardless of how Chao He cried and tried to throw a tantrum, no one showed any sympathy. He was beaten until he begged for mercy, made to vomit up the contents of his stomach with a purgative, and even managed to expel all his bile. Not a trace of the map could be found anywhere.
Shi Ming was particularly enraged. The thought of missing out on the treasure of Marshal Yue caused him such resentment that he almost went mad with anger. A cruel thought suddenly struck him, and without hesitation, he pulled a dagger from his monk's robe and disemboweled Chao He right there.
Such heinous and shocking atrocities have utterly destroyed Shi Ming's reputation. From then on, no one would believe anything he said.

Xiao Ju, as a weak woman, navigated the Four Doors of Kongtong with grace and skill, not only emerging unscathed but also gaining respect. Naturally, she was exceptionally intelligent, her cunning matching that of the Dharma King of the Human Path in no small way. As you stepped gracefully into the arena, she had already calmed her temper and devised a strategy.
She naturally knew that with Tang Clan and Kongtong alone, they would have no chance against the Wulin Alliance and would surely fail.
But that inevitable defeat is Tang Clan's plight in relation to the Wulin Alliance. To resolve this dilemma, there is no need for both sides to suffer.
People in the Wulin tend to act on their bloodiness, with hot blood surging easily, making them prone to impulsiveness. They follow the crowd by habit; Shi Ming can incite public sentiment, so why not her?
So Xiao Ju followed Lady Wen's lead and first used the Tang Clan's accumulated authority to intimidate people in the Wulin. This was a case of intimidating them with power, but Lady Wen's ultimate goal was always to gain respect and achieve reconciliation with the Wulin Alliance.
Xiao Ju, on the other hand, intentionally stirred up panic and anger. She then set fire to blame the instigator, turning the tables to demand Shi Ming as a hostage in exchange for Tang Clan surrendering their weapons and cooperating with the interrogation. Otherwise, Tang Clan would rather die than submit, and the Wulin's heroes would all be implicated by his selfish fear of death.
Shi Ming was simply afraid of death; he wanted to eliminate the Tang Clan through the Wulin Alliance. There was no question of any enlightenment or insight. He tried to use the pretense of a senior from the Wulin to speak and confuse the issue. Shangguan Ying suddenly stepped forward and stood beside Xiao Ju, the two exchanging a glance with perfect understanding. They detailed the benefits and drawbacks, cited classics to explain the bigger picture, using their own tactics against them, while subtly hinting at killing intent. Shi Ming retreated step by step, nearly spitting out old blood. A high‑ranking monk uttering such impure words; he cursed and fled in despair.
Others saw him standing firm and resolute when fanning the flames, but hesitated and obstructed when the fire was directed at himself. They instantly became clear‑headed, feeling both anger and regret as well as shame. Inside his head, he cursed Shi Ming hundreds of times over. He also regretted how reckless he had been, worrying about how offending the Tang Clan would lead to retaliation in the future.

\nGiven the prevailing trend, even voices supporting the Tang Clan could not stand against the majority, and their support was overshadowed by the criticism.\nSurveying Fengyu Mountain, every sight is an enemy.

After speaking about the Tang Clan, they mentioned Senior Brother. It turned out that on that day, he and Senior Brother were ambushed while traveling together. He sustained severe injuries and nearly died. Fortunately, it was Senior Brother who rescued him and had someone attend to his wounds. With his injured body, he went to meet Shi Gongyuan as arranged, which led to his fatal condition due to the severity of his injuries.\nShi Gongyuan is a straightforward person and also suspects that there was something suspicious about the fight from the previous day. Hearing him say this made him increasingly alarmed. He thought he might have accidentally injured his good friend, and immediately broke out in cold sweat.
You and your fellow disciples were seething with anger, but the cacophony of voices drowned out your protests.
Before your journey to Fengyu Mountain, the fact that you stayed as guests in Jinxiang Palace was used by him to make a big deal out of it.

All the major sects and clans have declared their stance, with both sides evenly divided. Shi Ming hurriedly ran up to Shangguan Jun, his face showing a pleading expression. Although Shangguan Jun had washed his hands in a Golden Basin, his family's influence was still formidable enough to stir up the Jianghu. With just one word from him, Tang Clan could be brought down on the spot.\nHowever, Shangguan Family's main leader is deeply cunning and won't dance to his tune. Tang Clan and Jinxiang Palace are fundamentally different; we can only take a long‑term approach. It is not a sect that can be crushed merely by public opinion; therefore, it was decisively refused.

Major sects have expressed their stance, with many supporting the Tang Clan. Shi Ming has no credible evidence at all, trying to take advantage of the panic and turn public opinion into gold‑his schemes are too obvious.

The Flying Stone Gang rose to prominence very quickly, although they had a large number of members, these were mere scattered individuals. They were invited to participate in the Wulin Grand Assembly, merely for the sake of exposure and broadening their good connections.
According to the norms, with senior experts and elders present from various schools, it shouldn't be his turn for Shi Gongyuan to speak. However, as he watched the Tang Clan surrounded by enemies, the expressions of these esteemed sects were filled with ill intent, as if they were about to draw their blades at any moment. This stirred something within him, and without thinking, he declared support for the Tang Clan. Whether or not the Tang Clan was allied with the Mud Cult, the Flying Stone Gang would stand alongside them.
During the heyday of the Tang Clan, there was no need to add flowers to a already colorful scene. But when the Tang Clan faced difficulties, it was essential to provide aid in times of snow, much like sending charcoal on a cold day.
Why else would he owe Senior Brother?
Fan Xiaotian found the Beggar Sect unreasonable and without hesitation, he took his dog and joined the Tang Clan, preparing for a major showdown.
Li Fugui ultimately chose to conform, considering the interests of the million Beggar Sect disciples.

Although Gang Leader Li is rather reserved, he is a man with spirit and blood. Otherwise, Wang Erzhuang would not have adopted him as his adoptive son and entrusted him with such important responsibilities.\nYu Xiaojie followed the advice of the traditional elders to consolidate morale on minor issues, but on major principles, he could not afford any compromise. Otherwise, if the Beggar Sect abandoned its code of honor, it would be equivalent to abandoning its dignity, and they could no longer consider themselves wanderers. Therefore, he resolutely decided to support the Tang Clan.

Back when we competed with you for vegetables in the bustling market square, sparring and feasting on hot pot together, those Beggar Sect friends were part of the new faction. After Wang Erzhuang's death, the power within the Beggar Sect shifted to the old faction, putting the new faction under intense pressure. They dare not make a sound; otherwise, they would face not just hunger but also the risk of having their limbs broken.\nNow that you are at a disadvantage, they have no concern for their own safety and have all stepped forward to offer advice to Gang Master Li.
Fan Xiaotian saw the situation as unfavorable and immediately caused a commotion. No matter how his uncle tried to persuade him, he refused to listen or pay attention.
They wanted the Tang Clan to stay and undergo interrogation, with the majority of the voices in favor, but Li, the clan leader, hesitated again.
Seeing that the majority support the Tang Clan, the Beggar Sect also unhesitatingly supports the Tang Clan.
Both sides have balanced opinions, so the Beggar Sect also has no opinion.
The Beggar Sect watched the situation, ready at any time to join the side with more people.

The Nangong Family has earned the reputation of Wulin Xin, so they must remain impartial. Therefore, as the new family master, Nangong Shen dares not defy the ancestral precepts and thus, the Nangong Family publicly expressed their support for the Tang Clan.

If Lord Shangguan were to encounter unforeseen misfortune on the battlefield, the Alliance Leader would find it even harder to avoid blame.

Jinxiang Palace attendants were well‑trained. Seeing the situation turn unfavorable, they immediately set up an array formation. The central point of the formation was firmly established, and it began to rotate ceaselessly. One person wielded a sword while the eight surrounding attendants took up positions as backups. This formation evolved from the Eight Trigram Diagrams devised by Zhuge Liang, a renowned minister from the Three Kingdoms period. Although the number of righteous Wulin practitioners was more than ten times that of Jinxiang Palace's, they were merely scattered and only knew to shout and move around. How could they possibly break through this formation?
So they were kept outside the battlefield, and for a time, neither side made any progress.
Since Jinxiang Palace gained fame, it had only taken in women who were harmed by societal prejudices. Throughout the entire palace, only Long Xiang was not voluntarily admitted but instead brought up by Lady Wen since childhood. They were called master and apprentice, but in reality, they were more like mother and daughter.
Today, she only found out that Jinxiang Palace was actually the Human Path. For a moment, it felt as if she had fallen into a dream, her feet unable to find solid ground, dazed and desperate to wake up but unable to escape. Lady Wen exiled her from the palace, leaving her lost and at a loss, unsure of where to go or what to do.

Zen Master Shi Ming from the South Yard of Songshan stood out among the crowd with an air of righteous dignity. Upon reading the letter, he displayed a boastful look of shock and presented it to the Alliance Leader.\nNangong Qian said, and everyone dismissed it with a snort. Even with Shi Ming's word, everyone couldn't help but doubt it fully.\nHowever, Nangong Yuan's face turned as pale as iron when he read the letter, surpassing a thousand words in conveying disbelief. How could there still be any doubt?
You broke into a cold sweat and felt an urgent desire to immediately step forward and silence him.

The ladies of Jinxiang Palace seemed to breathe a sigh of relief, with some planning to travel alone through the Jianghu, others intending to sheath their swords and retire, marry and have children, each going their own way.
Though Jianghu friends of the Jinxiang Palace were reluctant, they did not attempt to detain them, instead offering them blessings.
Rising tides bring joy in settling old scores, basking in the glory for a while. When the tide recedes, one washes their hands in a golden basin and retires in peace. Is this not what many in the Jianghu wish for too?
The grand assembly of the Wulin will come to an end. Surprisingly, Nangong Qian, the Second Young Lord of the Nangong family, who was always unwelcome, hurriedly rushed out. He brandished a secret letter in his hand and publicly denounced Jinxiang Palace's lady‑in‑charge as none other than the Dharma King of the Mud Cult on the Human Path!
This sentence made the mountain xia shi cry and laugh helplessly. It was well‑known that the Second Young Lord of the Nangong family was an illegitimate son who rarely upheld the family's honor; he had done many things that brought shame to the family, which were not befitting his status. This time, without knowing where he heard some gossip, he was once again seeking attention.

By the time the Six Great Sects, the Beggar Sect, the Cang Gang, and the Three Major Help Groups‑those from various states and even the Sword Pavilion of Fire Flame Mountain‑all came to pay respects to the Alliance Leader and the Jinxiang Palace Master, she finally made her slow appearance.
They waited for this day for twenty years. Twenty years ago, Su Yingxiang stood by Nangong Yuan's side, plotting and strategizing for him.
Countless talented individuals flocked to him, all awestruck by his lofty aspirations. They were willing to risk their lives and shed their blood to swear that they would change this world.
Twenty years later, the world had changed, and all that remained were unfulfilled regrets.
Lady Wen's face was as cold as ice, and her words were sharp and biting. Frozen for three feet, it wasn't the result of just one day's chill. No matter what Nangong Yuan said, it could not warm her heart that was already thoroughly chilled.
They would not acknowledge Nangong Yuan as the Alliance Leader, even if it meant dissolving Jinxiang Palace in front of everyone.

Sect leaders and elders from various factions hurried forward to offer congratulations to the Alliance Leader of the Wulin Alliance. Although your Tang Clan does not adhere to the orthodox path, you are still part of the Wulin, and as Nangong Family is a long‑time ally, it's only proper to exchange pleasantries.
Congratulations and farewells befit congratulations and farewells. However, the Tang Clan's steadfast approach cannot change. If an event benefits the people without violating righteousness, we might participate, but we are not likely to blindly follow the Wulin Alliance's every command.
You didn't even need to speak, and Nangong Yuan cut off your words. After dealing with the Tang Clan for so long, how could he not know their arrogance?
The Tang Clan should be proud and unrestrained. Grinding away their pride would be such a waste.
The Wulin should have unrestrained wanderers as well as righteous individuals who are willing to follow the orders of the court. And it is the Nangong Family that mediates among them.
You heard from the mouth of Nangong Sect Leader what the Master said two decades ago. You can almost picture him then, standing out from the crowd, looking down on all contemporary heroes and martial artists, moving alone and independent. What kind of spirit and determination must he have had back then? It couldn't help but make your heart surge with pride, taking great pride in being a disciple of Tang Clan.

A single family can quarrel over trivial matters, so how much more so between nations.
Rui Sheng reflected on the myriad feelings within him. The grand aspiration of bringing peace and unity to all under heaven was truly not an ordinary task to accomplish. He feared that his painstaking efforts might end up in vain, with no success to show for it.
Xiao Ju, however, did not think so. Knowing that it was impossible yet still doing it‑does that not make one a sage?
Clumsiness is fine; after all, not everyone has the talent. It's precisely because of this that one should be down‑to‑earth, taking each step with care, using ordinary methods to do what everyone can achieve. This way, future generations can emulate them.
Rui Sheng heard this and was greatly impressed, praising her for her exceptional discernment. You should be proud of her.
If they want the ladies to coexist peacefully, unless they all learn from the Little Junior Sister to not compete for favor and not be jealous, they can then remain uninvolved, neither sad nor happy.

Yunshang heard this and came up with a plan. She just needed to give each of them a blade, get drunk outside, and when they returned home, the problem would be solved easily.\nRui Sheng could only bitterly smile. How could such a suggestion of pouring oil on the fire be heeded? Little did he know that his sister had no intention of harming their lady; she was actually trying to encourage their lady to work together with him in their scheme.

You had planned to visit the Gu Yun Shan Sect, but instead encountered Young Sect Leader Rui Sheng, who had fled due to family disputes and was in shambles.
It sounds like his several female friends, although beautiful, tend to have somewhat quick tempers.
This is not difficult to foresee, for people are not sages and who among them has no selfish desires? To desire exclusive affection from their husbands is a natural human inclination. Moreover, these young misses sought their lovers without the mediation of matchmakers, driven by courageous hearts unafraid of societal norms and fervent sincerity.
The outcome truly cannot be exchanged on a one‑to‑one basis and also forces one to share with others. How can this not cause resentment?
Making them stop being jealous of each other is easier said than done!

There is intent to meet the Sect Leader of Emei, Xiang Wuyou, but how many like‑minded individuals from the Wulin are there? They all vie for his favor, hoping to make the acquaintance of this standout martial arts master.
You realized it was futile to squeeze in and decided to give up, turning to see the back of the Sect Leader. In doing so, you became more attuned to their presence.
All martial arts follow the same principle regardless of their path. He had forgotten the worldly affairs and secluded himself for many years, refining the Formless Fist from his understanding of Xingyiquan. At this moment, watching you move through the crowd as if dodging it, he couldn't help feeling a subtle shock. He wondered what kind of martial arts a Tang Clan disciple skilled in hidden weapons and poisons might practice.
Little did you know that the martial arts you practiced are indeed from the Tang Clan, the 'Shapelessness Chapter' which, despite its straightforward title, few can truly understand.

Lady Wen had been too busy thinking about the maids in the palace to worry about her own affairs earlier. Today's events allowed her some respite, and upon seeing Little Bamboo, she realized that Lue Gu Mo from Kongtong Mountain was renowned for his craftsmanship, while the Sword Pavilion in Huo Yan Shan specialized in making weapons. Yet, she could craft anything and everything, truly making her a remarkable woman of her time.
He then ordered a carriage from Little Bamboo, one with a roof to shield from wind and rain, and windows to enjoy the scenery along the way.
The exterior doesn't need intricate decorations, but the interior should be comfortable and spacious, sturdy and reliable, able to withstand bumps and jolts.
She wants to go to Changbai Mountain, where she hears the snow never melts all year round. It's said to be the place her old friend returned to in spirit. Since she will have nothing to do after retiring from the Jianghu, it might as well be a journey with a full car of fragrant flowers, paying respects to her old friends and telling them: Nangong Yuan has finally become the Alliance Leader of the Wulin. Everyone's dreams will continue on.

Xiao Mei approached to greet. She behaves lively and cheerful in front of boisterous people, and dignified and proper in front of refined ones. Her smile is flawless, winning the hearts of both men and women alike. However, this tactic seems ineffective before Lady Wen; after all, she is a seasoned Jianghu figure who has seen many a heart. How could she be unaware of Xiao Mei's fawning intentions? Furthermore, Lady Wen knows that Xiao Mei is a killer from Thousand Lantern Tower with an unclear past. The more Xiao Mei tries to please her, the more cautious and unwilling to speak Lady Wen becomes.
Xiao Mei was not bothered by this and turned into the arms of the Painting Immortal, calling her aunt in a warm manner. Lady Wen was instantly taken aback. She and the Painting Immortal were qin sisters; Xiao Mei calling her aunt meant that she must be someone else's aunt to Xiao Mei. They were kin, with Xiao Mei addressing her as aunt due to their familial relationship. Her mind raced through the family relationships, and she called Xiao Mei forward in a deep voice.
The Painting Immortal was greatly alarmed and thought her lie would be exposed on the spot. However, Lady Wen surprisingly changed her previous stern expression and immediately acknowledged their kinship. She even offered to share all of her life's knowledge as a form of compensation.
Xiao Mei was abducted by the Thousand Lantern Tower from a young age to be trained as an assassin. Afterward, she spent time at the Flying Heaven Gate where she absorbed the environment, and near vermilion is dyed red, inevitably picking up some of the ruthless and obsessive traits. However, in reality, her nature was inherently pure; she loved playing pranks and was easily fooled. At that moment, she truly believed she had found another family member. Tears welled up in her eyes instantly, and she didn't bother with how precious the martial arts or knowledge were; all she felt was joy at finally having a place to rely on.

Xiao Ju stepped forward to pay her respects. The Jianghu is renowned for its two exceptional women talents, and today these two finally have the chance to meet. You speak, I respond, each of us quoting classics and praising the other's words with genuine admiration, as if we've met too late in life.\nAlthough you knew Little Chrysanthemum was widely known for her talent and admired her scholarly abilities, you had never seen her so excited today upon meeting a kindred spirit. She talked fluently, with witty remarks flowing like pearls, and it seemed to have lifted her spirits from the past, nearly breaking her vow not to compose poems or verses.

You now know that Lady Wen is the Human Path Dharma King of the Mud Cult, and yet she dares to bring palace women to the Wulin Festival. Her courage cannot be said to lack boldness. Her spirit cannot be considered lacking in bravery.\nIf you slip up and say too much, they might find it difficult to leave this place alive.\nLady Wen, however, reckoned that you wouldn't say it. She knows people so well; she has a clear idea of who can be trusted. Venturing into great danger to inform you was not to have you expose her, but rather to entrust deep hopes.

Long Xiang saw you approaching, smiled warmly, and came forward, still holding a chicken leg from a street vendor. You couldn't help but laugh. This person could be colder than a sword's edge at times, yet at others, as sweet and charming as a young woman on a spring day outing. But to be honest, being able to eat is better than not being able to.

\nWhen you visited the Jinxiang attendants, a group of white‑robed ladies were chatting and laughing, looking carefree. They didn't seem to be aware of the solemnity of the Wulin grand meeting. Outsiders who knew nothing about it laughed at them for being naive and treating the Jianghu as if it were just a game. Little did they know that for these attendants, today was actually their graduation ceremony in their Jianghu life.

You felt as if it were a dream, so real and vivid that you couldn't believe your luck. You always complained that good fortune never came your way, but now that it had finally happened, you found yourself doubting everything, anxious and uncertain. At one moment, you thought you were still dreaming; the next, you suspected some trickery was at play.\nYin Zhiping had no intention of pleading or coaxing you; he was merely passing on the master's message. Whether you choose to believe it or seize the opportunity, and how you decide to act, is entirely up to you.

This was undoubtedly a matter of great joy, but Yunshang became furious upon hearing it and immediately found a branch to confront Yin Zhiping.\nYin Zhiping hurriedly explained that it wasn't to have you become a Taoist monk; it was just to register your name and allow you to practice at home.\nShe finally let out a sigh of relief and abandoned the idea of beating Yin Zhiping to death.

This is indeed a matter of supreme importance, but your little junior sister got worried the moment she heard it. She fears that you might be swayed and actually become a Taoist monk. After all, the first person in the world made an exception to take you as a disciple‑what reason could the Tang Clan have to keep you from doing so?
Yin Zhiping hurriedly explained that it wasn't about becoming a Taoist monk; it was just to register your name so you could practice cultivation at home.
The little junior sister finally let out a sigh of relief, feeling a sense of regained joy and relief. Without thinking, she gripped your garment, deep down always feeling that everyone wanted to take you away.
She really overthought it

On a whim, I instructed my disciple to test you. If you don't come, I'll give up and accept that there's no yunfeng, and there's no need to force it.\nIf you approach him and have Daoist affinity, yet lack formal teacher lineage, with a pure heart and unwavering determination, the humble door may still be opened for you. He might break his rules to admit you as a posthumous disciple.
The more they hear about your stumbles, the more Qu Immortal is interested, appreciating your indomitable will and the courage to go against the wind.

During that journey in the vast desert, Immortal Qiu remembered you, after all, your face is too unforgettable, and your performance was quite remarkable. At that time, they did not fully understand your character, and even heard Yin Zhiping laughingly recount how you stumbled along the way, unyielding and persistent. Their interest grew even more, admiring your indomitable will and the spirit to go against the wind.

Yin Zhiping had been waiting for you to come to him, and his recitation just now was not out of genuine emotion; rather, it was a deliberate test to see if your connection with the Quanzhen sect is deep enough.
Before this journey south, he had spoken tea and chatted with his benevolent teacher Qiu Chuji. They discussed the heroes of their time, and Daoist Yin specifically mentioned you.
The Yangtze River's later waves push forward the earlier ones, and in the Jianghu, outstanding talents rise with each passing era. Given enough time, one learns to accept the constant emergence of new prodigies.
However, among these outstanding young heroes, not one is an ordinary person. Only you are particularly unusual.
Ordinary in talent, you failed to receive the true teachings of the Tang Clan and have no extraordinary fate to speak of. Your situation is like that of many commoners‑either you give up and let the current carry you away, or you become a mere tool, a sacrificial lamb, silently disappearing and being forgotten by all, with nobody remembering your name.
How is it that you just showed up?

You still thought the poem he recited was an impromptu composition, about to compliment it, but Xiao Ju stopped you in time, whispering that it was a quatrain by the Pure Yang Master Lu Dongbin, so you didn't say anything foolish.
You could tell immediately that he was reciting a quatrain by Pure Yang Patriarch Lu Dongbin.\nYin Zhiping's eyes sparkled with approval
\nYou went to meet the Quanzhen Daoist Yinyun at the precipice. He was standing alone, gazing at Dongting Lake.

With a wife this wise, what more does a husband seek?
Xiao Ju heard the words and smiled faintly, showing no interest in the power she held.
Today, I will give you a chance to wash away the shame of being granted a marriage to a martial artist by the imperial edict when you were once a distinguished scholar laureate.
To her, you are a king

Fortunately, Wei Ju stepped in, having already arranged everything thoroughly, considered all aspects, managed with composure, and maintained order. She even attributed all the credit to you. Upon hearing that it was at the leader's behest, the Kongtong crowd obeyed without hesitation.
The reason you couldn't answer isn't about how much knowledge you have, but rather that your understanding of Kongtong's situation is too superficial to make a hasty decision.

\nYou, as the head of the Palm School, showed your face before the Kongtong Sect and feared that you might be stabbed by those who did not submit to you. However, with Danxiazi leading everyone showing great respect, it was hard to see any hint of disrespect. This made you feel somewhat relieved.\nHowever, when asked about the future direction of Kongtong, you stumbled and couldn't say a word.

How could you be here just to take it? Someone mocked you, and you immediately retaliated with sharp words, using subtle Yin and Yang tactics without naming names, yet the power was incomparable. The old beggar had poor restraint, and upon being provoked, he swung his staff, ready to fight. The surrounding crowd heard the commotion and turned to look, seeing the beggars' ruthless, aggressive stance, all ready to fight, their brows furrowed. The Beggar Sect's image, which had been striving to restore, now cracked open a fissure.

You know that the Beggar Sect is currently run by a few elderly elders who hold all the power. Although the Sect Master is the nominal head of the sect, his words don't carry much weight.\nSo as not to put the Righteous Cause Sub‑branch in a difficult position, he smiled and gestured with his hands, bidding them farewell.

The elder of the old faction of the Beggar Sect stepped forward, pretending to advise the sect leader to be cautious in choosing associates and avoid unscrupulous villains. As he spoke, his gaze kept scanning you, his face betraying a mocking expression, subtly implying his meaning without needing to say it outright.
They thought the old faction elders of the Beggar Sect would dislike the Tang Clan, but to their surprise, someone stepped forward to advise the sect leader to engage more with the Tang Clan.

Ye Yunshang saw you getting beaten and immediately raised her staff to strike from behind.
She struck you for a reason. Knowing that you would look surprised and turn around to question her, she took the opportunity to answer in front of everyone: Every slap is a sign of affection; every scolding, a manifestation of love. So her slaps are reminding you of your own feelings. As for your Beggar Sect friends calling you the Blue Devil, it clearly shows they care about you.
Upon these words, everyone present fell silent, unable to retort no matter how close they were. There was nothing left for them to say or curse.
Yunshang used her method to protect you.

The junior sister was not pleased to see you getting beaten up. She doesn't understand the friendship forged through a punch or kick.\nThe old beggar brother was both surprised and impressed to see that you really managed to deceive the Tang Clan's Miss Thousand Gold. I want to privately seek your advice on a few moves so we can live together as a beggar couple, but what do you have to offer? To this day, you're still worried that your little junior sister is like a mirage in a desert‑touch her and she dissipates.

Once upon a time, they used to bicker over stealing vegetables and eating hotpot together. Now, an old friend from the Great Righteousness Sub‑branch of the Beggar Sect burst out, cursing the blue devil with his mouth while tears filled his eyes. The world is unpredictable, like white clouds and black dogs. Not only had the Tang Clan seen people come and go, but their own Great Righteousness Sub‑branch of the Beggar Sect was no exception.\nThe Gang Master is gone, and the old faction's Old Beggar Reclamation deliberately consolidated power. The Great Righteousness Sub‑Branch now has very few old members left. Meeting you here truly feels like it's from another world.\nIn the excitement, of course I would punch you a few times to see if you're still as tough as you were back then.

She immediately noticed Xiao Ju by her side and was taken aback, lowering her head.\nOriginally, Li Fugui's family hadn't yet fallen on hard times and had once truly been wealthy. He went to a poetry gathering with his friends, admiring this talented lady in name only and being captivated by her stunning talents.\nBack then, I was already ashamed of myself; now that I've become the leader of beggars, I'm even more afraid she might recognize me.

\nYou approached the Beggar Sect to greet them, and Gang Leader Li was a young man. At the Wulin Conference, he appeared nervous yet cautious, but his face lit up with a warm smile as he came forward to meet you.

You had the intention to meet the high monk of Songshan and show your admiration, but instead you encountered Master Fu Yun who advised you against it.
Juehui Fangzhang was naturally fond of tranquility and had no interest in associating with the people of the Jianghu. Having returned to the mountain for only a short while, he was about to pass on his robe and bowl without any desire to be entangled in secular matters.
You want to deal with the Songshan monks, and dealing with him won't be any different anyway. After all, in the end, he's almost certain to become the abbot of Songshan.
You were taken aback and privately remarked that this young monk was terribly arrogant. Even if he had ambitions, how could he declare them openly? Yet, you underestimated him.
Fu Yun made such bold declarations because he deeply understands that one must hold a position to achieve anything. To discipline the monks, establish rank, and renew his efforts to propagate Buddhism, he must first gain power and lead by example. Therefore, the position of Abbot is a necessity for him to accomplish these goals.
If one intends to go but hides their words, it would be less honest.
After the conference ends, his wandering for nearly a decade as he fulfilled an old vow will come to a close, and he plans to return to the temple to deepen his understanding of Buddhist teachings.
If you don't come to Songshan this time, it might be many years before we meet again.
You and he, one a monk and the other a layman, have quite a deep bond despite your different ways. The friendship between you has lasted for so long that it cannot be considered shallow. Hearing this, you feel a sense of melancholy.

The Way of Righteousness determined the Wulin Alliance Leader. Even if the Tang Clan didn't intend to follow every word, they still needed to make some moves and interact with various sects, to demonstrate their presence.

Wei Ju spoke with you for a while and saw that you showed no signs of reproach, so she finally calmed down.\nActually, she came with no intention of leaving. According to their agreement, all matters at Kongtong Sect have been properly handed over. The reason why she didn't bring any baggage or fine soft items was just to avoid you disliking her. If you don't mind, from now on, she will no longer be Wei Sect Leader; instead, she will simply be your Little Chrysanthemum.

You sensed from her words that she seemed to praise the Nangong Clan highly, and this worryingly made you fear she might be lured away by Young Lord Nangong.
You probe very gently, but Little Juye knows autumn through a single leaf, instantly guessing what you're hiding. She can't help but secretly chuckle, finding it sweetly satisfying, and worries that after several months apart, the headmaster might change his mind and forget about her.
A gentleman hates to speak ill of others. She had no wish to criticize anyone, but in order to express her true feelings, she openly revealed her thoughts about the Young Lord without reservation. Her complaints flowed like a mighty river, leaving you speechless. You thought this Wei talented woman was easygoing, but it turned out she had such strict standards for one's character. You secretly rejoiced at your own steadiness, which is why you hadn't been disliked.
She had never even shared these words with her dear friend Shangguan Ying, after all, since the eldest Young Lord had once been Shangguan Ying's fiance.
She was speaking ill of others, yet she felt that you had caught her with a hold over herself.

Xiao Ju expressed shame on her face and apologized to you. Originally, she had devised a plan to use the pressure of the Quanzhen, Songshan, Diancang, and Kongtong factions to stir up public opinion at the conference, forcing it out of the control of the court and helping you ascend to the position of Alliance Leader in the Wulin.
Little did he expect the Quanzhen faction to withdraw from the competition without a word. As a result, Kongtong Sect, which was already in a similar predicament and faced even more controversy due to its broad acceptance of refugees from various nations, quickly found itself without support. Consequently, throughout the conference, Kongtong remained silent.
The good fortune in this misfortune is that the Nangong Family has won the championship. Given the social and geographical dynamics, the Tang Clan should not face any troubles, which somewhat eased his concerns.
\nAs Xiao Zhu gets to know you better each day, they will also start to joke around.
His love fortune was flourishing, and he unexpectedly acquired four beautiful female companions in one go, his tone revealing a sense of satisfaction.
He had a flourishing peach blossom luck, unexpectedly acquiring five beautiful female companions in one go, his tone carrying a clear air of satisfaction.

His peach blossom luck was exceptionally strong, and he actually gained five red‑haired concubines at once. The way he spoke showed a clear sense of satisfaction.
You find it absolutely normal. With Rui Sheng's appearance, martial arts, and talents, him facing obstacles in the past can only mean he picked the wrong opponents or had bad luck. Otherwise, having multiple concubines wouldn't be difficult.
We were talking just fine until Rui Sheng, without much thought, said, We might not lose to Miss Tang. This insulted you, this person of poor taste, and suddenly we found ourselves in a battle state. The more we fought, the funnier it became, and I ended up laughing loudly while supporting your shoulder.
He prefers friends like you, who don't bother to pay empty compliments to everyone they meet.

You don't find the slightest bit strange that Rui Sheng, with his talents, appearance, and martial arts skills, kept encountering obstacles in the past. It can only be said that he picked the wrong opponents and had bad luck; otherwise, having many concubines wouldn't be difficult.\nWe were talking nicely until Rui Sheng said offhand, We might not lose to Miss Tang, which angered you, this uncouth person. Suddenly, you entered a battle state.\nThe little junior sister didn't realize that this was just playful banter between men and the closeness it fosters. Before she could jump in to intervene, she asked for the reason, feeling a sweet warmth in her heart.
In a moment, Cang Gang members will arrive as guests and take the invitation, leading you to the pavilion for rest.
Even though you, who have seen much, can't help but get nervous, the younger disciples, seeing you like this, become even more panicked.
Even though you, who've seen so much of the world, can't help but be nervous, you still want to be stubborn and deny it.
You cannot gauge how reliable his calm expression truly is.\nHe always looks as ugly when he smiles, yet it strangely puts one at ease.

Arriving at Fengyu Mountain, one could see banners from various martial arts sects fluttering in the wind. The arena was packed with people, likely numbering close to a thousand.
Fenzhi chouban Wulin Dahui de Shangguan Jiazu, although he has retired from the Jianghu, still commands respect. Most people in the Wulin give him face, especially for such a major meeting to discuss the future of the Wulin. Out of one hundred posts, ninety‑nine responded. In a short time, heroes from all over Central China gathered at Fengyu Mountain. The scene was unprecedentedly grand and bustling with activity. The six major sects each claimed their own territory, with their disciples dressed in various uniforms‑easier to distinguish‑but the Wulin individuals without affiliation were not as particular about their attire; it became difficult to tell one from another.
Experienced old hands in the Jianghu value social graces and greet acquaintances with small talk. Youngsters with high aspirations, however, are as prickly as hedgehogs, unwilling to give an inch to each other. Some especially fond of pretense carry a stick in their mouths, styling themselves as solitary wolves roaming through the borders of the world, taking pride in being homeless. Even if they have parents at home, they would claim their families are destroyed and their loved ones dead, as though it were dishonorable not to have killed all family members.

You recalled the time when traveling through the desert, Lady Rui Xing advised Genghis Khan to act boldly and decisively with his sword. However, Lady Wen was taken aback by these words, interpreting them differently.
She only believed that Rui Xing chose to help the Mongol Khan seize the throne and thus offered strategic advice. However, with the Mongol‑Jin War failing to materialize, she turned westward for conquests. On the surface, it appeared as though they were expanding their territory, but in reality, they were exploiting the situation to divide the Mongols.
If Qizhi, who is the farthest from the line of succession, wants to protect himself, he would volunteer for a western expedition. By establishing merit there, he could clear his name and distance himself from political turmoil. Over time, with his own army, he might even aim at the Onon River, posing a hidden danger to the legitimate heir's heart, thus potentially leading to civil war if he is not careful.
A few years later, the situation did indeed unfold as Lady Wen had anticipated. However, she was only partly correct because Rui Xing changed her mind halfway through.
Tu Chi was sent on the western expedition and was appointed as Khan in the farthest Qipchaq.
Later, after Tuque was framed by Rui Xing and suspected by Genghis Khan, he was so grief‑stricken that he contemplated suicide. Rui Xing persuaded him to commit suicide in his tent, falsely claiming that he had died of illness. This left Genghis Khan with a lasting sense of guilt. Not long after, Tuque passed away.
Plum Blossom Immortal Soldiers effortlessly destroyed the Mongol stronghold, used Sui Dynasty territory as a passageway, surrounded Bianjing, and extinguished the Jin.

A girl with extraordinary beauty rolled aside the curtain, instantly filling the room with a radiant glow. Surrounded by an almost indescribable aura of sanctity and inviolability, she was none other than the mysterious Peach Blossom Fairy from the Southern Yang Peach Grove.
She referred to Lady Wen as Sensei and dismissed her attendants, sitting gracefully before picking up the pieces to play a game of go with Lady Wen.
She and Lady Wen engaged in a conversation, each word sending shivers down your spine. You broke out in cold sweat, fearing that any drop might fall.
Only now do I realize that Lady Wen's words were not empty. The storms of the Jianghu and even the wars in the four kingdoms are all orchestrated by this person, who operates from behind the scenes.

Thinking that today is the last chance to be spoiled, the little junior sister mustered up the courage and asked you to carry her.
You are both sorrowful and joyful, a complex mix of emotions.
Her dependence and intimacy towards you are different from those of others‑like water, they are subtle, yet like the sea, they run deep.

As long as you still possess any martial prowess and have breath in your body, the Kongtong Mystic Skill will relentlessly pursue and hunt you down.

Kongtong is a reputable righteous sect. Yan Jiang blushed, but he was straightforward with no way out. So he resolved to jump off the stage with the determination to break his legs, bowing down to apologize and thank you.
You're furious at Kongtong, stepping forward with a bad temper. If he still wants to fight, I'll go all the way.
You are angry at Kongtong, though you can't act out of anger due to etiquette, so you restrain your temper and step forward to listen to his words. If he intends to fight, you aren't afraid.

I can assure you that I will take credit for this with the Fire Dragon Immortal Monarch. Not a single 'thank you' was uttered throughout, but my gratitude is clearly evident.

Everyone was well aware of Jinwu Shangren's misconduct before he took his vows. Upon his approach, he immediately concluded with certainty that Jinwu Shangren's flesh garment was undoubtedly made from an immortal's blood and flesh.

Jinwu Shangren's notorious deeds before he became a monk were well‑known to everyone. The people from Kongtong Mountain witnessed Jinwu Shangren shedding his skin to escape with their own eyes, and were all shocked into silence for a long while, unable to utter a word.\nAmong those who had a close relationship with him and interacted closely, not one person perceived his true nature.

Happiness is happiness, but we must not forget that there's someone behind Jinwu Shangren who is truly the mastermind of everything.\nThey only consider it revenge and justice served if the mastermind behind everything is removed.
I can only feel at ease by pulling on your sleeve.

Little Junior Sister was overwhelmed with joy, on the verge of tears. She felt both grateful and proud toward you. She wasn't sure if it was an illusion, but she always felt you had suddenly grown a bit taller, making you seem a bit farther away from her.

The eldest brother's great vengeance has been achieved. Not only do the Tang Clan brothers and sisters admire you to the point of prostration, but all the guests, martial heroes and heroines, and local elders in the audience applauded enthusiastically, with thunderous applause.
The Nine‑Lives Leopard's last remaining life is snuffed out by your hands; it will never revive.

He was consumed by desires, his ambitions still unfulfilled, unwilling to die, desperately clinging to the mortal world. Other slanderous words he could endure, but insulting your beloved was intolerable. He fired another arrow, finally bringing this great evil to its end.

He touched the smoke bomb in his pocket, and you anticipated his escape. This monster can no longer hide within the Kongtong Sect, indirectly preventing a major righteous sect from falling into the hands of villains.

Such a ruthless and wicked scoundrel is beyond tolerance in this world. You threw a dart with your hand, finally bringing this great evil to justice. The last of Nine Lives Leopard's remaining lives ended at your hands, and it will never rise again.

His eyes were wide with disbelief. He never thought you would guess that he faked his death. Your single sword strike left him severely injured; the blade went straight into the hilt and cut a large gash. No living being could survive such a blow.
Jinwu Shangren felt a chill to the bone. It was only now that he truly believed he would die, not at the hands of an absolute master, but in the clutches of a mere bandit, someone whose life nobody considered worth mentioning.
Thinking of this, he suddenly realized it: He was mistaken; you are not just a mere lackey. You are very strong and should not be underestimated.
In this desperate situation, there was no time to consider face or reputation; survival was the priority. He pulled out a distracting smoke grenade and threw it to the ground with force. Miraculously, he managed to escape like a golden cicada shedding its shell, leaving behind his bulk as he leaped into the air.
Without needing others to shout warnings, you immediately turned swiftly, spun your sword, and slashed down, cutting back Jinwu Shangren.

If you don't want to let go, you still have to let go.
May she bloom with a smile in a place forever spring‑like and warm.

The sound of firecrackers and drums shook the sky, but you paid them no mind.\nI deliberately didn't want to hear from her and didn't wish to know who she ultimately chose.\nHe dared not approach her; he buried himself under the cotton blanket.

You may not think you can win, but you're unwilling to surrender without fighting. You'd rather lose with honor than concede without a fight.\nThis matter is far more than just a matter of life and death. At most, a blade or sword can take one's life, but if the little junior sister rejects you, the heartache would be enough to kill you ten times over. Facing away from the light, you walk into the darkness, believing there will never be a dawn again.

\nJust returning to the compound, I was met with people offering congratulations and well‑wishes, their words sharp and pricking.\nYou darted into the darkness like you were fleeing, fearing that the bright and joyous candlelight would illuminate your face.

Time flies, and moments pass like threading a shuttle. In the days to come, everything will feel like a hurried glance at flowers.\nEvery time I snap back to reality, it feels like living it all over again.

Yunshang tightly held onto you, fearing that you might disappear. Always a person who needed to be pampered, they reassured you not to be afraid and not to cry, nearly begging for you not to forget them.\nYou couldn't understand why tears fell, wanting to freeze time right at this moment and hold her small hand in yours. Buried under the quilt, there's no need to worry about dignity.\nNo one can hear your scream
Rui Sheng came without knowing when; you haven't even teased him about becoming a newlywed yet, but when he saw you, he looked very flustered.
You might be tired, or perhaps the wine's fragrance has lured you into a daze, leaving you drowsy and reluctant to wake up.

Of course, you'd say you would give your all and stake your life.
But isn't everyone struggling to survive in this world?
If there had been no one else intervening just now, you would have died at Jinwu Shangren's hands.
Your full strength and even your life are not sufficient to protect the one you love.
Even though he knew these words would be unfair to you, he still prepared himself to say them. He couldn't let you avoid the truth and regret it for the rest of your life. Honest advice may be unpleasant to hear, but it is a friend's duty.

But you were defeated by Jinwu Shangren\nRui Sheng finally realized that they were not up to the task.\nYour breadth of spirit and courage, he has always admired. But with your current martial arts skills navigating the Jianghu, it's every step is difficult. If Miss Tang were to follow you, how would you protect her?

But you lost to Jinwu Shangren\nRui Sheng realized then that they were not up to the task.\nYour chest and charisma, he has always admired. But with your neigong ruined and your power diminished, it will be extremely difficult for you to navigate the Jianghu in your current state. If Miss Tang were to follow you, how would you protect her?

When he went down the mountain and heard you talking to Little Junior Sister, he could already sense the deep concern in your words and the reluctant attachment in her eyes.
The onlooker sees clearly and can't help but feel that you two are mutually attracted.
You surely wouldn't believe it, so he didn't elaborate. In that moment, his affection for the little junior sister suddenly surged. Originally, he only found her delicate and tender, appealing in her vulnerability. At that time, seeing her pure heart, he felt even more admiration.
Jealous of you yet rejoicing for you, celebrating immensely, I've been planning to gracefully step aside from this since then. After all, such a tale deserves to exist in the mortal world, and I can look forward to teasing some immortal in the future.

You saw him suddenly anxious, suspecting he wanted to kill you when you were alone. Though it was a joke, the faint fear in your eyes still left Rui Sheng speechless. He considered himself on the righteous path, not understanding how he had become so unworthy in your eyes, and he had the audacity to call you his friend.

Fourth Senior Brother originally intended to ask Rui Sheng to protect the flowers, but Rui Sheng refused on the grounds of fairness and left a step ahead of you.\nThey only stopped to speak when they reached the heart of the forest.

Fourth Senior Brother fears that Kongtong's people might return with a sudden attack, so he is escorting Little Junior Sister up the mountain and sending more people to ensure additional security.\nPlease walk a bit slower and bring up the rear. Surround Little Junior Sister and escort her back up the mountain.
Although we have sent all the Kongtong people and horses away, the matter isn't over yet. The urgent task at hand is still to send the Little Junior Sister back to the mountain.

Upon seeing the scene, even the people and troops of Kongtong frowned and pointed at each other. Even those who were as ruthless and domineering as they might be could not ignore the code of honor in the Jianghu.\nIn a duel to the death, life and death are destiny; one cannot blame another for that. However, deceiving an opponent by stopping then launching a surprise attack‑such methods are decidedly not within the realm of proper conduct.\nSeeing the person in Jinwu Middle Man provoke widespread anger, they were cursed until their faces turned red, and they could neither defend themselves nor bear to stay for long.
