That Jinwu Shangren was originally not intending to take your life with this hammer strike; he was instead using his internal force.
Although a sneak attack is generally despised, most people tend to remain silent if he didn't kill anyone. In such a situation, one can still adopt the posture of a righteous high monk and remind you not to be complacent in battle, avoid the main issues, obscure facts, and turn black into white.
You will undoubtedly be furious at the time. Why not fight for a while? Once the dark force surges to your head, you'll lose all resistance. He will then launch a fierce attack and subdue you before letting you go lightly.
Would others not praise him for his compassionate heart and generous demeanor?

Not only was this disrupting what should have been a joyful day, but they had agreed to a contest where no one would be killed, just a point at most. Master Jinwu bound himself with his own cocoon, leaving no room for denial. He couldn't claim that one hammer strike wouldn't kill a person; all he could say was that it would turn a person into a intellectual cripple.

Fourth Senior Brother will remain to clean up the mess, and has entrusted the mission of escorting Little Junior Sister to you. Thanks to Rui Sheng's help, the matter isn't over yet.

You don't give a damn about him. You ran to the Tang Clan to cause trouble, died on your own accord, and still have a bunch of demands. Your face is really thick.
Not only do you not care, but you also plan to leave his body by the roadside to feed the wild dogs.
He heard these words and died with a guilty conscience, even his fourth senior brother broke out in a cold sweat. He knew you were ruthless, but he never expected it to be this extreme. You're not just evil to the core; you're evil beyond measure. The Four Great Bandits, Song Wang Tianfang, would be shocked into silence if they saw you.

You respect him as a man of honor, ask him for his final words. His gaze at this moment no longer brims with hostility. Please have him cremated, scatter his ashes in the wind, let him fly away with the wind, and ascend to immortality.

While you might not have been ignored in the Flying Heaven Sect before, seeing him treated this way still fills you with pity.\nYou wanted to bring him back to Kongtong for burial, but he wasn't grateful. His gaze towards you no longer held any hostility, and simply calling him Senior Brother was enough to make him consider you one of his own.\nI bestow upon you the secret techniques from my body. I instruct you to cremate his remains and scatter the ashes to the wind, allowing him to ascend to immortality with the breeze.

That Jinwu Shangren did not dare to inflict a fatal attack on you earlier. Now, having given up, he is mercilessly killing his own people.\nYan Jiang never considered that Jinwu Shangren would attack him. There was no time to muster any defense, let alone dodge or dissipate the force. He was struck directly, and his ribcage and internal organs were completely mangled. It seemed there was no saving him now.\nHe was indeed a tough guy. He wouldn't die willingly on Tang Clan land; you should take him as far away as possible while he still has a breath left in him.

That Jinwu Shangren feigned defeat to launch a surprise attack; this hammer was originally meant not to take your life but to apply a hidden force.
Although ambushing is generally considered despicable, most onlookers might not say much if they see he didn't kill anyone. With that in mind, he could continue to play the role of a righteous monk, reminding you not to be complacent in battle, avoid the main issues, and distort facts‑turning black into white.
You will undoubtedly be furious at the time. Why not fight for a while? When the dark energy begins to surge to your head, you won't have the strength to resist anymore. He can then attack fiercely and subdue you before lightly letting you go.
Won't others then praise him for his compassionate heart and magnanimous demeanor?
However, things did not go as he had anticipated. The surprise attack failed and instantly stirred up the guests' anger. They all called him a wicked monk. Not only did he cause disruption on such a happy day, but his tactics also revealed how inferior his skills were. Moreover, by feigning defeat and launching a sneak attack, the honorable Kongtong Sect, which ranks among the Six Major Factions, acted so disgracefully. How could this possibly win the crowd's respect?
Even the people and cavalry of Kongtong Mountain were furrowing their brows and pointing at something in surprise.
Jinwu Shangren had not yet become the Sect Leader; he merely took advantage of the situation to make grand declarations, gaining the trust of the four Sect Leaders. Only then could he lead his people on a long journey to cause trouble in Shu, seeking revenge on someone's wedding day‑a move that was already unreasonable. Losing a duel only made matters worse.
Victory and defeat are common in military affairs, and if that were all, it would not provoke widespread anger. However, by feigning defeat and attempting a surprise attack when others are unprepared, such methods clearly do not align with the principles of righteous conduct.
Seeing the person in the Golden Solar Bird pose anger from the crowd, they were cursed and reviled to the point of having dog blood dripping down their heads. They couldn't defend themselves and had no face to linger for long. An internal conflict arose, with the Mystic Skill guardian leading the way in apologizing to the Tang Clan and bidding farewell. Following suit, the Iron Fist and Soul Stealer guardians also departed one after another, leaving only the Flying Heavenly Guardian Yan Jiang still unwilling to give up, feeling both ashamed and angry.
Although he was inwardly resentful, he still wanted to protect his own senior brother. After all, people on the same boat should work together and support each other.
Such a grave offense does not permit outsiders to intercede. Once we return to the Flying Heaven Sect Hall at Kongtong Mountain, we will close the doors and ask the Sect Leader of Flying Heaven to mete out punishment according to the sect rules.
He was loyal and chivalrous, but Jinwu Shangren did not care about that.  His scheme had failed, and he was shouted at to be killed. He was already furious and in a state of desperation. Seeing Yan Jiang still dare to hassle him, his anger intensified even more, leaving no room for mercy. With one hammer strike, it hit his chest right on target, knocking him down and allowing the attacker to flee.

Not long after you escaped, the True Qi of the Fiery Sun Hammer flared up, causing him to fall to the ground and convulse. He suffered from a high fever and when he woke up, he remembered nothing. All that remained was Jinwu Shangren's malicious grin, forever etched in his mind.

That night, Third Senior Brother and Fourth Senior Brother prepared wine for you to drink together.\nWhen they spoke of the Tang Clan's glorious past, everyone felt a myriad of emotions, as if it were from another era. They couldn't help but feel sorrow well up within them and cried together, shoulder to shoulder. Third Senior Brother wanted to prepare wine for you to share a drink together, but you politely declined.
You are really too tired. There is no longer a little junior sister here, so it's impossible to wake up as if nothing happened after feeling wronged, like we used to.
Receive just a bit more stimulation, and you might die suddenly.

You waited many years for this day, and it was something that had been decided long ago.
The only thing I can do for her in this life is to quietly step back.
Right now, all you want is to sleep soundly and wake up naturally, or never wake up again.

You and Third Senior Brother and Fourth Senior Brother were having tea in the Lecture Hall and detailed the events of that day.

Now that Little Junior Sister has married and ensured the Tang family lineage, it finally settles one major concern.

Jinwu Shangren grew increasingly fearful with each battle. Although he succeeded in ambushing you initially, his defeat in their first confrontation still left him badly injured.

Decided to admit defeat in front of everyone.
You were taken aback for a moment. At this moment, you don't know what to do. It's inappropriate to act or refrain from acting in front of all these guests.

Jinwu Shangren is inherently cruel and violent. He has killed many renowned wandering warriors. Before taking their lives, he would first humiliate and degrade them, drawing pictures of their dying grotesque appearances as prized treasures.
You are not even worthy of them. You do not have the qualifications to be remembered or to die at their hands. As a mere mortal, you should have self‑awareness and submit like the countless ordinary people. Others can kill you if they want; you must die. Even if the Kongtong Sect retreats, one could argue that it's like a strong dragon not being able to suppress a local snake‑retreat now to bring reinforcements and regroup for another attempt later.
On the contrary, if you follow his advice and challenge him to a duel with a skilled opponent, that would suit me perfectly.
By just weakening and eliminating the remaining skilled members of your Tang Clan, it would be akin to snuffing out the flickering flame of the Tang Clan. At that point, the disciples within the clan will surely feel a bleak future ahead, and when all but the most devoted have dispersed like birds and beasts, the Tang Clan will be left as nothing more than an empty shell.

During his studies abroad, Rui Sheng traveled to various martial arts schools and once visited Diancang out of admiration, hoping to see the Azure Pine Swordmaster. At that time, Ye Yunzhao was already in a foreign land, so they only managed to catch a glimpse of each other.
At this moment, these two young skilled experts were seeing each other's true faces for the first time.
One side maintained a steady stance, like hidden lightning clouds waiting to strike; it would remain silent until it made a startling impact. The other side's posture was seamlessly natural, like wind and mist, with flaws and movements constantly changing unpredictably around them.
The two couldn't help but place their hands on their weapons, exchanging attacks with their intentions already clashing before the moves were even made.
You hurriedly moved to the center to separate them, fearing that these two might end up clashing if they found each other equally matched.
Ye Yunzhao arrived just in time. If it weren't for him being called up and down the mountain by his younger sister, Jinwu Shangren wouldn't have been so bold.

Little Junior Sister came with you. You were afraid she might make a mistake and told her to hide first. She listened and stayed hidden for a while before jumping out.\nAs soon as she appeared, the rumors vanished like smoke and clouds. When everyone saw this young girl's glance, her expression was both clear and cold, untouched by worldly smoke and fire. Clear as ice and clean as jade. Who would still believe what Jinwu Shangren said?\nPublic opinion turned against them rapidly. Golden Solar Monk was about to say a few cutting words when he met his junior nun's clear gaze and suddenly found himself speechless. He awkwardly fell silent instead.

These four individuals are renowned masters in the Jianghu, and just by observing their posture and demeanor, they stand apart from other Kongtong disciples like a world apart.\nYou and Fourth Senior Brother were both secretly alarmed after meeting. Dealing with just one of them would be difficult enough, let alone four, especially with Jinwu Shangren added to the mix. Looking at your side, while there are many people, few can match their skill level. The outcome of a fight would be unpredictable. However, regardless of winning or losing, outsiders would only laugh at Tang Clan for relying on numbers to intimidate others. Isn't that both a loss of face and substance?
Your personality is fierce; how could merely shouting a name scare you away? On the contrary, Fourth Senior Brother remained calm and quickly persuaded you to think carefully.

You once studied at Kongtong, and all know that these Four Guardians are no ordinary figures; they are the top talents among the four gates. There might be those even stronger than Jinwu Shangren, and they couldn't help but feel a chill of apprehension.

Jinwu Shangren has been hesitating to act and even boasted about challenging Tang Clan masters, all to avoid the reputation of bullying the weak with numbers. You bringing people down the mountain exactly fits his plan, positioning yourself in your own camp and summoning the four guardians.

Who wouldn't spill some dirty water? Since he didn't show benevolence, don't blame me for not showing righteousness!
A barrage of profanity immediately spilled out. The Fourth Senior Brother's shrewdness and eloquence were both top‑notch; you might as well end up in the same predicament if you tried to reason with him head‑on. But you didn't want to do that. When you got going, your sharp tongue left no one spared‑not a single dirty word was needed to kill someone. This hateful Jinwu Shangren just made you want to unleash all your profanity, how crude and vulgar it could be, every curse laden with the most obscene words, ruthless to the core.
Even Jinwu Shangren, who had been smiling on the outside but not inside, was eventually exposed by your curse. If it weren't for someone holding him back, he would have immediately rushed forward to fight you to the death.
Your barrage of profanity was utterly without reason and incredibly crude, making the foul words of Jinwu Shangren seem even less convincing by comparison. They now appear not as offensive as they once did.
You arrived just in time, heard these words, and became furious beyond control, then punched Jinwu Shangren back.

With the preceding conversation as preparation, Jinwu Shangren shifted the topic directly to address the little junior sister.
Wearing a large red monk robe, one would expect this person to be a Buddhist practitioner engaged in good deeds. Yet the words that come out of their mouth are extremely wicked, slanderously accusing Senior Brother and Little Junior Sister of engaging in premarital misconduct. Had it not been for Little Junior Sister's pregnancy, why would Tang Clan hastily marry their daughter and convene all heroes from across the land to gather in Shu? It was nothing but a scheme; in reality, they just wanted to find a scapegoat to serve as an easy father for their unborn child.
Of course, these words are malicious fabrications that cannot withstand scrutiny and will collapse on their own with time. There is no need for the Fourth Senior Brother to refute them.
However, Jinwu Shangren's intent is not to win by speaking the truth, but to spread rumors. He has pinpointed the mindset of people in Jianghu who love to gossip and enjoy watching performances. Regardless of how he twists or distorts the facts, once the news spreads, the Tang Clan's reputation will certainly be ruined.
And see which one happens first: his lies are exposed, or the Tang Clan becomes a target for public outrage and is exterminated. By the time the truth is revealed, it will be too late for them to do anything about it. At that point, he will assume the position of leader at Kongtong Mountain with ease and simply wipe out the entire Tang Clan.

Senior Brother strolls through the Jianghu, naturally living a carefree and unrestrained life, with both praise and criticism. Whether enemy or ally, they both look up to him and are annoyed by him. He feels candid and open‑hearted but has no intention of attracting countless girls who secretly adore him. Many envy him, and those who spread rumors and slander him are not few in number.\nNow, Jinwu Shangren has presented this matter as half true and half false, making it seem entirely plausible. The Kongtong disciples are all deeply convinced, filled with righteous indignation. Even the guests and locals present can't help but have their doubts.

Meanwhile, Jinwu Shangren and his followers were causing a commotion outside the outer fortress. They used Senior Brother's former illustrious name from many years ago‑triple incursions into the Kongtong Sect to view Xiahou Lan's beauty‑as an excuse. Additionally, they falsely accused Senior Brother of using evil arts and poison to harm him. In order to destroy the Tang Clan's reputation utterly, even their own family members were dragged into it, alleging that the two had engaged in immoral behavior, going against societal norms. As a result, Xiahou Lan was also tainted by constant exposure, becoming cunningly vicious and poisonous.
Now, Xiahou Lan has been missing for several months. It is likely that she, like the Flying Stone Gang Leader's Lady, has fallen into the clutches of your Tang Clan lechers.
Xiahou Lan is not an ordinary female disciple. She is a direct disciple of the Soul Stealer Sect under Kongtong Mountain. The Four Beauties of Kongtong are all direct transmissions from their respective sects and will eventually marry the headmaster's son, serving as a crucial strategy to strengthen their own standing.
Desecrating the unmarried wife of Kongtong Palm Sect's unengaged practitioner is akin to insulting the entire Kongtong sect. This is something that can be endured; what else cannot be tolerated? How could this fail to incite righteous indignation among the Kongtong disciples?
Senior Brother moves through the Jianghu, naturally living a carefree life that brings both praise and criticism. Whether friend or foe, they are both fond of him and resentful toward him. He feels his heart is open and honest but has no intention of attracting the affection of countless young women. Many envy him, and there are also many who slander and defame him.
Now that Jinwu Shangren speaks with such conviction and intensity, it's impossible for the crowd not to doubt his words.

At the other side, Jinwu Shangren led his people to cause trouble in the outer fortress. Using the excuse that Little Bamboo Zeng temporarily stayed at the Tang Clan to study, they falsely accused Senior Brother Susu of having wicked intentions and trying to plot something improper. This forced them to persecute Kongtong's direct female disciple.\nThe Four Beauties of Kongtong are all direct disciples of the Four Gates. They will eventually marry into the sect as wives to consolidate their own positions.\nPolluting the unmarried wife of Kongtong Mountain Palm Sect's disciple is equivalent to insulting the Kongtong Mountains themselves. Such an outrage cannot be tolerated; how could we allow the Kongtong disciples not to be filled with righteous indignation?

Meanwhile, Jinwu Shangren and his people were causing a commotion outside the outer fortress. They used the excuse that Xiao Mei had temporarily stayed at the Tang Clan to impugn Senior Brother Suxing's intentions, suggesting he was plotting something sinister. This led to persecution of Kongtong's female disciple who was directly taught by the founder.\nThe four beauties of Kongtong are all direct disciples of the Four Gates. They will eventually marry the leaders appointed by the sect, thereby serving as crucial stepping stones to solidify their own positions.\nDesecrating the unmarried wife of Kongtong Palm Sect's unmarried disciple is equivalent to insulting the Kongtong Sect. If this can be tolerated, then what cannot? How could the Kongtong disciples not be filled with righteous indignation?

\nMeanwhile, Jinwu Shangren led his followers to stir up trouble outside the outer fortress. Using the excuse that Little Mei and Little Bamboo had once stayed at the Tang Clan, they falsely accused Senior Brother Suxing of plotting misdeeds and persecuted the direct female disciple of Kongtong.

Little Junior Sister's heart, which had been painstakingly opened, once again closed tightly. The sound of bells gradually faded into calmness, obediently going home alone, never to be clingy to others again.
Not sparing her a scowl, they scolded her‑this was the first time, perhaps also the last in this life.
Although you're smiling and speaking sweet words, your mind is already made up.
Even so, you remain iron‑hearted; since making up your mind, you have never wavered.

You knew you shouldn't, but you still took the little junior sister's small hand and led her down the mountain to face the enemy together.\nThe little junior sister was both surprised and happy, finally managing to laugh through her tears.\nIf you continue to act without regard for consequences, you are truly a sin of the Tang Clan. Yet in the eyes of Little Junior Sister, you are the most trustworthy person under heaven. She is willing to walk through flames and blades with you, holding your hand.

At this moment, Rui Sheng suddenly fluttered forward to take the lead. The little junior sister was startled and immediately huddled behind you for protection.
He saw the Little Junior Sister leave her seat and did not return for a long time. He exchanged glances with two competitors, the Third Senior Brother, and their conversation was full of polite pleasantries. Unable to contain his frustration, he decided to use the restroom as an excuse to leave and take a stroll. From afar, he noticed several flickering lights on a winding path deep in the forest, presumably indicating that someone was carrying lanterns down the mountain. Curiosity piqued, he leisurely drifted towards them.  His neigong was profound, allowing him to hear your conversation from a distance before approaching. He felt a mix of astonishment, shame, envy, and relief. There was even an underlying sense of amusement, making it truly a complex array of emotions.
He purposely showed up, volunteering to use his qinggong to drive away the enemies for the Tang Clan without waiting for you to persuade him to stay. He then descended the mountain using his light and agile movements.
You and your Little Junior Sister can only follow.

The little junior sister blocked you, interrogated you about your whereabouts, and no amount of persuasion would make her change her mind. This is unprecedented and unparalleled stubbornness.
She was awkward at expressing herself and couldn't convey her thoughts fully, causing tears to well up in her eyes desperately.
He has been up on the mountain for so long that he can't even remember the way back home.
Each time she saw people leave, there was a chance they might never return. First it was her mother, then her father, followed by Second Senior Brother, and finally even Big Senior Brother disappeared without a trace.
Do you expect me to leave without so much as a word?
Since it's her big day, shouldn't you be accompanying her? At the very least, you should have brought her with you.
As the words spilled from her lips, tears fell in rapid succession. The bell rang softly, and the heavens and earth responded with a silent crack, rendering their efforts futile.

The little junior sister was unable to eat or swallow at the sight of the three husband choices. At the banquet table, she appeared lost and bewildered. Everyone only thought she was shy and paid no mind, completely unaware that she was sitting on pins and needles.
Excuses aside, she claimed she needed some time to herself and went to the window sill to take in the fresh air. She leaned on the rail, watching the guests below laughing and chatting merrily‑a scene that vaguely reminded her of times past. Deep in thought, her heart ached. Just then, from the corner of her eye, she saw you carrying a lantern step out of the monastery gates. Without hesitation, Little Junior Sister felt an inexplicable surge of anxiety and fear, and she leaped after you. In just a few bounds, she had already darted ahead of you.
You were taken aback and urgently brought your steps to a halt. The junior disciples following behind had no time to react and ended up colliding with each other, pinning you down. One of the thrown darts was still embedded in your body.
The little junior sister helped me sit up. Seeing that she had something to discuss with me, the others left one by one. They all went outside.

Though you felt uneasy about it, you knew that there was no way to avoid it. Third Senior Brother needed to remain in the main courtyard, so you couldn't expect him to go down the mountain to face the enemy. This would prevent disturbing the guests at the banquet and thus protect Little Junior Sister's reputation.\nThinking of this, you can only musters your courage to stand up for your sect.
You were taken aback first, completely at a loss as to why the Tang Clan had ever offended the Kongtong Sect.
You first froze, then erupted in fury. Even if the two factions were at odds, there was no justification for deliberately choosing someone's wedding day to stir up trouble.

You heard the words and were furious beyond measure. The death of the Master Brother hasn't been avenged yet, and you dare to come to the door and bully him, which can be said to be extremely arrogant and overbearing.

Just about to enter the house to eat, suddenly a junior disciple ran up the mountain in a hurry, holding a lantern and delivering news.
They said that the Golden Sparrow from Kongtong was bringing people to cause trouble, and was currently making a ruckus in the outer baodi, threatening to challenge Tang Clan's top expert.
Everyone knew this person had come with malicious intent, arriving neither too soon nor too late but precisely at the critical moment. It was clear they knew the Tang Clan was hosting a celebration and deliberately came to stir up trouble.
Fourth Senior Brother was hosting guests in the outer fortress when he saw the situation and immediately brought people to block them. However, it seemed that the other party had come prepared, making it impossible to stop them easily. They could only barely hold them back and send someone up the mountain to summon reinforcements.

Fourth Senior Brother took the funds from Third Senior Brother and personally covered the expenses to invite Four Six Bureau, using their external fortress kitchen to prepare a variety of dishes. He then served these in warming trays and brought them up the mountain to entertain guests.\nAlthough they couldn't match the Nangong Family's generous efforts, everyone still contributed their share of strength.

You were tasked by Second Senior Brother to recall your senior brother, who had been mixing around in the kitchen for years and was quite skilled at cooking.\nHe had long wanted to contribute to his sect, and this time he spared no effort, mobilizing his connections to gather his former colleagues. All four departments and six bureaus converged on the outer fortress, creating a grand spectacle that benefited not only the residents of the outer fortress but also the local villagers.\nFourth Senior Brother sent people to the county hall with food to greet and make contact. The magistrate stepped out of his residence and saw streets filled with laughter and joy. He couldn't help but tongue‑click in admiration, wondering if a high‑ranking official from the imperial court had come to visit, which would explain such a grand display.

The outcome of the contest is now clear. While martial arts skill, martial integrity and virtue, as well as education and family background are also considered, most people know that the disparity in strength is significant, and any hope for a different result has long been abandoned. Thankfully, coming here to witness such an event was worthwhile; not only can we partake in the celebration and bask in the joy, but we can also meet heroes from all over the land and broaden our horizons.\nToday's battle, particularly the final clash, was thrilling beyond measure. Applause echoed loudly, and this alone made the journey of thousands of miles for everyone to gather in Shu worth it.
You damned thing, you didn't scold them, instead you joined in.
You pondered repeatedly, still wanting to witness the charisma of today's chivalrous suitor, leaping onto the roof to watch the duel, while your fellow disciples were gambling.

You sit alone on the edge of the bed, at a loss.\nToday, the person you love is going to promise someone else in marriage‑it's supposed to be happy news, but for some reason, you can't help but feel unable to smile.\nYou seem to be separated from the lively activities outside by a wide gap. There, the sun shines brightly, but you find comfort in staying in the shadows, embracing loneliness and darkness.

The Tang Family Courtyard had limited open space, and after setting up scaffolding, the area became even smaller. Besides those disciples assigned to guard the alchemy room, lecture hall, and hall of cultivating the mind, everyone else had to crowd into their dormitories, peeking through the windows. Some found the space too cramped and even climbed onto the roof to watch.

Only after Emei's Jie Wuchen took action did the little junior sister begin to regard her with new eyes.
No matter who challenges him, they merely bow slightly and are then kicked down with one foot. If the second foot doesn't knock them down, a third or even a flying kick will do the job. His leg techniques are incredibly fast and unparalleled. After battling for several rounds, not a single person can land a single blow on him; it's always his one‑sided attack.
This time, not only did Third Senior Brother approve, but Little Junior Sister also secretly admired: This Jie Wuchen has such high martial arts skills, how come Senior Brother used to often say he was bad at it?
Actually, Jie Wuchen, who is known as the Wind God and ranks alongside Flying Hero, has a stronger foundation of resilience compared to his Senior Brother. Therefore, in the Jianghu, he often faces defeats, with his record far worse than that of his Senior Brother. This is because his Senior Brother is naturally cunning, and when they fight, there's no clear advantage for either side. Hence, Jie Wuchen chooses not to provoke him.
In contrast, Jie Wuchen is martial and enjoys battle, placing great importance on reputation. When traveling in the Jianghu, he often seeks out renowned xia to challenge them, which inevitably leads him to face tough opponents.
Senior Brother said he is incompetent, but the incompetence lies elsewhere; it's not about his martial arts skills.

Yunshang's first encounter with the Nangong clan left her speechless upon seeing the grand attire and shoulder armor of the eldest son. She frantically glanced around, noticing that everyone else remained unperturbed, as if only she found everything strange. This sudden feeling of being betrayed and isolated made the world seem unfamiliar all over again.

Nangong Shen sparred with people and adeptly adopted the worldliness of a Jianghu affairs handler. He remained calm and composed, standing invincible while also understanding others' feelings. Every member of the other group grew increasingly envious as they fought, but his eldest son's opponent often appeared pleased even after losing, showing genuine admiration.

A series of young martial artists took the stage and left it, each showing off their abilities, but all were found to be lacking in impressiveness when observed by the little junior sister.
She did not often venture into the Jianghu, and even less frequently engaged in combat with others, so her experience in battle was shallow. However, she had maintained focus and concentration for many years, delving deeply into the Tang Clan's martial arts secrets. Her perspective was so high that it surpassed that of her third senior brother.
These martial artists that Third Senior Brother praised endlessly seem quite odd to Little Junior Sister's eyes.
It seemed they were only focused on whether their techniques could generate a magnificent momentum, completely disregarding the possibility of exposing flaws by overexerting themselves. If these people couldn't even defeat themselves, why did they still feel so proud?

Third Senior Brother accompanied Little Junior Sister, commenting on the martial artists in the arena while secretly observing her expression. However, the Little Junior Sister remained expressionless, revealing nothing.

You Yunshang's girl suddenly appeared beside the Little Junior Sister as if it was entirely natural, and she started offering evaluations.
Basically, all the comments she could utter were harsh, ranging from nitpicking to undermining. Even her fellow disciples' Senior Brother from Diancang Sect was spared no criticism.
In Yunshang's eyes, there was not a single man worthy of Moling in this world. She feared that her Ice Soul Pure Spirit nature, being innocent and naive, might make her see everyone as good, leading to a lifetime of misplaced affection.
Regretting not being a man, I would have already abducted this lass and wouldn't be worried about her now.

\nA tent was erected in the training grounds, and practitioners from various schools of martial arts took turns to demonstrate their skills in the center. They competed not only in martial prowess but also in martial virtues and morality. Who wouldn't want to showcase their abilities before the little junior sister to leave a lasting impression and win over her favor?
After a few words, Jie Wuchen flew into the sky and vanished. You looked at the night, still unable to figure out why he had come.

However, you refused\nYou may want to become a great hero and gain fame, but you certainly don't want to get beaten up. Moreover, involving yourself with someone like Jie Wuchen, who is notoriously belligerent and a madman in martial arts, would surely be more troublesome than you can handle. Senior Brother is a prime example of this.\nFighting a hundred times seems ordinary, but if you think about it carefully, wouldn't normal people get tired of such endless arguments? This is why Senior Brother always looks unhappy whenever he mentions Jie Wuchen.
You were delighted to the utmost and swore an oath by clapping hands with him.
Your eyes brim with expectation. Wait until the day your martial arts are perfected, when the Jianghu clears up, the sky turns blue, and the winds and waves are calm, then come back to spar.

Jie Wuchen pulled you into a sparring session, as if there was deeper meaning behind it. He deliberately allowed you to showcase your skills, and you didn't disappoint him. The two of you exchanged blows, each countering the other's attacks. You identified a minor vulnerability in his technique that wasn't a clear flaw but still gave you an opening, and you seized the opportunity with a powerful attack, winning the encounter.\nJie Wuchen smiled and gracefully concluded his move with pleasure.

Jie Wuchen seems to have a deeper meaning; he deliberately allowed you the space to show your prowess, only defeating you after fully assessing your abilities.\nI can't teach you martial arts, but he intends to strengthen your spirit, making you robust and resilient. A shift in your mindset might alter your destiny significantly.\nAfter a moment, Jie Wuchen flew away into the sky. You looked at the night and still couldn't figure out what he had come for.

Jie Wuchen is the Wu Chi. Upon hearing the words, he was greatly enraged. He had already heard about this matter long ago; among the various major clans in Central China, they all disapproved of it and believed that the Tang Clan fabricated these tales to wrongfully accuse innocent people with malicious intent.\nJie Wuchen, however, alone refuted everyone's opinion. He would eventually attack Qingcheng and challenge ShenTu Long to settle the score for his senior brother and incidentally also take revenge for you.

When he sparred with you, he vaguely sensed that your internal energy couldn't keep up with the moves. According to what one would expect, techniques that should have residual power should still have some strength left, but he couldn't figure out why they were all lacking in follow‑through.\nOnly after asking did I learn that you were harmed by the Swallowing Heaven Magic Technique, and all of your inner power has been rendered useless. The worst part is fearing that you may never be able to recover to your original state in this lifetime.
After a fierce battle, you were crushed by Jie Wuchen's storm‑like assault.
Though you may not know what he's thinking, this secret manual is a genuine treasure. Fearing he might change his mind, he hurriedly thanked and put it into his bosom.

You really couldn't take it upon yourself to accept it hastily. You asked him again, and learned that Jie Wuchen also wished to sell this secret manual as quickly as possible. He was deeply devoted to martial arts and didn't want to take on a disciple that might hinder his progress. However, the image of the ancestor master from his dreams scolded him every night for being unworthy and only caring about himself, neglecting Emei's legacy. This made Jie Wuchen frequently wake up in the middle of the night in a state of alarm, suspecting that there might be a ghost residing within this secret manual. He wanted to burn it but was always too afraid to do so. Moreover, he couldn't find an appropriate successor.
Sure, since you are the disciple of his old friend, you can also be considered a junior to him. Given that you have already studied at Kongtong, it's likely that he wouldn't mind having his name casually hung on Mount Emei as part of the story, just for show.
With this secret technique now having a successor, he has fulfilled his duty to the sect. Isn't everyone happy about that?
Before you could even protest, he darted away.

Jie Wuchen took out a secret manual from his pocket called *Serpent Rabbit Eagle Monkey Combat* and gave it to you. This isn't just any martial art; it's one of the most formidable techniques in the Emei School, and also one of the finest forms of Xin Yi Quan in the entire world.\nObtaining such a precious secret manual brings joy. However, precisely because it represents a top school's expertise, it is far from trivial. Unlike other martial arts, where practice might yield results that are only half‑baked, others may still choose to turn a blind eye.

You're just being impulsive to show off your extensive network by immediately claiming that you know Liu E and have a good relationship with them.
Liu E also had a deep ill‑fated connection with Jie Wuchen. Not only did he defeat Jie Wuchen in public, but he also forced him to rename his unique ultimate technique Wind Thunder Divine Foot as Really Hard Kick, going to great lengths to humiliate him.
For this, Jie Wuchen can no longer use his secret martial arts. You've really pushed the envelope again by bringing up that issue. He fell silent for a moment before changing his mind and breaking off their connection. Originally, he had wanted to give you some sort of gift, but now he has abandoned that idea as well.
You're so annoying. Isn't it natural for people to dislike you?

He bestowed upon you his secret manual, though he lost to Dharma King Liu E of the Mud Cult in a wager. He was forced to rename his unique martial arts as 'Very Forceful Kick,' shaming him so that he could never use it again. Such an incredible technique should not be wasted; by giving this book to you, I express my feelings and hope you can use it to gain fame in the Jianghu and restore its reputation.

You suddenly heard the name Xiahou Lan from his mouth and, to ensure he believed it, you used a sword technique directly passed down by Xiahou Lan called Snow Mountain Sword Art.\nJie Wuchen stared blankly for a moment, then burst into wild joy. He never expected the workings of fate to be so intricate. Not only are you his lifelong nemesis' junior disciple, but you're also his old friend's apprentice. In a way, your connection with him runs deep.

Jie Wuchen recalled the past decade of their interactions. Both he and Senior Brother were inexperienced youths when they first ventured out, with Tang Buyi always outperforming him in every aspect. He wondered if there was some fate at play, as it seemed they kept running into each other wherever they went. As youthful spirited individuals, they faced off against one another, refusing to back down. Almost every time they met, they had to compete to see who was superior. When they weren't engaging in physical combat, they would compete in other ways.
The famous event in the Wulin involving the Mianyang Bo incident was carried out by the two of them. In order to determine who was superior, they razed the entire water bandit stronghold ahead of the officials, still unable to decide the outcome. Later, when Jie Wuchen joined the official camp, your senior brother took control of the water bandits and held out at the water fortress for ten days. It wasn't until the arrival of the two sect leaders and the Nangong family master that the crisis was resolved. Under the mediation of Nangong Family Master, they appeased the officials and also pacified all the water bandits, ensuring that everyone received their due rewards.
Only Senior Brother and Jie Wuchen were beaten into such a state that they looked like broken wrecks, each returning to the mountain to reflect on their actions.
Jie Wuchen has always found it hard to let go of this matter. He joined the official camp, how could he still be wrong about it?
Such incidents are countless. Just talking about your senior brother makes me seethe with anger.
Although these two archenemies always either quarrel or fight when they meet, they have also walked the Jianghu together on occasion.
Tang Clan's Tang Buyi, Emei's Jie Wuchen, Kongtong's Xiahou Lan, and two other anonymous companions journeyed together. They saw injustice on the road and acted bravely, never fighting unless necessary. From fisticuffs to defeating Jin dynasty warriors, repelling Goryeo's Demon Sect, and battering Lingnan's forces until they were reeling, the final leg of their trip saw the five of them unite to destroy the remnants' ambitious plans for the old Demon Sect.
These all feel like they happened just yesterday. It's as if I had bid farewell to my friends and gone our separate ways only the blink of an eye ago, yet now everything is different‑Qing Mountain remains unchanged, but people are all gone.
Life is fleeting, much like white horses passing through a crevice, with those who come and go, gathering and dispersing like floating ping leaves, leaving one unable to help but feel sorrow.

Jie Wuchen was not hesitant to take the risk and ventured into the rear hills of the Tang Clan without permission. It turned out he only brought some wine and water, intending to pay his respects to Senior Brother instead.
You stood in silence for a moment, leading him to the grave of Senior Brother. Jie Wuchen stood there silently for a long time, saying not a word.
It took a long while before they spoke again. The moment they did, it was with suspicion that their senior brother had feigned death, intending to dig up the grave and open the coffin for inspection. After your kind persuasion, they finally abandoned this notion and accepted the fact that their lifelong nemesis had passed away and was resting in peace nine feet below.
Pulling open the stopper of the wine gourd, even though he didn't particularly like drinking, he still accompanied Senior Brother and took a sip. Then, he passed it to you to have a drink as well.
Though the wine is fragrant and rich, you have no heart to savor it, pouring it instead into the ground to let your departed friend enjoy.
Jie Wuchen was so obsessed with martial arts that it bordered on madness. He unexpectedly caught you practicing, and it was so itchy he couldn't scratch it, completely forgetting his original intent.

Taking advantage of the day still having sunlight left before sunset, you set out alone to the back mountain. You assume your fighting stance and start punching and kicking. Days without anyone pushing you, you've always done this.
Before you could realize it, the sky had grown dark. You were just about to head back when suddenly a figure in white leaped up from the cliff edge. Upon closer inspection, you recognized him as Jie Wuchen, whom you had only managed to persuade to come down the mountain with great difficulty.
He was persuaded to leave and, upon reaching the middle of the mountain, took a different path. He then pulled out a grappling hook used for climbing steep cliffs. Relying on his remarkable qinggong technique, he avoided the suspended walkway and leaped straight into the back of your Tang Clan's mountain.
