Even without evidence, rumors grow more convincing with each passing day.\nThe rumors of the Tang Clan flyer's deep connection with the Dharma King of the Demon Sect spread far and wide.

The Wulin people watching the battle around were even more chaotic than a pot of soup, none of them expecting to come here today, yet unexpectedly had the honor to witness the emergence of the four supreme techniques.
You're absolutely stunned, never imagining that the Eldest Brother still has this ultimate move hidden‑this certainly isn't Tang Clan martial arts at all.

Not only were you left speechless, but your master Xiahou Lan was also visibly shaken.\nThought they had not met for many years, and he himself had perfected his divine martial arts, becoming far beyond what he used to be, if his senior brother did not put in severe effort, he would not stand a chance. Initially, he still found it rather dull and was half‑asleep, but upon seeing this technique, he realized that even she was almost knocked off the tree from surprise.

In the heat of battle, Senior Brother also fought with heightened determination, a spark of inspiration striking immediately as he employed a new technique he had just mastered.
Shi Gongyuan relied on his firm internal strength; even a clear blade or spear found it difficult to penetrate. He showed no fear at all. However, he did not expect that the master senior brother shot out an invisible qi pressure from his fingertips, which pierced through his protective qi layer and emerged from his body.
As everyone knows, when it comes to breaking the body with formless qi strength, there are only the Four Great Techniques of Ancient and Modern Times, specifically the Songshan School's Essence of The Invincible Divine Spear Finger Technique.
Just two decades ago, the Songshan Sect fell in battle against Joyful Teachings. Whether this technique has been lost or preserved is a matter of much debate, and its very existence remains uncertain‑much like Kongtong Swordsmanship, it is merely part of Jianghu legend. In today's world, most people doubt such abilities exist until your senior brother demonstrated it in full view of everyone. Only then did people believe that there truly are such extraordinary techniques capable of killing enemies from beyond the body.
If this technique were acquired by a high monk from Songshan, the world would only admire and respect it. But if it were obtained by a member of the Tangmen known for their expertise in Hidden Weapons, it would instill fear and dread. For you see, members of the Tang Clan care not for societal biases, using ambushes, sneak attacks, and poisons without any reservations. While Hidden Weapons can be defended against due to their tangible nature, Tang Buyi has mastered the divine Spear Technique that can kill even when stripped bare, with his hands bound. Who in the world could possibly guard against him?

Fan Xiaotian, standing by, exclaimed with regret, lamenting that so many copper coins were used as hidden weapons to throw. Even if they were retrieved later, some would inevitably be lost, making it rather wasteful. If these coins were given to her, wouldn't the dogs in the den have meat buns every day?

Your master Xiahou Lan also lost interest, for the skills your elder brother demonstrated today still fell short of those from when they traveled together in the Jianghu. She had come to observe the battle in order to verify her own progress; how could it not leave her deeply disappointed?
Unless he has ulterior motives and is intentionally concealing a move while holding back, this wouldn't make sense.
It's just that I don't know whether he's holding back due to severe injuries that haven't healed yet or if he's concealing a move.

At a glance, it's clear that Senior Master Brother has not exerted his full power. Gang Leader Shi practices external strength to enhance his muscle and bone, while also mastering protective qi cultivation to fortify his body. His resilience is undeniable; however, the Tang Clan is renowned as the foremost experts in hidden weapons across the entire world. Can they be defeated merely because their opponent looks a bit more robust? With Golden Coin Arrows directing force through the acupoints, all it takes is a subtle application of inner power to achieve this. If you can manage it, Senior Master Brother would find it even easier.  Might as well be said of Senior Master Brother.
As the Money Dart proved ineffective, you couldn't help but feel secretly anxious.

On the other side, Senior Brother and Shi Gongyuan have begun fighting. Their martial arts styles are indeed opposite extremes.
One is light and agile, moving like an unpredictable breeze; the other is sturdy and solid, as steady as a mountain.
The money cannot budge Shi Gongyuan's Iron Clothes, and Shi Gongyuan's Iron Arm Divine Fist also cannot touch Tang Buyi's clothes.
With each move and counter, the outcome remains uncertain, keeping the audience in constant excitement.

A low, raspy yet warm and sweet voice crept into my ears, immediately making my heart leap with joy as I realized it was your master Xiahou Lan who had arrived. I then demonstrated Qinggong, leaping onto the tree branch to meet her.

At that moment, a low, raspy yet gentle and sweet voice entered his ears. Instantly, his heart leaped with joy, knowing that it was Master Xiahou Lan who had come. He then unleashed his qinggong, leaping to the tree branches to meet her. His disguised male junior sister, who was masquerading as a beggar with disheveled hair and a grime‑covered face, was also there.

By the time the hour was about to pass, you and the Senior Brother finally arrived leisurely.\nEnemies meeting face to face will glare at each other fiercely, and there's no time for pretentious formalities. They get straight to the point and start fighting with just a few words exchanged.\nYou step aside to watch the battle

Long Xiang, who was present at the scene against her will, drew unwanted attention to herself. Yet she did not know that others were admiring her beauty while mocking her behind her back.\nHer reputation for being tricked out of money spreads wider than her deeds of righting wrongs. Every time she goes out, Beggar Sect disciples can't get enough of seeing her; not even the Generous Charity Maiden is as generous with her wealth.\nIf it weren't for the past friendship between Gang Leader Wang and Lady Wen, and considering Jinxiang Palace's standing in the Jianghu, they might have been tricked out of both their wealth and their bodies.

Long Xiang, in addition to his alias, also went by the nickname Leg of Chicken Assassin.\nAlthough the people who gave her this nickname mostly did so for fun, she actually quite likes it.\nIn his elated state, he also composed half a poem: 'Slay all the wicked people in the world and taste every delicious chicken on the land.' Upon returning to Jinxiang Palace, Lady Wen felt ashamed for her own beloved disciple and ordered someone to prepare a vine whip. She was only waiting for Long Xiang to return to the palace so she could beat her until she was nearly dead, then find a private tutor to teach her how to read from the very beginning.

Long Xiang, who was present against his will, drew even more attention. The fame of Jinxiang Palace's killer had spread even further. Despite all the righteous deeds he had done while wandering in the Jianghu, how come he ended up with such a notorious reputation?\nAt the root of it, the primary culprit is your senior brother. That nickname was even he who gave you. Sometimes, Dragon Xiang truly hates your senior brother so much that he wishes to strip him down to the bone.

By the day when Tang Clan's flying hero clashed with the Flying Stone Gang Leader, all the valiant heroes from various parts of Shu gathered to watch the battle, witnessing it together.
Emei and Qingcheng's young prodigies arrived on schedule, with even Soul Stealer Yuhuan from Kongtong making an appearance.
Gang Leader Shi grew increasingly impatient waiting. Ironically, it was nearly the time when your senior brother was supposed to arrive, yet he remained nowhere to be seen.

Through your persistent questioning, Senior Brother finally revealed the grudge he had with the Flying Stone Gang.
It turned out that he had already gone to investigate the Flying Stone Gang before it gained any significant following, and coincidentally, he happened upon Gang Leader Shi and Lady arguing in the courtyard.
Senior Brother was crouched on the roof, and couldn't help but chuckle inwardly. As the Tangtang leader of the group, he carried himself with a resolute air, always proud and confident. But at home, he was submissive and accommodating, truly a man who feared his wife like a tiger.
It may be amusing to listen to them, but the more they talked, the more astonishing it became. It turned out that it was not Gang Master Shi who had grand ambitions and intended to compete with Flying Stone Gang and Tang Clan, but this delicate Lady Shi.
Instead, Gang Leader Shi bowed and bent over, speaking gently to the Lady in a conciliatory manner. He said that one should never forget their benefactors, even for a mere drop of water's kindness. Recall how they left their mountain home and fled from Tangzhou during a difficult time, traveling westward through Sichuan. They had no means of livelihood, had to avoid officials, and couldn't engage in commerce. The local villagers feared them due to their fierce appearance and strange origins, refusing to hire them. For a while, they nearly starved to the point where they considered returning to their old trade on the mountains.
At the time, accepting their help was from the Tang Clan's Righteous Field. While the profit wasn't much, it was sufficient to allow people to support themselves and find a way out of dire straits. With that risk‑averse mindset abandoned, they eventually managed to establish their own clan, forming the Flying Stone Gang, which specialized in taking on rough manual labor for others as a means of livelihood.
Now that the Flying Stone Gang has grown stronger and more powerful, going after the Tang Clan's interests‑aren't they betraying their benefactors?
The argument became so heated that even Gang Leader Shi's robust external skill found it hard to withstand Lady one after another slaps she delivered. With a flick of his hand, his fingers inadvertently brushed against Lady's fair and delicate cheek.
He pressed his three fingers together, and they were even larger than Lady Shi's palm. Although it was an unintentional brush against his face, causing only pain without injury, since Lady Shi had always cherished her husband as a delicate flower under her care, she couldn't bear to speak of anything heavy, let alone endure being struck.
At that moment, his heart was filled with bitterness, and tears welled up in his eyes. His anger and hatred reached their peak, causing him to stomp away.
Gang Leader Shi hesitated and did not pursue. By the time he finally regained his composure to chase after her, Lady had already vanished without a trace.
Senior Brother was momentarily uncertain about whether to reveal himself and advise this old Brother Shi in a kind manner, or to chase after Lady Shi. After much deliberation, he ultimately decided to follow her discreetly to protect her, given that she was an ordinary woman traveling alone without even a maidservant, fearing potential trouble. Therefore, he spoke at length and managed to dissuade her from the idea of jumping off a cliff, and arranged accommodations for her as well.
Lady Shi is of a fiery temperament and threatens with her life to force the Senior Brother to swear that he absolutely cannot reveal his whereabouts. Otherwise, should she die, the Flying Stone Gang and the Tang Clan would become mortal enemies with no room for reconciliation.
The Senior Brother had no choice but to agree. He had been clever his entire life, and this was his greatest mistake. He still thought that Lady Shi would cool off after a few days and come to her senses, then return home.
Who would have thought that this Lady, whose temper is as stubborn as a bull's, would really sulk and refuse to come out? This tiny household matter has thus sparked a dispute between two factions.

With Master Brother's pace, this trip's progress was unusually slow. Sometimes walking, sometimes hiring a vehicle, they leisurely walked for several days before finally reaching the village near Woyun Ridge, staying at an inn to rest and regain their strength.

Besides the Little Junior Sister
She cast a glance of hesitation, and though she said nothing, it conveyed more than words ever could to the others.
Everyone could now rest easy. The senior brother traveling with others still didn't instill as much trust as you did when you traveled alone.
Though you are an outsider and the last disciple of the Tang Clan to receive true chen chuan, you stand like an old tree or a stubborn stone on the mountain, as if the Tang Family Compound were simply closed down but you could never be expelled.  Translation: Though you are an outsider and the last disciple of the Tang Clan to receive true transmission, you stand like an old tree or a stubborn stone on the mountain, as if the Tang Family Compound had merely been closed down but you could never be expelled. You occasionally venture out, traveling as far as you may, but you always find your way back.
With you by my side, even Master Senior Brother with wings would find it hard to fly.
Master Brother specifically called out your name to join him, but as soon as you heard, you immediately didn't want to go. No one could persuade you.

Fortunately, Senior Brother specifically requested you to accompany him. Other people aren't as reassured, but you're an exception.\nAlthough you are the last outsider to receive true transmission from the Tang Clan, you stand firm on that mountain like an ancient tree or a stubborn stone. Even the Tang Family Estate cannot burn you away or push you out.  You occasionally venture out, traveling far and wide, but always find your way back home.\nWith you by my side, even Master Senior Brother with wings would find it hard to fly.
Third Senior Brother was really uneasy, and since there were fellow disciples who volunteered to follow, he immediately agreed.

\nOn the day when Senior Brother went out, all the fellow brothers and sisters living in the compound gathered at the training ground.\nThe senior brother is engaging in a duel with the Flying Stone Gang Leader at Woyun Ridge, without any fellow disciples to assist him. This situation leaves people both reassured and worried. They are comforted by the fact that he seems confident and believes this grudge can be resolved. However, they also worry that without anyone watching over him, if the senior brother suddenly gets distracted by flower butterflies halfway through the duel, wanders off, and disappears, what will become of him?

In the strategy discussion for dealing with the Kongtong Sect, you revealed the secrets of the Kongtong treasures to drag everyone into it.
Soon after, this news spread, and people from all over knew that the secret treasures of Kongtong had fallen into the hands of outsiders.
People in Kongtong and its surroundings are living in fear, with some fleeing for safety and others plotting to seize power.
Master Wei, under criticism for failing to protect the treasure, was forced to seclude himself in a cave. From then on, he lived a reclusive life, rarely venturing out. He spent his days sighing long and short, lamenting that he had been deceived again. Not only do handsome men like Pan An know how to lie, but ugly‑looking individuals might not be trustworthy either.

The Third Senior Brother was entrusted by the Sect Leader to arrange the lifelong affairs for Little Junior Sister.\nAlthough Little Junior Sister's thoughts are simple and she is somewhat naive about romantic love between men and women, it would be better if she could mature sooner. However, in this turbulent Jianghu where one must weather both rain and wind, it's hard to predict how many peaceful days lie ahead. Knowing that formidable enemies surround them, they should make a swift decision. If Senior Brother and Little Junior Sister truly have no feelings for each other, they should carefully choose a reliable husband for her who can support and care for her. Once she marries, she will no longer be part of the Tang Clan. Unless there is a catastrophe that affects nine generations or more, issues related to her family would not concern her anymore. From then on, it would not be her responsibility nor would it affect her.

Senior Master Brother narrates vividly about the thousand‑mile journey since his disappearance from Jiangling.
First, he stealthily entered the battlefield of Xiangyang to support Song soldiers against the Jin army. There, he fought off the Jin forces and made acquaintance with General Daofa Danxiazi and Zhao Fang, the commander of Xiangyang, over a hearty drinking session. The next morning, without bidding farewell, he set out northward. Along the way, he occasionally took care of several pleasure houses for their patrons, effortlessly picking up treasures from visiting Jin tourists to present as rare and precious gifts to the most favored courtesans at these pleasure houses.
During the feast, as they became more intoxicated and talkative, they learned that a bandit group in Shanxi, near Anyang and Kaifeng in Henan, planned to convene a swearing‑in ceremony with other mountain outlaws. They had no idea what kind of major business they were planning. After further inquiries, they discovered that the Golden State Emperor Wanyan Xun had received some confidential letter and decided at the last moment to visit the front lines to encourage the soldiers before the Song dynasty.
The bandits from various mountains were outlaws to Song but heroes to Jin. Therefore, they united and began planning this huge venture, hoping for dual success in profit and reputation‑perhaps even eternal fame. Should they fail, it would only mean their deaths.
Senior Brother's eyes lit up, and he ventured alone into the bandits' main camp to make friends through martial arts. Even with his formidable skills, it was difficult for him to single‑handedly fight off all the bandits that came from various mountain outlaws.
The senior brother may act recklessly, but he is far from a brute. On that day, it was only by sacrificing himself that he could fully express his admiration.
He defies a hundred with one, meets death with indifference. The bandits ambushing the Jin Emperor's convoy are equally noble and resolute in their cause.
If not for fighting until he was exhausted and in a daze, how could these bandits have sincerely revered him based on just words?
After this battle, Senior Brother was revered as the King of Mountain Bandits and commanded various coves of mountain bandits, ambushing Emperor Wanyan Xun of the Jin Dynasty.
The senior master thought to emulate the heroes of Boluosha who struck at the Qin by throwing heavy hidden weapons from a vantage point on the winding path. However, this person was overly suspicious and had his attendant sit in the main carriage while he rode in the secondary one, thus narrowly avoiding the attack.
Senior Brother did not succeed with his first strike. He took advantage of the fact that the Jin Emperor's entourage had yet to meet up with the main force in the Jin army camp and called down the bandits to launch a downhill assault. The battle raged on, and as it became clear that they could not break through the heavy defenses, he decided to snatch the flag and steal horses, drawing the Jin soldiers in pursuit. Meanwhile, he waved the flag and charged towards the camp. Upon his arrival, the Mongol general Pu San Anzhen, who was just setting out to meet him, saw him advancing with great force and began to curse at him, immediately accusing him of being a traitor. Since he had been ordered by His Majesty to come and arrest him, he did not dare to resist. He thought to himself that the clear would be cleared up on its own, so he took off his armor and bound himself, loudly proclaiming his innocence, asking His Majesty for clarification. Unfortunately, before His Majesty could clear his name, Senior Brother chopped off his head with a single stroke of the saber.
Although the assassination attempt failed, decapitating his Golden State military commander certainly counts as a remarkable achievement.
The three of you, along with the little junior sister, were all taken aback.
You may not say anything about it, but Third Senior Brother and Fourth Senior Brother are completely unconvinced. After all, Big Senior Brother is notorious for blowing his own trumpet, with a record of misconduct.
The senior brother merely shrugged and wore a bitter smile, letting you believe what you will; anyway, he has fulfilled his duty of briefing.

Senior Brother simply didn't take the Flying Stone Gang, our major nemesis, seriously. He has his own clever plan to turn enemies into allies without a single drop of blood being spilled.\nAs they say, the one who tied the bell rope must untie it. With such confidence in his demeanor, everyone heaved a sigh of relief.\nRegarding the matter of Second Senior Brother, Big Senior seems contemplative and unwilling to believe that his Junior Disciple would betray their teacher and desert the Tang Clan. There must be some hidden truth behind this. Once the pressing matters at hand are resolved, I will inevitably set out on a journey and confront him, beating him severely until he reveals the truth.

The Little Junior Sister was overjoyed to see the Senior Martial Brother return. However, he did not wish for her to linger, so he gently pushed her away. The Little Junior Sister tried to pat him but found herself unable to do so, at a loss. She could only pout and sulk, retreating to one side.

Senior Brother didn't want her to cling on, so he pushed her away. Little Junior Sister wasn't persistent, letting go of Senior Brother's sleeve and then grabbing you instead. You were flattered and surprised, thinking she had grown up and would no longer depend on you like that. Unexpectedly, today's emotional turmoil made her involuntarily grab your sleeve. This shows that although she cultivates her mind and restrains her desires daily, deep down she still greatly depends on you. Regardless of your appearance, as long as you are close to her, it's enough to make her feel at ease.
Senior Brother came down to the lower floor this time, but he was accompanied by the Little Junior Sister.

Senior Brother listened to the series of bad news that the Tang Clan has been dealing with recently and still remained unperturbed. This made you and your fellow brothers both angry and relieved; it seemed as though the sky hadn't fallen, and these were merely trivial matters to him.\nSenior Brother Third politely declined the sect leader's token, still allowing Third Senior Brother to take charge. Considering his decision‑making was not as sound as Third Senior Brother's, he believed it would be better for them each to handle their respective duties‑internal affairs would be managed by Third Senior Brother, while external threats would be left to him to deal with.\nAfter hastily making the arrangements, the senior brother went upstairs to see the Sect Leader, while you and the other three informed the senior brother of his return, causing excitement throughout the sect.

Just as the three of you were continuously debating the situation, muttering oaths and wishes for Senior Brother to return quickly, he suddenly appeared just as if nothing had happened.\nIn an instant, the three of you felt a mix of joy and anger. You were overjoyed that the Flying Hero had returned, as if the sect now had a solid foundation; but you were also angry because he vanished for such a long time without a word, leaving no trace. You feared he might have encountered danger outside, only to find out later that your worries were unfounded. Clearly, this person is nothing more than an unreliable wanderer.\nIt was strange. When he wasn't around, they always hoped that he was just being playful and had delayed his return due to time mismanagement. But when he finally showed up, grinning and swaggering home, the murderous intent in their heart couldn't help but arise again.

Perhaps it is more accurate to say that Senior Brother saw the situation clearly and steered the Gang Leader's wife away, hiding her. This prevented the Flying Stone Gang Leader from acting rashly and taking someone's life, thus maintaining stability up to the present.

It's actually better to thank Senior Brother for his foresight. He redirected the Gang Leader's wife and hid her away, making the Flying Stone Gang Leader hesitant to take any lives out of concern for her safety. This is how the situation has been maintained in stability until now.\nToo bad you have no way of knowing where Lady Shi is hiding. Otherwise, if she were captured and poisoned, we could see whether Gang Leader Shi would still be so pushy.

Fourth Senior Brother and Third Senior Brother are both senior master brothers who are the sole survivors in Tang Clan today. They witnessed the clan's rise to prosperity followed by its decline and subsequent revival. With their extensive experience in the Jianghu, they deeply understand that the conflict between our clan and the Flying Stone Gang is not solely due to the misconduct of our eldest senior brother. At most, it serves as a pretext; the real reason boils down to nothing more than fame and profit.
To understand how our clan has established roots in Shu, the credibility and prestige were built up over several generations. Within our territory, villagers from every hamlet have long benefited from the Tang Clan's kindness. While today's young people may not fully realize this, the older generation knows well of the Tang Clan's former glory. During times of natural disasters or human misfortunes, people would seek help from the Tang Clan before turning to the authorities.
In the bureaucracy where officials look out for each other and true justice is hard to come by, at Tang Clan, the wronged will surely see their innocence revealed. Among the Three Great Families, only Tang Clan dares to face the court head‑on.
Now, if the Flying Stone Gang wishes to win hearts and expand its territory, rising to become a first‑rate major gang in the Wulin, the Tang Clan from Sichuan would be their primary rival. Even if the Tang Clan has no intention of competing, the Flying Stone Gang would still find it absolutely unacceptable and would seize any opportunity to provoke conflict. They would then seek to defeat the Tang Clan and take its place.

You've hesitated to speak several times, though you know the First Senior Brother's whereabouts. However, considering the Master's intention to keep the disciples unaware, even the Third Senior Brother and Fourth Senior Brother cannot speak out. You fear that rumors might spread, causing the disciples to panic and lose their composure.

You and Third Senior Brother have never tried to calm the situation, have you? Unfortunately, no matter how we pleaded, the other party's Lady just disappeared without a trace. No matter how sincere you are, it's all in vain.

Since Senior Brother disappeared from Jiangling, the vast Central Plains Wulin has never again heard tales of Flying Hero's exploits. It's as if this person vanished into thin air.
This left your Third Senior Brother in a state of great anxiety. The Flying Stone Gang Master Shi Gongyuan had previously agreed to duel with the Eldest Senior Brother. Shi Gongyuan set the date while the Eldest Senior Brother chose the location. Your Eldest Senior Brother was never one to shy away from combat, so it came as a surprise when he failed to honor their agreement.
Ordinary Wulin practitioners have agreed to a duel, but one party did not show up.
The notary would then rule that the opponent fled in cowardice and lost without fighting. This would be even more humiliating than losing in battle.
If we could resolve this matter now, although it would be embarrassing, it might still be acceptable. Unfortunately, Master Senior Brother took the lady away, and her whereabouts are still unknown to this day.
Lady has not returned for a day. How could Gang Leader Shi be able to save face and let it go without further ado? He repeatedly wrote challenge letters to the Tang Clan, even when Senior Brother refused multiple times, he grew increasingly frustrated and angry. This time, his letter omitted all the Jianghu formalities and plainly stated that if they did not accept the challenge again, he would mobilize the entire Flying Stone Gang to storm the Tang Clan's residence and massacre their household. Even if your martial arts are formidable and you fear no Flying Stone Gang, he would still use a sea of bodies to overwhelm and crush you, sparing neither one nor both sides.

Before leaving, Shangguan Ying suddenly turned around and began talking about her own matters to herself.
She once had a personal maidservant named Shu Rong, who was like a sister to her.
Although she was immensely reluctant, she ultimately could not defy the Lord's command, and thus could only watch helplessly as her personal maid was given to someone else. After that, no matter how good or suitable other people might be, they could never fill Shu Rong's place in her heart.
Nangong Da Young Lord doesn't want her, but Shangguan Ying still can't forget her; Wei Ju, the Sect Leader Wei, is the closest friend she has deemed irreplaceable.
Your destiny with her is also the priceless treasure she treasures beyond all gold.
Even if you don't appreciate it, she has to help you. Who hasn't rebelled at some point, arguing with their parents?
After parting ways with Shangguan Ying, the first thing she did was seek out the Tang Clan's creditor, Lu Weng, using the name of Cang Gang's ship association. She promised to offer favorable terms in order to alleviate some of the Tang Clan's debts.
Lu Weng heard about the sect leader's serious illness and felt a myriad of emotions. He generously contributed money to eliminate the long‑standing debt that the previous generation of Tangmen owed for buying rice with borrowed money to relieve famine.

Shangguan Ying, though determined in battle to switch sides and turn against the Tang Clan, could only speak for herself. In the chaos of a disorderly battle, the Cang Gang disciples she brought were ordered by their family head to remain neutral and observe from the sidelines. Even if they didn't actively support either side, it was enough to show their stance.
That day's troublemaker Tang Shouhong, who led the Tang Clan from Guangzhou to cause chaos, and Zen Master Shi Ming are old hands of the Jianghu with vast experience. In stark contrast to the young pup Flying Stone Gang Leader, they have seen the Tang Clan at its zenith and during the height of Tang Zhongling's power.
At that time, the Tang Family's Sect Leader was fiercer than even ghosts and gods. When he aligned with the mainstream faction, the evil forces retreated; when he went against them, even the top experts from the Six Great Factions had to seek mediation from the Nangong Clan.
Because Tang Zhongling held the position of Sect Leader for several decades, neither of those two dared to approach Sichuan territory. Today, had it not been for the Shangguan family supporting them, they would never have had the courage to come and cause trouble at our doorstep.
At the root of it, the Shangguan clan is duty‑bound.
Shangguan Ying summoned her retainer without moving and couldn't ignore the prestige of a noble family by showing weakness to others. She forcibly endured the Tang Clan disciples' taunts and jeers. Overjoyed at hearing that you had woken up, she hurried into Zhengxin Hall but was immediately sent away with a dismissal order.
Shangguan Ying ordered her servants not to approach, walking alongside you shoulder‑to‑shoulder in silence. Her heart was filled with dread as she vaguely realized that the situation was beyond redemption and that the moment of their farewell had arrived.
How could you not want to walk with her and enjoy yourself together, laughing to your heart's content? But people don't live just for themselves. You have the Tang Clan behind you, and she has the Shangguan Family.
Breaking away from her and setting clear boundaries is your way of protecting her. Such a good person should stay as far away from the chaos of Jianghu as possible.

You have arrived at Zhengxin Hall to pay respects to the Acting Sect Leader. You and your fellow senior brothers met just yesterday, yet it feels like a long time has passed since you last saw each other.
Internal strife within the Tang Clan left a scene of chaos and bloodstains everywhere. Even inside Zhengxin Hall, where light smoke still rose gently and the air was serene as if detached from the world, everything had changed.
Clearly, defeating powerful enemies so poorly was a miserable defeat. After being defeated by Zen Master Xianming, he fled to spread rumors, distorting the truth. One side is portrayed as an amiable and wise hermit, while the other is depicted ambiguously‑neither entirely good nor evil‑and comes from a martial arts family. Anyone would naturally side with the amiable and wise hermit.
In a single night, the Tang Clan disregarded their loyalties and familial ties by indiscriminately killing fellow clan members, and rumors of such deeds spread far and wide. The whispers that the Tang Clan were followers of the Demon Sect also mixed into these rumors, spreading without anyone's prompting.
It's said that Master Li of the Tang Family has too heavy a presence of resentment. Even with Zen Master Shi Ming's teachings from the Dharma, he could not be enlightened. This ultimately led to him reaping the bitter fruit of his actions, falling into madness. The once great genius is now bedridden and reduced to a wasteful person.
Given the presence of such a formidable opponent, if Third Senior Brother were to punish this group of troublemakers from a fake Tang Clan, it would confirm the rumors and expose our weakness. How will the Songshan Sect and Nangong Family handle their future attempts to mediate?
Third Senior Brother was left in a difficult position. As such, he could only leave some room for maneuver and rescinded the order to search for Senior Brother, instead commanding the disciples to return to defend the mountain gate, to avoid being taken advantage of by the enemy.

You slowly woke up the next day\nFellow sect members and senior brothers called you in. You were overjoyed to think that the Sect Leader had revived, only to find out right away that everything you feared was reality.\nThe glorious days of yore have long since slipped away from you. The human world has undergone a sudden and profound change overnight, despite our best efforts to resist it; we are but pawns in this vast tide, unable to control our fate as it carries us along with immense force. The bitter and salty tears that fill our mouths now finally reveal the true face of Jianghu.

The Third Senior Brother held the token entrusted by the Sect Leader and ordered the disciples to chase down their targets, but all returned without success.
Little Junior Sister was in such a mess that she rushed home, but she couldn't even manage to say a single word to her father. She stared blankly at the bedside, gently patting the Sect Leader's body as silent tears streamed down her blouse.
Without a Sect Leader, the disciples lost their leader. With both Senior Brother missing and Second Senior Brother having betrayed, internal strife and external threats abound in the Tang Clan. Even driving off powerful enemies brought no joy; every single person was deeply worried, with solemn expressions.
That night, many disciples left without saying goodbye.

You and the Third Senior Brother have fought repeatedly today, already exhausted. Moreover, upon learning of your origins, your Heart Connection has been shaken, and you've been poisoned by the Second Senior Brother's toxin, leaving you powerless to pursue. Yunshang is leaving. With no one around to make noise and cause trouble, how quiet and lonely it will be? But there's no helping it. If she doesn't go, she has no chance to live.
I know. You've treated me better than my own grandfather.
Shang'er, I'm not your real grandfather, but my wish for you to be healthy is as genuine as can be. You don't know how afraid I was that you wouldn't be willing to leave.
Grandfather~
After all... After all, everyone hopes that Miss Ye will recover and grow up safely.
Well said.
Since we're friends, we act with loyalty. No one owes anyone anything.
Now everyone treats you as a good friend. Even if you hadn't brought it up, I've been thinking about the words to politely advise you to leave.

Young Hero Ye, don't be so formal. You are young but accomplished, a renowned sword hero in the Jianghu. Yet you came to the Tang Clan and worked diligently without complaint, washing away the prejudice our senior and junior brothers once held against Diancang swordsmen.

However, my sister's illness is grave and difficult to cure. Her life hangs in the balance. Driven by necessity, I have no choice but to take our leave and seek another remedy to save her. I beg for your understanding and forgiveness. When my sister and I return one day, we will repay the Tang Clan's great heroes for their life-changing kindness.

Third Master Tang, Brother Zhao. My sister and I have imposed on the Tang Clan for a long time. We are deeply grateful for your hospitality and protection. We will remember this kindness forever, to the end of our days. I know that the Tang Clan is going through a difficult time, and leaving like this makes me seem ungrateful.
But where can I go safely? Ah, here's an idea‑why don't we go to the Song State?
Peasants are really terrifying; I need to find a way to avoid this marriage or go out and avoid some trouble. Otherwise, he'll have his nephew kill me.
Hey! You still have my needle in your body......!

My nephew is handsome and strong, with endless strength, like a super strong farmer. You'll definitely like him when you see him. As long as your hips are big enough to handle it, having three children in three years is no problem. No time to waste, wait here. I'll go get him right away!
Oh, don't, don't. Just bring it, don't jump to conclusions so soon.
Let's just call it off

Marriage is a big matter, always following the parents' orders and the matchmaker's words. It's not like the Jianghu, where people are rough and unrefined. A proper family wouldn't have someone meeting before marriage, picking and choosing. That's too unbecoming.
That... That next time you bring the Medical Pavilion, I'll have to see your character first.

Of course it's true. Your medical skills are so high, of course you don't worry about making a living. But you lack someone who truly cares to offer warmth and concern. How lonely you might be when you're old. Don't you want someone to take care of you? Don't you want someone to bring you a cup of tea and massage your shoulders when you're tired? My nephew is good enough!
...Really?

Anyway, you don't have any company. Don't think that because you're young and still have time, others get married at sixteen, while you're already eighteen and considered a mature lady. What's wrong with my nephew? He's a farmer, and he's very down‑to‑earth.
After all, you're trying to arrange a marriage for your nephew again, aren't you?

Hi, I'm from a farming family, most spirited, relying on sheer willpower to stay awake. After all, there's nothing to do during moxibustion; you can just chat with Aunt, and it won't make you lose a bit of flesh.
Aunt, why are you awake? Didn't I just needle your sleep points?
Little Medicine Immortal, what are you daydreaming about? Thinking about men?
At the same time, in the Medical Pavilion of Kaifeng, Jin Dynasty, the Liang family's practice was bustling.
May Heaven bless me, I hope that Miss Liang is a good person. When I leave this world, I hope she can take my place, become my brother's spiritual pillar, and protect his heart.

I can still tell that my brother has no feelings for Miss Liang. But even if he doesn't, saying it out loud every day, over and over—sooner or later, it might come true. And I'll do everything I can to act cute and push them together. Then I'll have a sister-in-law.
Forgive me, Miss Liang. Ye is being coerced by his willful sister's threats. I cannot avoid tarnishing your reputation.
Alright. Go pack your things. Tomorrow morning, we'll take our leave from Sect Leader Tang.
Fine. I'll give you special permission to practice on the road. Three times a day, or we turn right back around.
I need to practice. How can I just say something like that out of nowhere?!
Don't give me that perfunctory stuff. Speak louder! You have to include words like 'covet' and 'wish to marry her as my wife'!
......I admire her. Is that good enough?
If you don't say it, I won't go! Are you going to say it or not? I'm giving you one last chance. Don't be ungrateful!
I'm not saying that!
I, Ye Yunzhao, covet Liang You Shi's beauty, admire her talent, and wish to marry her as my wife!
Why can't you say it? You're a man, aren't you? Shout it out loud with me!
Uh... h-how can I say something like that?
Tell me in detail. How much do you covet her? Don't say I'm forcing you.

Do you admit to having improper thoughts towards her?
Wait. I—I lied just now. Please don't refuse to go.
None? Not even a little? Then I'm not going.
I have no improper thoughts towards Doctor Liang!

Of course it's important! She could be the woman who becomes my sister-in-law! If she's pretty, don't you think your little sister here will pull out all the stops to act cute and win you some opportunities?

How pretty? Compared to me? Compared to Moling?
Uh... pretty, I suppose?
What does she look like? Is she pretty?
Liang You Shi

...Little Medicine Immortal Miss Liang? What, she's a young woman?

One last time... please, just listen to me. I promise you, if we meet Miss Liang, the Little Medicine Immortal, and you don't want to go through with the treatment, we'll come back. Or... go straight to Jiangnan.
Ye Yunshang's Resistance
Leave the Tang Clan
Yunshang...
But I also value you, big brother! I've had enough... I don't want to be a burden to you anymore.
Father and mother entrusted you to my care...
Retract your words! Now! Immediately! Don't you dare say such stupid things about dignity being useless! You're the renowned Pine Swordsman, whose name spreads far and wide!
Watch me knock some sense into you!
You... you're impossible to reason with!
I won't die. As long as you can live, what does dignity matter? Enough. I'm not asking for your opinion. Just follow me quietly.
That's not the kind of life I want. Something like sacrificing you to survive... I don't want that!
Yunshang, don't be so stubborn.
Oh, okay. Then I don't want to go.

I am. As long as it can save you, never mind bowing to a Jin subject—even if I had to beg all the way to the Six Paths Canyon, sink into the mire, and be condemned to eternal suffering without hope of rebirth, I would do it.

But is this the right way? The Song and Jin Dynasties have been at war until now. Our Ye family has a grudge with the Jin Dynasty and cannot live under the same sky. You're willing to bow your head to a Jin subject?
So she's a foreigner. No wonder.

Because... she is from the Jin Kingdom. As for her skills, I have personally seen her save lives and heal the wounded. Her medical skills are divine, almost godlike. She may be no less capable than Second Hero Tang.
Is there a divine doctor in Jiangling? How reliable is she? Why have I never heard of her before?
...Yunshang, I went to Jiangling before and met a divine doctor by chance. I'll take you there, would you like her to treat you?
I am very satisfied, it's really a good thing I didn't go to Jiangnan. The days spent at the Tang Clan were the most comfortable years of my brief life.
Well, forget it. I didn't really expect much to begin with. Although getting needles is painful and taking medicine is bitter, I've become friends with Moling.
...Was it all in vain in the end?
With my swift sword, killing people is not an issue; to capture the Heartless Hand alive would be nothing short of a fool's dream.
Even if I knew his whereabouts, I might not be a match for Second Hero Tang.
That's true. So what are we going to do about this coming life-or-death crisis? It's not like you can go down the mountain and drag him back.
Though he betrayed the Tang Clan, he has done us siblings a favor. At the very least, we should not lose that respect.
Why are you still calling him Hero Tang?
She was struck by Second Hero Tang's hidden weapon and hasn't been able to get out of bed since. She may have the will but lacks the strength.
Isn't Sister Fang still here?
Sister, listen to me. Second Hero Tang once said that you will face a life-or-death crisis this year. But the one who can help you is no longer in the Tang Clan.
Surprisingly, she's still thinking about food by this point.
Tell me what's going on. After that, give me two red bean cakes as compensation‑I'll split them with Moling.
Ah, forget it...
Don't blow your nose on my clothes!
What kind of nonsense are you talking about? Stop fooling around. I'm trying to talk seriously with you. And stop crying.
Why must I be the one to be beaten? Why don't you hit Brother Zhao? I'm sure he'd be happy to suffer this butt-splitting, bottom-cracking pain for me.
That's on you for acting foolishly without discernment, bringing trouble upon yourself.
So? What is it that you were willing to harm our sibling bond just to tell me? It better be important, or I won't let you off easy.
Ah! Wuwu! Stop it, you bad brother! Ah! You're hitting me while Brother Zhao isn't here! I'll tell him about this, ah! You're going to get a good scolding! Wuwu! Wuwu～～Help! Help me!
Eeek, eeeek... My life is doomed!
Enough, come here
Female Hero, Think Thrice!
No
Moling, aren't we good friends, good sisters? Don't you have a firm bottom? Would you take half of it for me? Next time you commit a wrongdoing, I'll also be duty‑bound to repay you half of it.
Oh no, this is bad, big trouble is coming.
You dare!
...D-Do you think I'm joking with you? Bring out the red bean cakes right now... Otherwise, this heroine will strip your little sister... take off her clothes and see what the treasure...
Of course! Hurry, hurry.
Do I really have to say that?

'Do you think I'm joking with you? Bring out the red bean cakes right now! Otherwise, this heroine will strip your little sister naked and see what that treasure map looks like. Then I'll use the treasure from the map to buy endless snacks!'
Huh? Huh? But...
No choice. Time to pull out the ultimate move. Whatever I say, you repeat after me.
Well, of course not...
What to do? They didn't fall for it.
Yunshang, come out for a moment, Brother has something important to tell you.
(In a low voice) Cough... Zhaozhao, your sister's life is now in my hands. If you want her to live, bring some red bean cakes. Remember, two portions!
It's my brother shouting outside
Senior Sister, could you tell me if my younger sister Yunshang is in the female disciples' quarters?
Y-You're welcome. We're friends, after all.
Thank you. Truly.
Yunshang
Wh-Why did you stop? Was it too long?

'It makes my father, the Sect Leader, wear himself out cleaning up their mess. Fortunately, he has unparalleled divine skills, fearless of heaven and earth. As long as he gets a good night's sleep, he'll recover. Waking up sooner would be great, but sleeping enough to feel refreshed wouldn't be so bad either.''
One thing after another—does it leave any room for a person to live? It's infuriating!
'One thing after another—does it leave any room for a person to live? It's infuriating!'
And where has the eldest senior brother disappeared to at a time like this? What a useless guy!
'And where has the eldest senior brother disappeared to at a time like this? What a useless guy!'
Where did this fake Tang Clan come from, pretending to be my family? They're asking for a beating.
'Where did this fake Tang Clan come from, pretending to be my family? They're asking for a beating.'
...Wh-What is all this? It's too much, pushing people too far.
'What is all this? It's too much, pushing people too far.'
There's no 'then,' just saying it out loud will make you a bit more comfortable. You have to trust me. If you don't believe me, try repeating after me.
Say it out loud... then what?
What's so hard about that? Whatever's bothering you, just say it out loud.
Mhm.
Don't know how to do what? Complain?
But I don't know how.
Although I can't be of much help to you, I can listen to you vent. If there's anything on your mind, feel free to complain to me.
My poor little Ling'er
......My chest feels tight.
Don't trick me, okay? Because we're friends, you know?
Not bad
Are you okay?
Little Junior Sister wasn't actually folding paper; she was just holding colored paper, staring blankly into space.
Mhm

In the end, there's no escaping death......!
I had no need to tell you anything. As for the reason you were two years late in returning, you should explain it.
What task does the Second Senior Brother still need to assign me?
After the nonsense is said, if there's nothing else, then everyone can go. Tang Fang, you stay.
Thank you, Brother～Hug! You're indeed the real brother of Shang'er! The one who looks good is just good‑looking; they don't know how to care for others at all. I don't want it anymore!
Alright, here you go. When I have something good, I didn't collect it for you.
Alright, here you go
Stingy!
I won't give it to you, you know. This is my reward for working all day. You go ask your older brother for it!
Eat it yourself

Brother, you now have two choices. One, take the candied fruit back to your room and eat it yourself, to sweeten your bitter life. Two, give the candied fruit to me, significantly increasing Shang'er's affinity toward you.

Yes, indeed, when I practice medicine, I often encounter children who complain that the medicine is bitter and refuse to take it. To prevent them from crying or fussing, honey candies are the best remedy.
Is this candied fruit?
Thanks, this is for you as a thank you gift.

Zhao Huo is much more astute than Tang Fang. If they were a woman, it would be worthwhile to pass on medical skills to them. In the future, when treating female patients, they could administer acupuncture on my behalf to avoid any suspicion.
I picked it up on the way, thinking it might be useful.
Needles and instruments, medical books, drug scales, medicinal herbs... not only have they not decreased, but they have also added new herbs.
You have quite a few things; I don't know if I've found them all.
Everything has been recovered
Here you go, after all, I've read it thoroughly.
Wild boar
Why does this medical book smell so damp and smelly?
Thank you so much! It's better than nothing, I guess...
Sorry, I only recovered a little; some were eaten by wild boars. I even fought a wild boar to get them back. Here.
Half, better than nothing
Well, just consider it a good deed to feed the mountain pigs. Those are all pure medicinal herbs, not poison; eating them won't kill the mountain pigs or rabbits.
I've been searching for a long time, but all I found were some needles and medical supplies, and everything else is gone.
Pitifully few
You can avoid today, but tomorrow you'll still have to endure the needle, ya.
Brother! Brother, save me! Their needles are so thick!
I'm back
I'm dead, I'm dead!
Second Senior Brother is rarely this cautious, isn't he?

Hmm, Second Senior Brother wishes me to first harmonize the Five Elements and restore balance, then gradually repair the meridians and replenish the Qi sea. Later, we can expel the pathogenic factors externally, thus eliminating the root cause.
Yes
Slow down, slow down, what's going on? Is my soul leaving?

Starting tomorrow, you will be responsible for administering acupuncture to Miss Ye. First use the 'Observing Balance Needle,' then the 'Returning Pulse Needle,' and finally the 'Soul-Expelling Needle.'
Fine, I can't say no anyway
Anyway, my things‑please take care of them. As much as you can recover, that's fine. Urgently.
That's right
I'm definitely smarter than my senior sister Xin Ru. If it were her, she wouldn't even be able to keep the medicine box's strap.
You still have the nerve to say you're not confused.
I felt my luggage growing lighter, and I supposed it was due to my eagerness to return home, my steps becoming brisker as well.
How could you not have noticed even a bit?

Alright, don't talk about this anymore, help me quickly. I'm almost there, but I just realized the medicine box has a hole, things are falling out all the way, and I can't retrieve them alone. Plus, Second Senior Brother is worried about me. I'm afraid of being scolded and also afraid that the medicines will be eaten by wild animals when I go back.
I'm just late. Life is so long; why worry about moving a bit slower?
You and Xin Ru, your senior sister, are both known as the Muddlehead King of the Tang Clan; one has poor sleeping posture, the other loves to be late.
I've been late for so long? I'm doomed... That's why Second Senior Brother's letter had such a harsh tone.

Moreover, I say to Senior Sister Tang Fang, you haven't been away for just a couple of months. You've been traveling and practicing medicine down the mountain, and it's already been over two years now.
Oh dear, almost there!
All wrong! Not a single word is correct, I'm called Zhao Huo, right?
I still remember your name... what... what... Chen Guandong.
Sister Senior hasn't been gone for more than a couple of months, and you've already forgotten me, Brother?
You...?
Who are you, sir? I've only been away for a month or two, and you, my junior disciple, have already forgotten me?
Wearing the red attire of our sect's female disciple, may I ask who you are...?
Only you, an outsider disciple, are left. Going on a mission, still want to pretend to be naive and not go? Thinking you're so clever!
I still have my own tasks to finish, not going!
Not going
Let's go out and take a look
Go out and take a look
This sound sounds familiar
Is there anyone there? Come on, someone help me!
How is this possible!
Ah!
Don't worry, I'll never throw the leftover banana peel carelessly. Because this is going to be thrown on your face!
Senior Brother, I just wiped that area, don't step on it. Also, don't hold the banana while walking and eating, can you do that?
Lowlife, wipe the floor carefully for me, don't even think of being lazy! Chew chew chew.
Ugh, my back and waist are sore‑let me stretch a bit.
Okay
Well, I can't convince you. Finish work early and come play cards‑the one Yunshang invented.
It's just a habit; if not applied, then nothing, but once applied, you can't be careless, otherwise, the whole body feels uncomfortable.
Now, where are there still so many senior masters in our sect? It's certainly not the sect master who will take you in.
I've gotten used to it, always wanting to go all out, hoping a master will notice my diligence and take me in as an apprentice.
You don't need to clean the floor tiles so meticulously every time. Even if they're clean, when the Fourth Senior Brother walks by eating, it's still going to get oily and greasy.
Good. Thank you, Senior Brother.
Disciple, I'll put the water bucket behind for you. When you turn around, don't kick it.

With your silver tongue, you turned ordinary candied hawthorn into a special medicinal dish of the Tang Clan. The villagers believed it to be true, flocking to buy it and eagerly pulling out their money. Not only were there verbal disputes, but intense conflicts even broke out, ultimately escalating to the point where officials had to intervene to settle the matter.
Received widespread acclaim

You bustled with spirit, peddling sugar‑coated hawthorn sticks. The villagers, who recognized you, thought you had finally failed to thrive in the Tang Clan and had left to make a living. They felt a pang of sympathy and generously contributed to your business.
Manageable
In the end, you had to pay out of your own pocket to buy the candied hawthorn, then gave it to others to share, and returned home feeling lonely.
Sugared hawthorn sticks are delicious, but the seller's unattractive appearance affects the appetite. Plus, they're a coin more expensive than usual, so they don't sell at all.
Gloomy and dull
Delicious... candied hawthorn skewers, just six coins for one... Kind‑hearted uncles and aunts, come and buy!
Oh! There's still a fish caught in the net! Bring it over here!

Reporting to the authorities is useless, hahahah, the officials are all my people, have you heard of officials covering for each other? Just give up, you little cuties like you are born to be tormented and destroyed by me!
Oh! Sister Fang, don't go, help us report to the authorities!
If you want, the price is negotiable
You still want another time?
Oh dear! Look at me, I've been holding back for too long, couldn't help it this time, next time I'll be more restrained.
No... no, I was wrong. Sister Ying doesn't want a treasure map; she wants our lives!
Hoo... hoo...
Oh, okay, take care
I've been delaying for so long; I need to hurry to the outer fortress. See you later at the mountain.

Madam Shangguan's gaze was exactly like my older sister's back then... equally dangerous. It's not pretentious, so it's no wonder Yunshang is jealous of Little Junior Sister getting close to me. Now the truth is clear.
It's not that I can't understand Madam Shangguan's feelings. When I was little, Xiaoshigu... my real sister also spoiled me thoroughly.
Senior Brother, save me!!!
Cluck! This isn't a money issue, I'm about to run out of air!
Don't struggle, little darling! Let me hold you for a while! Just close your eyes and count to ten! I'll give you some pocket money! How about ten coins for a breath?

You're such a good child, you're not to be messed with! How could someone be born with such fortune to have skin as white and delicate as a mochi doll and a porcelain doll? Come over quickly, let me hug and rub you and study you!
Huh?
Uh
Actually, my older sister, I love small and delicate things. Therefore, the moment I saw you two, I liked you both so much that I wanted to take you both for myself.
Since you've already said that, I don't need to pretend to be a gentleman anymore.
We are very cute, we know it ourselves. Why hold back on this? You can be more straightforward. Really, the husband has so many thoughts.
Great! Great! I can't help but want to get close to you all, fearing that I might scare you, so I've been pretending to stay calm all along.
Empty words are not enough; you must prove it with action, hurry and pamper us!
Yes, is that so?
I do believe
I think so too, sigh, who would believe that?
No matter how you say it, it's all empty talk.
...How should I say it, would you believe?
Then it should be the one to tell me?
You assume others feel the same as you, and since you already have preconceptions, I suppose you won't believe it. After all, this isn't meant for you to hear.
I won't argue with you. It's impossible to communicate with you. I won't talk to you anymore.

How could I not want? Why can't I? Yunshang and Moling are so pretty and charming; every time I see them, I can't help but like them. I want to be close to them and pamper them. But what does that have to do with you?
It sounds nice, but who knows what kind of wicked schemes are hidden in your belly. Don't you still regard the young misses from other households as mere sisters in name only?

Even if there were treasure, it would be the people's contributions to Yue Wang for resisting the Jin. Righteous wealth should be used righteously, to support the Song dynasty. As a mere merchant, I have no such grand ambitions, and certainly no face to embezzle it.

I can't help but speak, what are you going to do about it? You can't just say that chatting about trivial matters is illegal, and you're meddling so much. Who doesn't want to get rich? You don't have to pretend to be good either; can a good person be a merchant?

Be advised: Even if you believe the rumors about the treasure, you should still maintain good speech. Those who spread rumors also commit verbal transgressions, displaying low character and causing significant harm. As for those who spread gossip and misinformation, they are equally guilty.
What do you want now? Don't be so pushy, or you'll push me to the point where we both end up in a bad situation!
Slow down
Alright, let's not talk anymore. Let's just stop, okay? For real, the daughter of an official is just different. Her words, once spoken, are sharper than a palm strike.
You dare to spread rumors and slander officials again, I will take you to the authorities and show no leniency. You don't believe me? Try it, see if I dare
No, there isn't, I was just saying something random...

May I ask which article of the Song Dynasty's penal code stipulates that officials' children cannot engage in commerce? What you just said seems suspiciously deceptive; are you trying to challenge me in court?
He, as the father, takes office; you, as the daughter, engages in corrupt practices‑it's no different!

Since you're ignorant, I'll only say this once‑listen carefully. My father is an Imperial Court official, not a merchant. The family's commercial ventures are managed by me, Shangguan Ying, and have nothing to do with Lord Shangguan.
You dare to hit me! You... You dare to hit me on Tang Clan's territory!

You're being so harsh towards the old woman, what are you doing? Are you the daughter of the government officials, oppressing the common people? Being both an official and a merchant, isn't that for your own benefit? In other words, that's corruption. Where am I wrong?
The nun's aura was completely suppressed
Sister Ying is so fierce
You... you...

If it weren't for the fact that you're from the Tang Clan, I could have reported to the local authorities to arrest you for insulting my father. Now, I'm being patient and only call you Aunt; you'd better not be ungrateful.
How come I'm nobody anymore? I used to be a Tang Clan female disciple, the same generation as the sect leader. Tell me what you should call me!
Do you know me?
You are the wife of Zhang from Meishan Town. Born into the Tang Clan, now that you're married, you belong to nobody.
You don't act recklessly! Don't touch my adopted son!
When I come to collect the debt, the constables will break the bones of your adopted son. At that time, whether you choose to sue the magistrate's office or Tang Master, it's up to you!

A loan agreement written in black ink on white paper‑unless you act like a robber and tear it up, you have to take responsibility. You can just make a scene; don't hesitate to roll around on the ground again.
You, this unscrupulous merchant, intentionally deceived my well‑behaved son into borrowing money! You are deliberate, you will meet a bad end!
How could I not know? Your stepson still owes me a fortune in debt.
What do you want? Do you know who I am?
Alright, you go to the back first and keep an eye on the two little girls for me.
This... this...
Those few roars could be heard all the way to the end of the street. I'm not deaf.
Madam Shangguan, you, you didn't hear everything, did you?
Other matters aside, I can't just turn a deaf ear to this.

We wouldn't let foreign hands reap the benefits of our hard work. The Shangguan family is notoriously greedy and corrupt; otherwise, how could they have prospered? Wouldn't you be more cautious if you thought she was so kind as to travel far just to flatter this Little Ye? She should have gotten her hands on the items much earlier!
Finally, I'm going home. This time, I can finish the task.
The three of them chatted and laughed, strolled and wandered, until dusk fell, when they finally walked home together.

Spare me, please

I don't... I um... um...

Sister Fang – where is my sugar‑coated hawthorn sticks?

Yunshang sister is truly unfortunate. Ah... Now, although the Tang Clan has no master to rely on, they enjoy the peace. If Shi Gu hadn't married out and nagged every day, I would have had to leave.
Respectfully see off Sister, Sister, take your time.

Since you are so unteachable, there's no point in wasting words with you. I will go back and speak to the sect leader's junior brother about this. This is all I have to say; you should take care of yourself.
That is even more humiliating than death!
Even if there's truly no treasure, this girl's looks are decent enough. Marrying her to my foster son would still be acceptable. I'll just set a few rules for her and properly train her.
Hmph... You dare not.
Master's niece dares not
Understand? What a joke! No respect, lowlife! Are you the superior or am I? A mere junior, daring to scold me? Daring to teach me to do things? Have you gone mad?

How could this be... That's too unreasonable.

Remember: Any descendant of the Tang Clan, even if they are the worst, you must treat them as your own flesh and blood; conversely, those from the Diancang sect, no matter how good they are, you cannot treat them as humans, but as animals! Upon seeing them, just kill them on sight!
Is it really me who is unscrupulous?

Not only her, but all future disciples and descendants of the Diancang sect should also be completely wiped out! As a Tang Clan disciple, you should love your clan. Who gave you the right to use your clever brain to discern right from wrong! Self‑righteousness and unscrupulous intentions!
