Wait, calm down, calm down‑there's something I need to say, something very important.
Tang Buyi, if you have any last words, say them quickly! I'm going to cut you down.
Ah, no. Whenever I see a pretty young lady, I can't help but want to steal a kiss. It's nothing special directed at you.
This is already the second time... Y-You... could it be... could it be that you... feel... toward me...?
Well, at least I gave your face a kiss before I die, so it's not too much of a loss.
I was afraid of messing up! Weren't you afraid that in a fit of anger, I might miss my mark?
...Who told you to hesitate? I had no choice but to resort to that low move—just to give you a push.
You... you really have no conscience. Even though I did stab you with my sword, you also... you clearly took advantage of me too.
You, why are you... Did I guess wrong?

I know. But you must heed my advice. In this desolate mountain wilderness, you won't find any chicken legs to eat, especially since your injuries haven't healed, and you should avoid oily and salty foods. Just eat whatever you can manage; don't be so picky.
You know? Are you really that smart?
I know what you want to say
Please stay, Heroine Long, I have something to say.
I apologize, it was my oversight. I'll get you some water and arrange for food right away.

And on top of that, bouncing along the whole way, losing this much blood. All those mountain bandit brothers wept as they saw me off, but I had to play dead—couldn't eat, couldn't drink. Even if the pain didn't kill me, hunger, thirst, and craving surely would.
Even if the organs are unharmed, it still went straight through from front to back—a clean hole. Anyone would feel pain and bleed from that, right?

I-I should have avoided your vital organs and acupoints, right? I've mastered the essence of Soft Sword of The Twisting Finger, inside and out—practiced until I pierced countless chickens before I got it right. When I stabbed you, the feel of it wasn't bad either...
What kind of foolish question is that? Of course it hurts. Do you want me to stab you and let you find out for yourself?
...Does the wound I gave you hurt?
I see. Fine, I'll do as you say.
The horses are innocent. I'll set them free
I don't want to keep the carriage that Wanyan Xun gave me. I planned all along to smash and burn it once we reached Song territory. As for the horses...
Why are you rushing me out of the carriage? I took a sword strike from you—can't you have a little kindness and escort me all the way home?
Alright, we've entered the territory of the Song Kingdom. Get up quickly.

Whether out of guilt or some other motive, he declared that the death of Marshal Pusan Anzhen was carried out under his own imperial decree—strictly forbidding soldiers and officers from discussing it privately, and instructing the court historians to record it as such. Thus, from the annals of history, he erased the traces of Tang Buyi and Long Xiang.

No matter how many eloquent justifications he could use to convince others, he could not deceive himself. Whether lies or truth, the people he cared about simply would not listen. From then on, ties of affection were severed. Though his position was high and his power great, and sycophants flocked to him in countless numbers, there was no longer a single person who would bare their heart to him. Truly lamentable.

Long Yuan, oh Long Yuan, I am truly sorry for you, dear Brother. I am both incompetent and foolish. Do I not wish to govern diligently and turn the tide? I never wanted to become this kind of person either...

That child has grown up so quickly, with such spirit, just like their father. I have been plotting against Long Yuan from the beginning, yet he has always trusted me without doubt. Without him, how could I, Wuyan Wudu, have today? Sigh.
Eh? Ah? Your Majesty, please forgive me!
Guards! Drag this wretch away. First perform castration, then cut off his head—it's useless keeping it on him anyway.
How outrageous! This Song woman has such boldness! The young general requests permission to pursue this woman. Capture her and throw her into the laundry courtyard for the Emperor's amusement!

According to reason, I should issue an order to capture her. She said that the next time we meet will be my death date; threatening the Emperor of the Golden Dynasty is a crime that deserves punishment.
I do not wish to betray the trust of old friends again.
Although the main suspect is dead, the accomplices are still at large. Is that... ?
...Did you not hear? It was I who let her go, and it was I who provided her carriage.
Your subordinate arrived late to the rescue, Your Majesty. Please forgive me! I will immediately send someone to pursue the assassin.

After that battle, Long Xiang firmly declined the Jin Emperor's entreaties to stay. She asked only for a horse-drawn carriage, and alone she carried the assassin Tang Buyi's remains back to the Central Plains to bury him. Leaving Wanyan Xun alone, lost in melancholy reflection.
I understand. I am confident. Young Hero Tang, please enlighten me!

Miss Long, I have heard that Jinxiang Palace has a technique called Soft Sword of the Twisting Finger, which is profound and extensive.  I've been wanting to experience it. I just don't know... do you know how to perform it?
Xiang'er, would you be willing to see this brave swordsman off on his final journey for your uncle?
Do you really want to fight me?
I at least count as a master of martial arts. I don't want to die at the hands of some nameless nobody. Miss Long has sided with Your Majesty—how about I ask Miss Long for some pointers instead?
No need to thank me, I keep my word. However, your life must be left behind.
Thank you, Your Majesty

The mountain bandits exchanged glances. They had come to assassinate the Jin emperor with nothing to lose, fully expecting certain death. Yet who among them did not cherish their own lives? Hearing this decree, they could scarcely believe it. Supporting one another, carrying their wounded and fallen brothers, they withdrew.
...Good. This is fine.
All irrelevant personnel, withdraw immediately. If you linger any longer, do not blame me for my heavenly might striking down upon you!
All generals, heed the command and announce my decree: release all captured assassins.
That's what I've been saying all along.
Your Majesty of the Great Jin, your word is your bond. I propose a trade with you. I'll exchange your life for the safe return of all these mountain bandit brothers. How about it?

If you and I fight, at least one you can live. If we're on the same side, then both of us will end up here. And drag along all these mountain bandit brothers with us—all descending to the Yellow Springs together, what a lively party.
If you fight alongside me, even if the dog emperor wants to spare your life out of old sentiment, how can those arrows, dense as a locust swarm, tell who is who?
Wh-What? How am I naive? I thought about all of this at home for a long time before making my decision!
How can you be so naive? Hahahaha!

Young Hero Tang, if you want to kill this man, you'll have to come back tomorrow. Do you insist on striking him dead, even if it means fighting me? Or would you rather join forces with me to break through the encirclement together?
But please remember, my father has never wronged you; it is only you who owe him. The next time you see my face will be your time of death.

This is the last time I will address you as Prince Yi, Wanyan Xun. You risked coming to the front lines only because Xiang'er wrote to invite you. Xiang'er appreciates your sentiment, and so today, with me here, no one will take your life.
Long Xiang drew her sword and cut the hem of her skirt, symbolizing the severing of ties and loyalty.
Your highness, Prince Yi, you'v misunderstood. I'm not pleading for mercy. What I want to ask is that you stop calling yourself my father's sworn brother. You are not worthy.

No, it's just me and my Junior Brother Zhao here who like to trade barbs. The others wouldn't waste words with you. If my Second Senior Brother had come, His Imperial Majesty would already be standing trial before King Yama by now.
Is the Tang Clan always this sharp‑tongued?

I'm not begging His Majesty for mercy. This worthless life of mine—if it can buy a Jin marshal and the Jin emperor, that's not a bad trade. On the Yellow Springs Road, I'll still get a good beating in, and push you off the Bridge of Helplessness—let's see if you drown or not.

Otherwise, everyone will imitate them to carry out assassinations, and I will never have a moment of peace. What will become of my authority? Moreover, they killed my loyal minister, Pu San Anzheng; punishing their entire family would be too lenient.

I could never bear to harm your life, but if you wish for me to spare this person's life, that I cannot do. For the sake of your plea on his behalf, I may remit the death penalty for the accomplices. But this man is the principal offender—under no circumstances can he be released.
Your Highness, Prince Yi, this humble woman respectfully thanks you for your kindness, but I have only one request to make.
As for Xiang'er, come back with me to Bianjing City, and I will grant you the title of County Princess.
...Damn it, it really feels like I'm going to die today.
No matter how high your qinggong may be, you are still a mortal. With my hundred thousand strong troops surrounding you alone, how can you save yourself?
That's not necessarily true! I run very fast.
You came here with your followers to assassinate me—whether you succeed or fail, you're walking a dead-end path. You should have known that long ago.
You noticed too? So it turns out you were referring to those people laying in ambush.
Sigh, I have advised Your Highness twice to dismiss those around you, yet you do not trust me.
...So you knew all along.

You say that I, a Song person, harbor ill intentions, hiding a blade behind a smile. But how are you any different? You remain calm and collected, having people lie in ambush on either side, bow drawn and arrows ready. As soon as I distance myself from you, the moment you feel safe, you will order a rain of arrows to shoot me into a beehive, won't you?

Your Majesty's words, I understand clearly. If it were someone else from the Jianghu, they might have been moved by a grand speech. Although I do not know how much of what you say is true and how much is false, I will assume that it is all falsehoods.

When that time comes, matters in the Central Plains will all depend on the strength of you young people. If you want to settle these disputes, you must seize power. Otherwise, as the emperor of a nation, why would I listen to your advice? Mere courage of a single man will accomplish nothing!

Therefore, I must sever the private ties I once had with your father. Even if you harm me today, there will be a new ruler to take the throne tomorrow, and the conflict between the Song and Jin will never cease. However, if you are able to abandon the darkness and embrace the light, I am willing to give you a chance.
Such provocation! I ask, if I do not attack the Song Kingdom, how can I face my ancestors? I can assert that the humiliation suffered by the Song Kingdom is entirely of their own making!

When the Song recognized the might of our Great Jin's armies and addressed Jin as "Uncle," offering annual tribute to seek peace—fine, then peace it was. Yet later, while Great Jin was at war with the Mongols and the Western Xia, the Song resorted to underhanded tricks and broke their word, tearing up the Jiading Peace Agreement.

What you refer to as the Jingkang Incident also resonates with me; this is a sin, and the responsibility lies solely with us. However, attacking Song to expand our territory is for the foundation of our great Jin, and it is also to uphold the honor of our ancestors.
Alright, don't ask questions right now.
Where are the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun?

The founding emperor insisted on maintaining a good relationship with the Song. Yet after the war, the Song acted as if they had rendered great and meritorious service. Let me ask you Wulin people, can you tolerate such a useless and greedy neighbor? Can you endure it?

Nonsense. The Song did it on purpose—they couldn't care less. After all, it was the Jin who suffered under Liao oppression. The Song were merely going through the motions, conserving their strength, waiting for the Jin and Liao to tear each other apart so they could sit back and reclaim the Sixteen Prefectures of Yanyun!
Victory and defeat are common matters in warfare; how can Your Majesty hold a grudge against the Song state for this reason?

After our Great Jin's Taizu Emperor founded the dynasty, he established the "Maritime Alliance" with the Song and launched war against the Liao. Yet the Song were passive and reluctant to fight. Even when they did march to battle, they lost.
This is not just about having a meal; it's about dignity.
Even so... it's just a matter of having a meal.

You Song love to show off your refined elegance. When you eat a meal, you invent all sorts of flashy, impractical formalities. You put out "display dishes" that no one is allowed to touch. Whoever breaks your taboos gets mocked by the whole crowd, just to flaunt how noble you Song are. You look down on others, consider yourselves the superior nation, and at every turn sneer at people as "barbarians who eat raw meat and drink blood."

I know it all too well. After the Liao dynasty fell, the Song-Jin war began. You Song people are all the same—extravagant, wasteful, and pretentious. When I traveled through the Central Plains with your father, I saw far too much of it.

You Song people naturally find us Jin people detestable. Do you remember the humiliation of Emperor Qinzong and Emperor Huizong being captured? Do you know how arrogant and cruel the Song nation was towards us Jin people before the fall of Liao?
It's laughable. You Jin people are insatiable, repeatedly invading our Great Song territory, and you have the nerve to call us detestable? Even I know about the calamity of Jingkang.
Because the Song people are even more detestable than you think.
Why not?!
Still no.
So now, can the Song and Jin coexist peacefully?
I took the head from his shoulders and casually used it as a Hidden Weapon, killing one of His Majesty the Emperor's royal guards.
With Zhuhu Gaoqi dead, there is still the Left Vice Marshal, Pusan Anzhen. But he is also dead now—he was just killed by that warrior behind you.
Then why are the battles still going on?
That won't work, because Zhuhu Gaoqi is already dead—I ordered his execution.
So Zhuhu Gaoqi is the chief culprit of the Song-Jin war? If he is killed, will the war end?
...The ones who advocated war were first Hu Shahu, who held significant power in the court and among the people, followed by Zhuhu Gaoqi.
Very well, please continue
All generals, heed my command! Everyone, cease fighting! No one is allowed to continue!
The imperial court has issued an order, all soldiers of the Jin Kingdom, cease your actions!
...... wait wait.

Today, I come to see Your Highness to ask you to answer me seriously, considering my late father's sake. I am not very learned and cannot understand complicated words; I just want to know why you do not keep your promises.
...Sigh, your father's death is indeed partly my responsibility; I feel guilty towards Brother Long.
It is because of you that my father severed his own arm to apologize to the comrades of Wulin. All his life's hardships were wasted, and he passed away in disgrace.

I'm not talking about that; I'm referring to your betrayal and the matter of raising troops to attack Song. Didn't you swear an oath with my father, pledging to work diligently to resolve the century‑old grievances between our two nations?

...After your father passed away, I issued multiple edicts to bring you to the Jin Kingdom to enjoy wealth and honor, but your master, Lady Wen, politely refused each time. I was just about to directly ask the officials of the Song Kingdom for you.
But later, after you became the emperor, you cast aside your oath.
How could I forget? He is a Song person, not suspicious of me because I am from the Jin, nor flattering me because I am a noble. He is even closer to me than my half‑brother Wanyan Jing!
You are certainly good to me, but you can't say the same for my father. Have you forgotten how he once saved you from peril?
Then why...?

Your Highness, please do not panic. Even if I were to take your life, it would certainly not be today. I am not someone who is ungrateful; I naturally remember your kindness. Even if I do not dare to accept the treasures you bestow, I am grateful in my heart.
Xiang'er, why do you want to kill me? Have you forgotten? I held you when you were still in swaddling clothes!
I can kill you
I believe you. The daughter of Long Yuan—of course her martial arts go without saying. From now on, with you by my side, who in this world could possibly kill me?
My martial arts skills are no worse than his.
Great hero, your martial arts are superb. Those few guards of mine were elites chosen from ten thousand. Who would have thought that even giving their lives, they could only tear off your mask.
How can you say I didn't cover my face? It was torn off by those imperial guard warriors under that man's command.
Speaking of which, how could you attempt an assassination without a disguise? That's quite arrogant!
Whether he spares you or not depends on Your Highness's answer when the time comes.

You ask me to dismiss those around me... but all the warriors by my side have already been killed by this brave swordsman and his men. He chose the moment when I personally led the imperial campaign to strike—why would he leave me any path to survival?
...This humble woman once again begs His Highness Prince Yi to issue a decree dismissing those around you.
What! What did he just say?!
I was also the sworn elder brother of your father, the great hero Long Yuan!
You are the former Prince Yi, now the Great Jin Emperor, Wanyan Xun.
How difficult it is to see you even once. After all these years of waiting, I finally receive a single letter from you. Do you still remember this old uncle?
But for you to trust me so much, even turning your back to me... this really makes it impossible to strike.
You've guessed wrong. I don't only intend to kill the dog emperor—I've also entertained the thought of killing you.
In that case, please dismiss the guards. I have something to say. Rest assured, with me here, this hero will not act recklessly.
How could I possibly doubt you?

Prince Yi, that letter was indeed written by me, Long Xiang, a common woman. Although I am acquainted with this hero, we are not conspirators. Our meeting here is purely coincidental. I beg Your Highness to see the truth clearly!
It's not what you think. Stay your hand for a moment.

This place is dangerous—I must end this quickly. Though I am reluctant to strike a woman harshly, Miss Long's martial arts are formidable. If I don't fight with the resolve to kill her, I will definitely lose.
Well, it turns out you are in the same boat as the Jin.
Is it really you, Xiang'er? I thought that letter was forged by this person in your name to lure me away from Bianjing for an assassination!
It's me. Hello.
You are – Heroine Long of Jinxiang Palace?
My life is at an end!
Wait, my ass! Who's got time for all your nonsense!
Warrior, wait!
Oh!
Us mountain bandits—in Song territory we're traitors, but in Jin territory we'd be heroes. To fight alongside Flying Hero Tang Buyi—even dying would be an honor!
Ha, "none of you die"? Who here today still expects to go home.
Alright! None of you die on me—we'll drink together when this is over!
Great Hero Tang, we'll hold them off here! That dog emperor is yours to deal with!
How dare you, vile assassin—you dare attempt to assassinate the Emperor!
Protect the carriage! Someone! There's an assassin! Hurry, protect the carriage!

Though the Flying Hero is no mere title, your qinggong today is certainly on par with his. However, a sudden appearance of a shoulder armor attendant at the corner caught you off guard. You collided head‑on with the shoulder armor, unable to retract your momentum in time. You fell to the ground, rolling and tumbling, unsure how many bones were broken. All you could do was watch helplessly as Senior Brother dusted himself off and left.

However, the agile hero is no mere pretender. Your qinggong skills have always fallen short of Senior Brother's. After chasing for a while, you could only watch as he grew farther and farther away with several leaps and vanished from your view. You stood there in confusion for a moment before finally giving up.
Ah, bastard, don't run!
Just because you can fight me doesn't mean you can outrun me.
What?
But you know how it is, right?
That's great!
Of course it's true. Be confident; you are already a skilled expert who can stand on your own.
Really?
Unless it's not a fight
However, even if I give it my all to fight you, I still might not be able to win.
Indeed
What are you joking about? Of course, I let it go.
I, I won! Senior Brother, you didn't go easy on me, did you?
Oh, oh wow, this is truly remarkable. Not long ago, they were all over the place with their gymnastics, and today they can actually manage to impress me.
...I really believe you, so don't go back on your word. Otherwise, next time, I'll go to the Jin Kingdom instead.
Senior Brother really is still Senior Brother
It said: I am very strong; I won't die, so you can relax completely.
What did your fist say?
The one not listening is you. Haven't I already told you everything I wanted to say with my fists?
There are opinions, but you just refuse to listen.
Now there are no objections, right?
Ah
As you slowly came to, the Senior Brother was already gone, and you immediately realized he had tricked you. He had tossed a secret manual onto you—one he had recently acquired.
I will be back soon
...This time, I’ve struck a spot that’ll really knock someone out. Junior Brother, this mission is dangerous, and I’m not entirely confident in my chances. You’d better stay put here.
I'm going to see her
The carriage has just arrived. Right now, they are outside talking with Uncle Nangong.
Is Little Junior Sister going too? Wait, when did she come to Jiangling?
When it comes to Qinggong, the only one who can compare with me and is willing to obey my orders is of course our Little Junior Sister.
No you didn't
Didn't I mention them just now?
Three people? Do we still have companions?
Then pack your things quickly, the three of us will set off immediately.
......You're right.

That's right, let's pull the rug out from under them. Let's take out that old emperor of the Jin Dynasty and his general. Let’s see if those Jin bastards would still dare to flex their muscles and take advantage of our Great Song Dynasty.
Oh... are you going too?
I will go with you
Oh, great! It's been a long time since we sparred. Bring it on!
Upon careful consideration, I think I should beat you up first to help you calm down before we talk.
Don't go!
However, I understand the word triumph. Don't worry, I'll be back soon.
Junior disciple......your knowledge is really profound; I didn't understand half of what you said.
Eldest Senior Brother, take care on your journey. With the blessings of martial fortune and the favor of the winds, I believe you will surely return victorious.
Oh! I'll be right back.
Eldest Senior Brother, be cautious in everything and have a smooth journey.
That's good. Junior Brother, I will set off now. If luck is on our side, not only will there be no need to fight in Jiangling, but the troubles from the Song and Jin armies may also be resolved.
Travel safely

To summarize, you must remember to keep my whereabouts confidential for now. Once the matter in Jiangling is settled, return to the Tang Clan. If I haven’t returned yet, you must pay a personal visit to the Sect Leader and report my whereabouts to Master then ask him to decide what to do.
I just said it casually...
Alright, starting today, this will be my second goal in life.
What a great idea
Alright, if someone asks, I'll say you went to a pleasure house. You suddenly had the idea to tour all the pleasure houses across the country.
Ha, fortunately, my martial arts skills are higher than yours.
That's true; actually, I also want to give you a good beating to stop you from being foolish.
If I say it, I won't be able to leave.
You made such a momentous decision without first consulting the Sect Leader or Third Senior Brother?
Let's get back to the main topic. This mission must remain secret. Don’t go telling everyone I’ve gone to the Jin Kingdom, or else you might really get me killed.
Hahaha!
Hahaha, you stinking scoundrel!
Who said I’m betraying you out of loyalty to the country? Of course I’m doing it for the reward!
How could you! You and the Emperor may both share the surname Zhao, but when did he ever befriend you? You’re actually betraying me for a stranger who’s a world away.
Should I report you the authorities right now and immediately have you arrested as a traitorous rebel?
In this way, it seems that the noblewomen of the deep palace are not as straightforward and simple as the women of Jianghu.
Indeed, I thought I could support all women in the world. However, after a trip to the palace, I realized that a person's capacity for wickedness knows no bounds of gender or age.
You rarely have so many complaints about women.

At least the ladies of the pleasure houses strive to earn your favor through their own efforts, being soft yet resilient. Unlike the women in the palace who do not engage in production and only compare their family backgrounds, plotting and scheming while considering themselves superior. When the official is present, they are gentle and virtuous; but as soon as he is gone, they become arrogant.

They were all dressed in finely embroidered silken robes and had elaborate makeup. But... those women who never left the palace and couldn't explain why they felt superior yet were arrogant and extravagant, I find them unpleasant to look at. If I have to say it, the sisters from the pleasure house are much more likable.
Are the imperial concubines in the palace really all as beautiful as flowers?
...Is that true or not?
I’ve even infiltrated the Song Imperial Palace. Do you think my nickname "Flying Hero" is just for show?
Who said that? I'm not going to die.
No way, don't joke around. You're the one who's planning to get yourself killed, right?
Rest in peace, Junior Brother. You're about to be killed; do you have any last words to say?
What are you making so much noise about early in the morning! Damn it, Zhao Huo, I'll beat you to death once I've had enough sleep!
What?!!
I plan to first go to Xiangyang, then to Bianjing to assess the situation. If I get the chance, I will eliminate the Jin Kingdom's general, or even take out the Jin Emperor directly.
What...?
I want to take a trip to the Jin Kingdom.
You misunderstood. This time I'm not taking you along.
...I guess I have no choice. You wait for me outside first. I'll wash my face and get dressed, then I'll go with you.
That's true
I fear I may not return for a while, so I wanted to let you know. In case someone asks where I have gone, you will have something to say.
If you want to go, just go! Why tell me?
That's not it. I've thought about it for a long time and I've decided to go somewhere.
Of course I remember... why, is that thing not over yet? Is he coming to kidnap A'Qian again?
Do you remember the incident with Sect Leader Wang a few days ago?
What's going on! Even coming to Jiangling, I can't find any peace! You are truly a calamity in my fate, can't you let me sleep?
I'm awake!
Junior brother... Hey, you worthless person, wake up! Stop sleeping, wake up already!.
Then please thank the master on my behalf.

Young Hero Zhao, this is the Master's instruction to give you your hardship money. Originally, the deep friendship between Tang Clan and Nangong does not need compensation with money for such noble deeds, but I still ask you to accept it with a smile.
The head of the Nangong family, with a look of someone who has been through it all, smiled and walked away.

Nephew Tang still understands such refined matters, which is unexpected. Well, there's nothing to be done. In my youth, was I not also a dashing young man? Who can resist the allure of a soft embrace?
Elder Brother, since you often linger in places of pleasure, your reputation is already what it is. I have no choice in this matter, but it can't be said that I am wronging you.
Indeed, they have an appointment tonight to listen to music and admire the moon.
Pleasure House?
He went to the pleasure house
Thank you, Hero Nangong, for your generous gift!
Yes, my lord

Is that so? Then I must trouble both of you. I will go inside to check on Qian'er's condition, so I must excuse myself. This small amount of money is not much of a token of respect, but please accept it on behalf of your Master Brother. Ah Yi.
I don't know them
I wonder where your senior brother is at this moment? Why hasn't they come to greet us in person?
Hehe, this is nothing special
Hero Nangong, you are too kind
Thanks to the two talented nephews for stepping in to save someone, being able to rescue a person from the hands of Dharma King is truly showcasing that heroes emerge in youth.
──The events unfolded as follows

As soon as I arrived at the Nangong family, I felt completely out of place. No matter how expensive or luxurious their beds and bedding were, they couldn't compare to the freedom I felt hanging out on a tree branch. And just like that, I left.
Can't you think about returning to the Nangong family?
Leader Wang mentioned something that resonated with me deeply; I need to think it over.
What about you?
...Disciple, take Second Young Lord back with you.

The Senior Brother took out a precious wine cup from his personal collection and filled it with wine. The three of them drank silently, clinking their cups together before performing a respectful bow to each other. Wang Erzhuang then stepped away with purpose. Next time they met, they would be rivals once again.
I'll drink too... Alright, I'll risk my life to accompany the gentleman.
Okay
Junior Disciple, you should drink too
I don't love drinking, yet you all keep forcing it on me... Just give it here.
Wait a moment... Lord Wang, would you like to have a drink?

If you two let the news slip, causing the people of the Wulin to be indecisive, that would be quite embarrassing. I, Wang, might as well take Jiangling seriously, rebel, and declare myself king, hahaha!

You don't need to worry about this, I'll take care of my own people, and I won't treat them unfairly. As for tonight, don't take it to heart when you hear it; if a fight needs to happen, then let it happen.

Leader Wang is deeply concerned about the great cause of the nation, and Tang admires this greatly. However, with so many brothers in the Beggar Sect looking up to you and following you, how can you bear to wager their lives? One must understand that in times of turmoil, with so many people in the Beggar Sect, no one can escape unscathed.
Everyone knows how fierce our sect leader used to be.
This is not impossible

It's a joke; your Tang Clan is struggling to protect itself now, so take care of your own matters. Regardless of whether the Imperial Court is good or bad, the Tang Clan has never allied with anyone, and they have a very stubborn temperament. I'm just afraid that if there's a disagreement, the Tang Clan leader might even strike the envoy from the Imperial Court.
Leader Wang, are you willing to gather your troops and accompany me to Shu to meet my master?

The Sect Master's thoughts ran deep; the siege was for the sake of his country and its people... Compared to this, the disputes and emotions of so‑called Righteous Heroes seemed like child's play. Such a person... would serve as the Dharma King of the Demon Sect's Beast Path?

Wang Mou besieged the city to unite the military and civilians of Jiangling as one. To dissolve old grudges, share a common hatred for the enemy, and join hands to resist foreign aggression‑this is the true remedy for saving the nation. If Brother Shangguan and I were to take action, I would fight the Painting Immortal, while he would fight Lady Wen. Our chances of success would be considerable. However, the issue is that although Brother Shangguan is as ruthless as he is, he is also a servant at Lady Wen's feet. How could he possibly put forth his full effort?

Shangguan Household Head has a profound Neigong foundation. Even without training in the Jinxiang Palace's *Xuanzhuo Heart Sutra*, they might still be able to resist. As for the Young Lord, he will listen closely to our palace mistress's String Melody. How his fate will play out is anyone's guess.

Lady Wen is renowned in the Jianghu for her sound wave techniques. None of the heroes present would consider it mere bluster; they believed they had surrounded their enemies and could rely on their numbers to secure victory. Little did they know, they were the ones being threatened, and immediately, everyone turned pale with fear.
Let me put it this way: Before all the servants die, I can kill ten times as many martial artists as there are servants.

Palace attendant monk, focusing fully on activating the Sound Wave Technique, the string sounds reached everyone present. Even if a martial artist's inner strength and mental fortitude were slightly weaker, they would surely suffer from injuries that could never be completely healed, even if they didn't fall into madness and die from vomiting blood.
Not a single soldier or warrior? Haha, how naive of the eldest prince.

...Even though array formations can be infinitely mysterious and profound, human energy has its limits. Though you might not fall in the short term, you will eventually succumb. Give up this stubborn resistance. If I encircle but do not attack, waiting for you to exhaust your energy, I won't need to deploy a single soldier or resource; the formation will disintegrate on its own.

Elder Shangguan spoke too simply. This array's intention to change but not changing, its fluctuations indecisive, is not solely about seeking perfection without flaws. Instead, it creates a hidden vulnerability that tempts the enemy to make their move, allowing for a subsequent counterattack. It subtly contains the principles of yin and yang, flowing ceaselessly at all times, much like turbulent underwater currents‑truly terrifying.
Shangguan had only superficially dabbled in military studies and knew little of the intricacies. Yet, they could vaguely sense that this formation was no small matter.

Lord Shangguan speaks plainly. Allow me to be frank with you. The Fenghou Array in Jinxiang Palace has eight transformations and can repel a larger force with fewer troops. Though it cannot win outright, it can maintain an unbeaten position for some time. Even powerful leaders of the Six Sects would find it impossible to break through the array without discerning its key points, no matter how much brute strength they wield.

Eldest Young Lord, what Lady Wen said is not false. Let us avoid idle disputes that serve no purpose. The Household Governor handles myriad affairs daily and must focus on the broader picture. Governance relies on various officials in the court submitting memorials for his consideration; he cannot attend to every detail personally.
This... Are you insulting His Majesty by failing to distinguish right from wrong?

The emperor reigns high in the temple hall, and all affairs of the Jianghu are reported by ministers. Do you think that the officials can distinguish between friend and foe? The eldest young lord could topple a whole boat with one pole, and the officials might not be unaware of such skills.
We are all part of the Jianghu, so your eldest Young Lord is also one of us.
...You are all from the Mud Cult, like snakes and rats in the same den. Birds of a feather flock together, so you naturally bear the responsibility.
But what does that have to do with my Jinxiang Palace?
The eldest young lord's words are quite reasonable.

Never mind the Dharma King of the Beast Path who dared to incite the Beggar Sect to surround Jiangling and cause unrest. The evidence against plotting is irrefutable. One must know that Jiangling is crucial for support to Xiangyang and transportation of front‑line supplies, all relying on Jiangling's logistics. If not for a united effort from the government and nobility, and later, Brother Li, the Sect Master, upholding righteousness by eliminating his own kin, wouldn't this have led to national disaster!
The Hell's Path engages in all manner of deceit and trickery, exhibiting supernatural strength and madness. They plunder and torture indiscriminately, defying the law entirely!

Dharma King Liu E of the Hungry Ghost Path gathered pirates and roamed the East Sea, attacking officials and troubling the people. He was placed on the wanted list with a bounty by the court and is listed as the top evil person under the Heavenly Character first number in the sea capture documents.
Lady Wen said that according to your Mud Cult, starving ghosts, hell, and animals' actions are not considered evil?
Lord Shangguan, hold on. This is spoken too soon.

...Jinxiang Palace standing in the Jianghu, besides challenging conventions, indeed has no blemish. If the palace mistress surrenders, I can show mercy out of old feelings and spare your palace ladies from extreme punishment.
Oh well, if that's the case, then Jinxiang Palace should have all those people who were saved in the past immediately commit suicide to repay their lives.

Our conduct has been open to the scrutiny of all in the Jianghu, for everyone to see and hear. Do you really believe that everything we did before was false just because our beliefs differ? Is what you consider righteous truly righteous?

Once, Jinxiang Palace was part of the righteous path, and the Imperial Court could still be tolerant and magnanimous. But now, you palace attendants are rebels, so naturally, you cannot be treated the same way.
Lord Shangguan, we are acquaintances. Let's be straightforward. If you are really in trouble for this, there is no need to wait until today to take retribution.
Jinxiang Palace defies Confucian rites, which goes against the foundational principles upon which our dynasty was established.
This palace wishes to ask Lord, may I ask the Alliance Leader, what grave offenses have we committed that the court and the Wulin Alliance relentlessly pursue us, refusing any mercy?

Shangguan Jun was a veteran of the Wulin accustomed to great waves and storms, while Nangong Shen was a man of both literary and martial talent, a standout among the new generation of the Wulin, with the air of a general. The two plunged deep into the heavily guarded area without any hint of fear, and everyone present couldn't help but give them silent applause.
Is that so? Forget it.
The ability refined in officialdom, other than that, showing no emotions on one's face is ordinary and common.
Lord Shangguan seems rather unshaken by my status as the Mud Cult's Dharma King, doesn't he?
I wonder what Brother Mansion has invited us here to teach us?
...good.

My father is the Alliance Leader of Wulin, revered by all. A gentleman does not stand by a precarious wall; hence, he cannot come in person. Please forgive Master's absence. Senior, should you have any words to convey, your late disciple will listen with great respect.
Is Nangong Yuan not coming?
Younger brother Nangong Shen pays homage to Senior.

Upon Lady Wen's command, Fenghou tore a gap in the formation, allowing people to enter. The array then immediately began to flow and constrict. This array had both offensive and defensive capabilities; it was easy to enter but extremely difficult to exit, much like climbing heaven itself. Unless one's qinggong were unparalleled, allowing them to leap several dozen feet and escape over the formation, it would be virtually impossible to leave.
Sister Xiang...... Sigh.
The situation is unclear; to avoid implicating the sect, I will refrain from making a statement for now.
Thank you all... otherwise, I really wouldn't know where to stand.
Before you clear your debt, don't think about running away.
...There might be a slight inconvenience for you as well.
No one is comparing you on this
Hehe, I won
Besides Young Miss Ye, nobody else causes more trouble than you.
No?
I don't have any!
Please, you've caused enough trouble already. Now you're being polite?
But I fear dragging you into this

Exactly. Miss Long should not wander around either. In case of chaos during a battle, even high‑level martial arts skills cannot guarantee no injuries. It's better to stay with the Tang Clan for mutual support.
The clear will clarify itself, and the turbid will turbidify itself; let what they say. Anyway, I've got you now. You want to run? Unless you kill me.
Where else can you go? You stay here.
Ignoring the cold gazes of others, they took in Long Xiang.
When I haven't said it's good
The words had barely left his mouth when he noticed the gazes of those around him, and immediately reconsidered his decision.
Tang Clan great heroes... can I stay here for a while?
Brother... Can I stay with you for a bit?

Don't rush just yet... Lady Wen invited the Alliance Leader and Master Shangguan to discuss something, didn't she? Let's observe their intentions first and avoid creating unnecessary trouble for ourselves.
What should we do, senior brother!
The numbers are too disparate; even with that array of spells, the servants of Jinxiang Palace would still find it hard to escape death.

Although Jinxiang Palace was temporarily at a standstill due to the array formation, the disparity in numbers was too great. Even if Sun Wu were reincarnated, he would find it difficult to turn the tide. Jinxiang Palace was destined to fall here.
I even thought about switching to the Jinxiang Palace!
Didn't we live in the Magic Cave a few days ago? Thought it was a Land of Softness, but turns out it's a Dragon Pond and Tiger Den!
Jinxiang Palace Lady Wen is the Dharma King, Jinxiang Palace is the Human Path!
Chaos! Chaos! How could a peaceful Wulin gathering turn out this way?

Thought everything was settled, unforeseen events suddenly unfolded. Many associations blossomed in Xiao Ju's mind, spiraling out of control. The more she thought about it, the more alarmed she became.

Does the princess not know about this? No... she must be aware. Even if the situation has evolved in such a way, maybe it was all arranged by the princess herself. But why...? Is she going to abandon Jinxiang Palace?
Lady Wen is... the Dharma King of the Human Path!
Lady Wen is actually the Dharma King of the Human Path!
Something big has happened!
Don't run off yet; let's see the situation first!
A'Huo, don't move here. I'll go help Auntie!
So what if that's the case? The Tang Clan wasn't wronged too? Just because someone says it, you believe it!
But they are from the Mud Cult!
I, we should hurry to help the female heroes of Jinxiang Palace!
Oh no, oh no! A fight is about to start!
With your words, I can come back to life even if I die.
...Young Lord, please also be careful.
...Then I shall trouble Big Brother Li to look after me more.
Lady Firefly, don't worry. I will handle it from the side, so there should be no mistake.

They dare not move against me; otherwise, the Human Path would be solidly branded with the name of rebellion. With Lord Song present, a single command could result in the complete destruction of all those in Jinxiang Palace.
Father, be wary of any deceit. As an official of the imperial court, you cannot risk your safety.
Young Lord, let's go
Desire but cannot obtain
Do you have the courage to accompany your Uncle Shangguan on this journey?
Child is here
Shen'er, come here
...Brother, your words seem to be correct as well.

Why not let Young Lord take charge? They are the heir you have been nurturing, possessing both martial skills and courage, with only experience lacking. Isn't this a great opportunity? With me watching over them, I can ensure their safety without a scratch.
If I do not intervene, how can we resolve this matter today!

Brother Yuan, no! You must not enter the array now; it would be equivalent to putting yourself in an unjust situation! Your old feelings for Lady Wen are well‑known to all. As the Alliance Leader, you need to avoid suspicion! No matter how you intervene, you will inevitably be criticized by others, let alone gain their respect? Do we still want to be the Wulin Alliance Leader?
Great! I'll be right there!
Wulin Alliance Leader, Lord Shangguan! Would you be willing to enter the array for a conversation? I can guarantee that the palace servants will not touch you with even a finger!
Who dares to touch her! You have to ask me first, on this chessboard!

If Great Hero Nangong were to act on personal bias, who would believe those lofty principles you just espoused? You may have a past with that witch, but it cannot stop everyone from tearing them to pieces!

We can trust the Great Hero Nangong! But you must not be blinded by lust and speak falsely! That Dharma King of the Hungry Ghosts, Hell, and Animals is a depraved and wicked fellow. As they say, birds of a feather flock together. This woman, associating with evil doers, surely harbors malicious intentions; how could there possibly be any misunderstanding?

Ladies and gentlemen, please bear with me; there must be a misunderstanding! Allow Brother Nangong to speak for a moment! As I know, Lady Wen is far from being a vicious person. Though Jinxiang Palace consists of women, they have always been at the forefront in doing good deeds in the Jianghu!
You first be quiet
Oh well, one can't say it's entirely your fault.
Just so! The Human Path is known to be the most adept at playing with people's hearts! You lot from the paths of evil and distortion can't have any good intentions left! Stop pretending!

You have the nerve to say this? Your face is too thick! For us to have devoted our hearts in friendship, yet you, this group of traitorous women, harbor sinister intentions, seeking fame and profit by deceiving heroes under heaven! Now that you are afraid, do you want to appeal to emotions instead!
We have retired from the Jianghu and shall no longer be involved in mundane affairs of the mortal world. Why must you press us so, great heroes? Do you not harbor any old feelings at all?

This is the true enemy of your great ambition: the preconceptions that overshadow humanity. It is the result of following the crowd, the false hatred instilled by others, the fear of the unknown, and sheer stupidity.

...Alliance Leader, listen and look. I only claim to be the Dharma King of Human Path, yet these people want to kill me. When have they ever seen me do evil? I have clearly harmed no one, yet I am unjustly treated as an enemy, with the desire to kill me at all costs.
Surround the Jinxiang Palace guards! Kill this demoness! The forces of the righteous path stand in opposition to the Demon Sect!

I say a rooster crowing like a hen‑absolutely not something serious! What talk of equality between men and women? Total nonsense! I think it means the country is about to fall, with demons and monsters appearing! In ancient times, there was Daji and Bao Si, and now we have the Demon Sect's witch Su Yingxiang!
Still considering themselves above others, they go around indiscriminately killing loving men full of emotion. Originally, it turns out that they are not good people at all! Pah!

Are all the ladies at Jinxiang Palace human path witches? My dear heavens! I was hoping to marry one and bring her home to honor my ancestors! If I were unaware and had a child with her, wouldn't the next generation all be Demon Sect outcasts?

This time, the Dharma King of the Human Path lived up to his reputation for being upright and virtuous, seeking fame and praise. Whenever people in the Wulin mentioned Jinxiang Palace, they could only marvel and try to establish connections, which were out of reach. They never expected it to be associated with the Demon Sect! If not for Nangong Qian's revelation, the consequences would have been unimaginable.

With her own words confirming the situation, tensions escalated further. All righteous individuals felt a chill down their spines. They all suspected that the Beast Path's Dharma King had infiltrated the Beggar Sect and was gradually eroding the foundations of the righteous path with his insidious schemes. Ultimately, unable to contain his impatience, he revealed himself and suffered defeat, dying in the process‑considered a great stroke of luck amidst unfortunate circumstances.
The Second Young Lord of the Nangong Family spoke truthfully. The Jinxiang Palace is indeed the Human Path, and this Princess is the Mud Cult's Human Path Dharma King.
Are you a member of the Demon Sect or have you been defiled by that Nangong brat? Don't be afraid. If you've suffered an injustice, just say so; we're all not unreasonable people!
Jinxiang Gongzhu Lady Wen, you must have some explanation for this matter!
Since this is the Human Path, we naturally need to use methods from the Human Path. Humans are not beasts; it's because they possess reason. There is still a possibility for coexistence.
Thunder Over Mountain ‑ Regret in Excess, Water Under Thunder ‑ Await, Sky Over Water ‑ Need.
What do we do next? Should we try to deny everything, or break through and escape down the mountain?
Xiang'er.... You said very good words just now. We must know who we are. Don't forget your true self because of the words others impose on you.

...Master, you have kept such a big thing from me and not told me about it. Apprentice will be very hurt. Afterward, apprentice will definitely throw a tantrum for a long, long time, so you should prepare psychologically.
Ohoho, that won't do. How can you be so soft‑hearted? You have to learn from the ways of the Wulin, how to show no mercy when necessary. With your kindness, how will you survive in the Jianghu?
But I... I... can't bear to part with you all.
Are you going to walk carefully on your own, or be stubborn with me at this critical moment, wasting my energy and leaving me unable to protect the Lady later?
I won't do that!

You are not from the Mud Cult, so even if we do not help each other, just standing in formation is a threat. Later, when we unite to resist the enemy, we also need to guard against you suddenly upholding righteousness to eliminate your own kin.
Please come, Heroine Long~
Palace attendant, listen up! Open the living door! Xiannier, escort Long Xiang out of formation!
Then go outside. Don't be in the way here.
Of course not!

Jinxiang Palace has already disbanded. At this moment, only the Mud Cult of the Human Path is here. You are not one of us; what could possibly make you linger? Or do you, as the daughter of the Wulin Alliance Leader, wish to join the Mud Cult?
How could I leave my master and fellow disciples?

Lady Wen spoke while observing the expressions of everyone. Upon hearing the name Long Yuan, none failed to be moved. She remained wary of Jinxiang Palace, but when it came to Long Xiang, her face seemed to carry a touch of regret.

Though you are a disciple of Jinxiang Palace, you are not a follower of the Human Path. You are a descendant of Great Hero Long Yuan. Your father dedicated himself to righteousness and made contributions to the Wulin; everyone remembers him. Moreover, the Alliance Leader is benevolent and righteous, so he surely will not make things difficult for you. Go now.

Lady Wen glanced around and met the gazes of those surrounding her. The respectful and regretful looks she had just received were replaced in an instant with hostile ones. Everyone's faces bore expressions of anger and resentment, waiting to hear her defense.
Why are you not saying anything... Quickly tell everyone that you're a good person!
Master, speak quickly! I will believe you unconditionally if you just say he is a liar!
Master, are you joking with me...? Is this some kind of topic or test? I grew up in Jinxiang Palace since childhood; how could I possibly not know who I am.
What...? What does this mean?
Only you are not among the people of the Jinxiang Palace.
I told you so
You are certainly not from the Mud Cult.
Master, are you saying so?
Nangong Qian, you are speaking nonsense! How can there be such a thing as framing someone for something they didn't do out of thin air! How could I possibly know that I am a part of the Mud Cult!
Ugh...
Oh hehe, it's turned out this way nonetheless.

This formation is derived from the Eight Array Diagram devised by the Three Kingdoms statesman Zhuge Liang. Although the righteous martial practitioners outnumber Jinxiang Palace by more than tenfold, they are nothing but a heap of sand, merely shouting and agitating. How could they break through this array? Thus, they were kept outside the formation, and for a time, neither side made any progress.

Jinxiang, the palace attendant, was well‑trained and immediately set up a wondrous formation. The heavens covered the earth, the wind rose, and the clouds hung low. With the core of the formation firmly established, it flowed endlessly. One person drew their sword, and the attendants from all directions supported each other in turn.
Yes!
Junior Sister Xue'er, let's each step on the Yin and Yang array points!
Yes!
Jinxiang Palace disciples, array in formation around Lei Fenghou to protect the palace mistress!
Don't cause trouble, stay away from Brother Li!

Nangong Qian said this, and everyone dismissed it with a snort. Even with Shi Ming's words, no one could fully believe him. However, when Nangong Yuan read the letter, his face turned a deep shade of blue, which was more convincing than a thousand words. How could anyone still doubt?
Alliance Leader, you are an old acquaintance of Jinxiang Palace Leader. I am certain you recognize her handwriting. You may examine the document for verification.
Evil creature, shut up right now!
Father, don't be misled by that witch's words; I know that's a mind‑possessing technique! Just now when she played the zither, it was to confuse your mind.
Impossible! Absolutely impossible! I, Nangong Yuan, can vouch for Lady Jinxiang's character!

This... this is truly Lady Jinxiang's handwriting, identical to the calligraphy and paintings she has created! I, as a senior monk, hold great respect for Lady Jinxiang's talents and have collected one of her works. I would never mistake it! This letter addresses Dharma King of the Beast Path as brother in every sentence, showing an intimacy that is shameless and unscrupulous! Indeed, this is the style of a demon!
I have private messages from the Dharma King of the Human Path and the Dharma King of the Beast Path as evidence! Master, please take a look!
If not, even as the Second Young Lord of Nangong, the old monk and the heroes of the world would not spare you.

Amituofo, Second Young Lord, Jinxiang Palace maiden Zengfeng Liangjie, even if she disbanded, she could still be remembered with fragrance in later generations. You accused Lady Wen of being the Demon Sect's Dharma King; do you have any real evidence for this?

This sentence had the mountain heroes laughing and crying in disbelief, with many snorting in derision. It was well‑known that the Second Young Lord was an illegitimate son who often performed foolish deeds that brought shame to the family. This time, without knowing where he heard rumors, he was once again seeking attention.
Senior brother, what are you doing? You can't go! Do you want to become public enemy number one!
Zhao Lang, you must not! Once you make a move, it will inevitably implicate the Tang Clan and Kongtong!
Brother, you should stay calm. Why did you stop him?
No way! Even if it's me, I know you going now will cause a big problem!
A'Huo, you fool. If you charge out now and don't let him speak, aren't you clearly showing you're with the Mud Cult!
Oh no... Oh no! Second Young Lord, quickly stop!
Oh no... Oh no! Foolish one, stop at once!
Oh no... Oh no! A'Qian, quickly stop!

A person who is pitiable must have something hateful about them‑this saying is not an empty claim at all! I even felt sympathy for him, but it turns out he's a fool who blurts out false accusations without any evidence!
This boy is talking nonsense! Everyone in Jinxiang Palace is so good!

Heroes present, never allow Lady Jinxiang Palace to descend the mountain! Their lofty image is merely a facade; in reality, they harbor filth and corruption! As for why – because Lady Wen of Jinxiang Palace is none other than the Dharma King of the Human Path of the Demon Sect!
Nangong Qian pressed his palm to his chest and took several deep breaths, mustering up the courage before speaking loudly.
Are you Master Senior Brother Jie Wuchen, the famed Wind God of Central Plain? I am also here to pay respects to the master, but first I must learn from Young Lord Nangong's South Wind Graceful Fan.
Young Hero Yuan, the Emei Sect Leader wishes to see you.
Yes! Thanks, Senior Brother!
I won't take myself as bait; how would you get a chance to speak? What stink haven't you farted yet? Wait until they swarm and both of us end up as meat sauce.
Brother Yuan, isn't it not appropriate to say this?
Okay
Disciple, go invite him over to chat
He is referring to Master Uncle Yuan Chengfeng?

Young Lord, don't be anxious. I know what you want to say: Who are you, esteemed one? Allow me to answer you first: my name is Yuan Wuxian, of the Emei lineage without a character. I am of the same generation as Master Xiang. It's not surprising if you haven't heard of me, but you must have heard of The Strange Ape in the Wind, Yuan Chengfeng.
What did you say!
No! You, you want to take credit for my achievements again. Ever since we were young, everything good has gone to you, and I've had enough of it!
What's going on? You should have told me first.
This concerns the future of the Wulin. Don't stop me, otherwise, even if I'm your senior brother, I won't be polite!
Wow! When did his martial arts become so powerful? Just now, why was he taking hits without retaliating...?
What are you rambling on about? Stop it right now! Grab him.
I, Nangong Qian, wish to boldly accuse one person today in front of all these heroes and heroines! To reveal a huge secret!
Hold on!!
Lady Wen is indeed a clear‑thinking woman
Can we also retire and withdraw from the world?
Is that so... That's good then.
Who says we are not together anymore? We're just not dancing with blades and swords. Friends remain friends, family remains family.
Senior Brother... Will they not be together anymore? I just feel it will be very lonely.
Are you considered a person of the Jianghu?
I also want to retreat from the Jianghu.
No wonder Lady Wen wants to commission a carriage from me.
It's probably too early; it's not yet the right time.
...A'Huo, when are you planning to retire from the Jianghu? I want to take you to a place.
Yes... Senior Brother has always tried to retire from the Jianghu but failed. In the end, he couldn't achieve his wish.

One could retire from the Jianghu and live a peaceful life without any trouble. After all, that wouldn't be such a bad thing. Otherwise, when would it end? How bad can it be to have a stable home and a peaceful life?
Although those from the Jianghu who had a friendly relationship with Jinxiang Palace were unwilling to see her go, they did not try to detain her, instead offering her many blessings.
The attendants in the Jinxiang Palace on that side seemed unsurprised, instead appearing relieved as if a heavy burden had been lifted.
I was thinking that if the Tang Clan couldn't accommodate me, I could still seek refuge at Jinxiang Palace. How... how is it already breaking up?
...Did Jinxiang Palace really disband like this?
Ah... the road ahead is long indeed.
...Nangong Yuan, I hate you. But we both believe you will change this mortal world. Congratulations on your assumption of the Wulin Alliance Leader position.
So you have the duty to remember us, bear the aspirations of everyone on your shoulders, and dedicate your entire life.

These names of people might be forgotten in another decade, but you must not forget them. Everyone yearns for your wild yet beautiful vision, willing to sacrifice their heads and shed blood for it. From today onward, you must fulfill your promise.

......It has been a long time since anyone mentioned them. Most of these friends are no longer among the living. Even if they are still alive, they have gone their separate ways, each pursuing their own path. Whether we will meet again in this life is uncertain.

There are also Master Yixin of Songshan, Master Liaofan, Tang Yi from Shu, Tang Mian, Tang Keran, Youxianzi of Qingcheng, Xu Zilian, Iron Fist Master Yan Shiru from Kongtong, the Quanzhen young Taoist Sima Zhiqi, and the Jiangnan courtesan Su Yingxiang.

Can you remember Shangguan Jun, the Dragon King's Blade, your cousin Nangong Yu, Young Lord Shen of Lin'an singing alone, with lyrics carefully chosen, burying himself on Mount Changbai in memory of the Liao orphan Yelv Jinghong, Xiao Qingshan, and Master Li, the Beggar Sect's Lady?
...it's Senior Brother Wen and Little Sister Wen, your husband and younger aunt.
Do you still remember Wen Wuwei, the Seventh Change Holy Hand of Emei, and his sister Bixiao Immortal Lady Wen Wuxia?
That was my lifelong friend, how could I forget?

You've come this far with so much effort, and you're now saying such lackluster words. Do you think the position of Alliance Leader can be renounced just by your own say‑so? Don't you remember Captain Dinyuan Wang Chunxiao?
Why don't I not be the Alliance Leader then? You don't have to dissolve Jinxiang Palace.
...As the leader of the alliance, they cannot behave in such a manner.
No, no, don't go
I disbanded the Jinxiang Palace and vanished far away. From now on, I will no longer compete with you. You can rest assured without worry; isn't that delightful?

They are all independent individuals, and they don't need me to constantly remind them; they will find their own way. Those who still cling to Jianghu can do as they wish; anyway, I will no longer get involved in this murky water. If the leader is reluctant, how about offering them more support?
Yingxiang, you... are you serious? Jinxiang Palace protects homeless female travelers, a utopia desired by all women under heaven. Now if you dissolve the palace, where will the nuns go?

Jinxiang Palace is the pinnacle of clarity and nobility in the Wulin, standing above the Six Schools, with a group of women who can challenge the Three Great Families on equal terms‑truly beyond reproach. The ladies within are both scholarly and martial, talented and versatile, captivating countless heroes. How could it be said to disband so easily?
These words sparked a commotion among the assembled heroes.
What!
Therefore, I dare to ask the heroes of the land to bear witness. From today onwards, I hereby dissolve Jinxiang Palace, wash my hands in a Golden Basin, and retire from the Jianghu!
You... I thought you would never forgive me.

......But to be fair, when it comes to speaking of today's heroes, who can match Lord Nangong in terms of wide‑ranging social connections and virtuous friends scattered across the Five Lakes and Four Seas, while also being a master in martial arts with a heart full of benevolence? Despite my unresolved hatred towards him, how could I bear to harm such a virtuous person for my own selfish reasons?
Sigh

This palace has longstanding grievances with the head of the Nangong family, and it is well‑known that we cannot live under the same sky as this person. It is understandable that Jinxiang Palace is unwilling to serve them as the leader, let alone obey their commands.
Attendees from all corners of the Jianghu!
Is that so... I see, actually I knew that.
We are drifting further away from our best days, unable to return to what we once had.
Everything comes at a price
Cannot do it anymore
No, it's not like that. I just... sigh. I regret it. For twenty years, I have regretted my words back then. Can we go back and do it all over again?
To you, I am merely an item that can be easily given away.

When Wen Guangren entrusted someone to approach the Nangong Clan for an arranged marriage, I wished you would protect me and become angry on my behalf. But you exerted all your efforts, speaking well of me throughout the night, yet you advised me to marry instead.

You chose brotherhood over me, pretending to be intoxicated by wine and pleasure, trying to make me feel disheartened. I am disheartened, but not because of your poor acting. It is because you, this self‑proclaimed great hero, the chivalrous one, ultimately chose to abandon me.
Times have changed, and I am no longer Su Yingxiang. I will never let you again.

Long, long ago, Su Yingxiang had also asked Nangong Yuan this very question, begging him to guide her in chess. At that time, the young girl's eyes held a deep admiration, and she would often deliberately show weakness and try different tactics just to watch her lover display his prowess with gleaming spirit.
Yingxiang....．

Senior Brother Wen is deeply devoted, but Nangong Qian's biological mother was merely one‑sided? Where's the difference? This is truly confusing. I am rather unintelligent, and cannot figure it out. Young Lord, could you enlighten me?

Although Xiao Zhu acted nonchalant on the surface, she secretly harbored a faint hope for the future sect leader she had never met: hoping that he would be good; hoping that he would value her more than anyone else; hoping that his martial arts would be unparalleled, making her seem pitiful by comparison. With unrealistic fantasies in mind, this pining maiden continued to hone her skills day after day, preparing to contribute to her future husband's endeavors. Beneath the wardrobe, she cherished and carefully stored a vividly colored garment, one she hardly ever wore even during festivals, due to the old calluses and scars on both hands that she did not wish others to see.

Because she was sold to Kongtong at a price of five thousand guan due to her father's gambling addiction, they valued her for her natural beauty and purity. They expected great things from her future. However, unbeknownst to them, this girl stopped growing taller unexpectedly, greatly disappointing the Iron Fist Sect elders. Xiao Zhu herself did not harbor any expectations of becoming the sect leader's wife. Yet, she could never get used to the contemptuous glances others cast at her. The more she felt inferior, the stronger she became.  In her heart, she envied the common folk's young misses for their slender and delicate beauty that won people's pity. Unfortunately, fate was not kind; this girl possessed boundless strange strength despite her seemingly frail frame, lacking any good fortune but with a body weight far from ordinary. The only thing to be grateful for was that the old sect leader, who had purchased her as an apprentice, left her his large iron forge before passing away. From then on, Xiao Zhu handled all aspects of woodworking and ironwork in the mountain, sometimes casting farming tools, sometimes forging weapons. In idle moments, she would tinker with mechanical tricks, immersing herself fully whenever inspiration struck, finding contentment even if she could not become the sect leader's wife.  Her dream was to be like Lu Ban or Ou Yezi, a peerless master craftsman of the world.

Due to poor eyesight, she frequently squints when looking at people, giving off a menacing glare that left a bad impression on everyone. In reality, she is a pure and kind‑hearted girl. As the contemporary direct female disciple of Iron Fist Sect, she has the right to compete for the position of future sect leader's wife, and should be highly respected. However, in reality, no one takes this scowling short‑statured person seriously. The Iron Fist Sect seems to have given up on her struggles, allowing her to stay in the large iron forge, hammering away without resembling a refined lady. Although the iron mallet she often uses is just a common tool, a pair of unremarkable‑looking gloves are worth their weight in treasure‑crafted from the legendary Ulan Silk of Tianshan, resistant to water and fire, and impervious to blades and spears.

The contemporary direct disciple of the Iron Fist Sect of the Kongtong School is a petite girl in green with a fierce gaze. Renowned for her exceptional blacksmithing skills, it is said that she possesses immense strength, capable of crushing the bones of others with her bare hands. Thus, she is known in the Jianghu as the Bone‑Crushing Demon.

By now, she could no longer take her eyes off you. Witnessing your growth and strength, seeing you become more resilient, filled her with greater pride than any personal achievements of hers. She wished to see you achieve even more and watch from the sidelines as you reached new heights. Even without the master‑disciple relationship, she could consider herself your friend or, if that suited you, offer herself as a reward for becoming your wife. You surpassing her like indigo outshining blue ‑ Xiahou Lan would boast about being your master and the one you hold dear to your heart. You are the reason she yearns to be human.

You are the only person in this world who knows her original name‑Xiahou Mei. After being brought to Kongtong Sect, she had her parents' given name altered by fate and was ordered to take the name Xiahou Lan as a disciple. Later, through direct transmission from the Xianzhangren faction, she mastered both Soul Stealer Neigong and Snow Mountain Yin‑Yang Neigong techniques, truly making her the foremost expert of Kongtong Sect in this era, just one step away from reaching unparalleled realms. Your presence fills the last empty space in her heart; after all, she has never taken a disciple.  Initially, it was merely a jest, but as she taught you more seriously, even she found herself astonished. With others, she shows no patience, yet your dullness and stupidity can make her smile. Even your appearance evokes pity, fearing that if you were to survive alone in the world, you would suffer countless hardships.  Should I treasure our time together and impart all my knowledge to ensure you are not bullied? Or should I take you with me when I depart this world...?

Xiahou Lan is a survivor of the Snow Mountain Sect, whose family was annihilated. Even before her birth, she had an engagement to marry from the Shangguan Family. Her parents wanted their child to be born in a warm place, far from this harsh land, to grow up without worry. Now, all that has become nothing but a dream. She has walked through rain and frost, seen the warmth and cold of human nature, bravely stood against powerful authorities she could not fight, and battled enemies she could not overcome. She deeply loved someone, only to have her heart scarred. Desires unfulfilled, what little she had clung to slipping away. Xiahou Lan's story has come to an end. Whatever happens in the future, meeting you will be nothing more than a tasteless afterthought.

With a stunning appearance and exceptional martial skills, they captivated many young heroes and were once the most promising candidate to become the first Lady of the Kongtong sect. Unfortunately, a tragic event from years past rewrote this young woman's life. Since that day, she has seemed like a lost soul, never smiling again, her gaze wandering aimlessly. Even on sunny days, she carries an umbrella, as if in her eyes, the world is perpetually drenched in rain.

Kongtong Sect·Soul Stealer Gate's contemporary direct female disciple is known in the Jianghu as Soul Stealer Yu Lan. She is notorious for her vicious and perverse ways, residing in the Soul Stealer Forest, where none should enter.

Whenever you appear nearby, Xiao Mei experiences a contradictory flutter of love and hate in her heart. She wishes to stab you several times but ultimately cannot bear to do so; she complains about how ugly you are but still can't put you down. After all, at least you have an unsightly appearance; unlike others who all look the same, dull and uninteresting, making it hard to tell one from another. Although she hides her attachment well, Xiao Mei's obsession with you has almost become a pathological fixation. If you were to be disloyal and take multiple wives or concubines, she would smile and agree, then find an opportunity to push you down the stairs, leaving you half‑dead and half‑alive, subjecting you to a mind‑entrancing confinement that would leave you unable to go anywhere, relying solely on her for the rest of your life. But if you were faithful and innocent, she would gladly sacrifice her life for you. Your distant gaze is her future, no matter how far away it may be; she will see it through with you, being both a lifelong friend and a companion.

Even her pitiful background was a fabrication, merely a deliberate creation to win the trust of the Kongtong Sect. Her true identity was that of a cold‑blooded assassin carefully cultivated by the mysterious organization 'Thousand Lantern Tower,' a candidate for the new Thousand Faced Demon, skilled in disguise, poison techniques, cunning schemes, and rhetoric. She secretly sowed discord among the Four Gates of Kongtong, luring countless talented men from Kongtong with her beauty to kill them, waiting only for the right moment to destroy the vast Kongtong under her own hand, thereby claiming merit and inheriting the name of Thousand Faced Demon. All these were also mere pretenses, designed to deceive Old Soul Reaper, winning his trust while breaking through the illusions laid by thecorpseheart worm poison. Deep within Little Mei's heart, hatred was directed solely at the master of Thousand Lantern Tower; her heart held no love, and she merely lingered on life to kill one person.

It is said that Xiao Mei's biological mother was a demoness from the Supreme Bliss Sect. After escaping from the clutches of evil, her mother married and gave birth to a daughter, living a life of simplicity and contentment. Unfortunately, good times did not last long. The Fire Dragon Immortal Monarch, under the guise of ridding the world of evil, ruthlessly tore apart familial bonds and forcibly took the orphaned girl from the Yu family as a disciple, renaming her Xiao Mei. He intended to cultivate her to secure the position of the first lady of the sect, thereby solidifying his power.   Thus, while Xiao Mei appeared innocent and carefree, she actually harbored deep‑seated hatred towards the Kongtong Sect. Always smiling, she subtly manipulated events to steer them towards a negative outcome as a form of revenge. She even secretly taught the sect's secret technique, the Crane's Elusive Fist, to Fire Lightning, forcing them to learn martial arts without regard for their feelings, which was utterly unreasonable.

Dressed in a red robe and white dress, she resembled a plum blossom in the snow, exuding an elegant and transcendent beauty. Despite her youth, her position was high; she was more precious than even the major disciple of Flying Heaven Sect, ranking only behind the four Palm Masters. Even so, she showed no hint of arrogance. She frequently roamed around Mount Kongtong every day, enthusiastically helping others, lively and cheerful, loving to joke and make friends. She kept a tame crane named Fire Lightning. Among the Four Beauties of contemporary Kongtong, she had the highest reputation; it seemed inevitable that she would marry into the Kongtong Palm Master family as their Lady in due time.

Kongtong School · Flying Heaven Gate's contemporary direct female disciple was a lively and cheerful young girl, innocent and carefree. Though she had an unremarkable reputation in the Jianghu, among Kongtong School's four main gates' direct female disciples, she received the highest support for the position of First Palm Chief Lady, with her succession as such a certainty.

Throughout the Jianghu, the person who endured her poison beats the most is you. No matter how she beats you, she can't give up. The more she beats you, the more she finds it hard to let go. She grew tired of men in fancy clothes, showing off their dashing and flamboyant manners. Instead, she favored your integrity. My dearest, you are the greatest hero and hero among all heroes, with a strong backbone and standing tall. Just like a father would say, she said this. Long Xiang blushed for three days after that, and as soon as she saw you, she would immediately draw her sword to confront you. But because she couldn't do without your care, in the end, all she could do was suppress her shame and return to your side. Occasionally, she tried to pick herself up and live up to her role as a wife‑during mending clothes, she tore your garment; during cooking, she burned down the house. You'd be best not to hold high hopes for this woman.

In practical combat, they gradually became skilled, able to wield their swordsmanship with composure and at will, becoming a renowned female hero, beautiful as a flower, attracting a steady stream of suitors. Long Xiang, experiencing the stirrings of love for the first time, couldn't help but feel secretly delighted. However, being inexperienced in matters of the heart, they sought to hide their embarrassment by making friends through martial arts and connecting with others through their sword. As a result, many suitors fell beneath their blade, leaving in disarray. Even their kind words of consolation couldn't prevent the setbacks, and it was not surprising that many proud individuals chose to sheathe their swords and retreat. Over time, they became indifferent, treating anyone who approached with heavy hands, inflicting greater defeats to reveal the true nature of their opponents. After all, Jianghu men valued their pride; who could tolerate such a fierce demeanor? Although their martial skills were high, their life was a mess, lacking self‑sufficiency, and if no one intervened, they could very well bring ruin upon themselves.

Memories of their father have become quite faint now. In the distant recollection of that day, he patted their small head, smiled, and left, never to return. Later, Lady Wen of Jinxiang Palace took them in, bringing them into her household. Through various hearsay, they learned that their father was a legend in the Wulin, feeling both sorrow and pride. Following in their father's footsteps, they visited old acquaintances, hoping to gather more stories about their deceased father to cherish those memories. All their swordsmanship came from a family secret manual, and among the Seven Absolutes of Long Yuan, they excelled particularly in sword techniques. From a young age, they practiced with a chicken leg as a sword, unconsciously grasping the essence of the unity of person and sword, and even now, they are not quite sure if they can be considered a master. However, no matter how high their martial skills, they still get lost, fall for scams, and faint from hunger by the roadside. Surviving through all this truly shows remarkable luck.

Mastered under Jinxiang Palace, the ingenious and exquisite swordswoman. Walking in her father's footsteps with a solemn step, she yearns to fulfill her father's aspirations by roaming the four quarters as a wanderer of justice. Despite this, due to her naivety regarding worldly affairs, she is surprisingly prone to falling victim to deceit.
