Combining the Snow Mountain Sect's neigong with the stealth tactics of the Soul Stealer School, her agility is like that of a ghost and can entice one's soul. The Four Styles‑Heartbreak, Bone‑Eating, Soul‑Slashing, and Soul Stealer‑are each more ruthless than the last, extremely poisonous. Learning them might even go against heaven's will.
Soul‑Stealer Phantom Claw

The signature skill of the White Ape Patriarch of the Emei School is strictly speaking a form of monkey fist, yet it diverges significantly from the folk versions of monkey fist. The power emanates from the back and travels through the shoulder to reach the elbow and fingers, which is known as reach arm.
White Ape Connecting Arms Fist

It is said that this is the martial art practiced by Xu Qing, the third of the Five Heroes of the Floating Island. Xu Qing, born to a blacksmith, possessed immense strength and had the unique ability to burrow underground, earning him the nickname Mountain‑Burrowing Mouse. The Five Mice pledged their loyalty to the Kaifeng Prefecture and assisted Bao Zheng. In the seventh year of the Jiayou era, Lord Bao passed away, and the following year he was buried in Hefei. The Five Mice accompanied him on his journey, bowing in farewell before parting ways. Later, Xu Qing retreated to Kongtong, passing down the Iron Arm Divine Fist and blacksmithing techniques, and he passed away at the Great Iron Forge in Iron Fist Alley.   Practitioners must apply oil to both arms, pass them through iron rings, and circulate their energy to make their arms engorge and harden. They then strike wooden stakes; after breaking the wooden stake, they move on to stone stakes; after breaking the stone stake, they strike iron stakes. If an arm breaks, they apply ointment and continue training until healed. Over time, their hands will become as strong as iron.
Iron Arm Divine Fist

This was the claw technique created by Zeng Mingdong's famous thief, Iron Mask Bandit. Unlike conventional methods, his swordsmanship took an unconventional path, hiding in darkness and transforming into shadows to strike from the night, delivering a fatal blow. The Iron Mask Bandit was commanded by Pang Taishi to assassinate Bao Zheng, but he was moved by Bao's unwavering integrity and refused to harm the clear sky with his personal desires. Fearing breach of trust, he abandoned his superior position and secretly challenged Nanxia Xia Zhang openly. In a fair fight, Iron Mask Bandit lost and chopped off his ten fingers as a sign of defeat. As a result, Bao Zheng spared his life. The Iron Mask Bandit retired to Kongtong Mountain and had someone forge iron claws for him, writing this book.
Shadowless Claw

Kongtong Sect. The flying heaven school of martial arts passed down through the sect. Their agility is light and graceful, with quick punches and loose steps, making them most nimble and versatile. At times they move like a leisurely wanderer, at others like a bird suddenly diving into attack, leaving one unsure and constantly on guard. However, this style of fist technique is overly complex, consisting of thirty‑six paths, seventy‑two transformations, and one hundred and eight subsequent moves, making it very difficult to master. Therefore, the flying heaven school within the sect rarely sees in‑depth research by many practitioners.
Immortal Crane Lost Trace Fist

Kongtong Sect • Heavenly Flight Gate's secret techniques. These are simplified versions of the Immortal Crane Mystical Trace Fist that the transmission masters use to teach new disciples. They omit the mystic traces and fist movements, focusing solely on lower‑body qinggong training, making it simple and easy to understand.
Flying Heaven Kick

The martial arts manual stolen from Songshan Temple is the foundation of Songshan's martial arts, easy to learn but difficult to master. The Luohan Fist manual that has circulated among the people has given rise to many different forms over the centuries, each with its own unique flair, and each version is somewhat different. You cannot be sure if the manual in your hands is the original. Since you have come across this manual, you have a connection to the Buddha; practice it.
Luohan Fist Manual

The meaning of the two characters Amo is ultimately unknown; not even the elders of the Beggar Sect, such as Geng Yang from the Reading Studio, know. However, the term tangqiang has been interpreted as to smear, meaning that this set of martial arts can only exert its maximum effect in extremely confined spaces: pushing the enemy against the wall and beating them mercilessly until they are reduced to a pulp smeared on the wall. Although the concept is simple, this martial art cannot be established without a foundation in External Skill; techniques like inch power, sudden elbow strikes, and Iron Mountain Lean are all practical combat skills.
Amotang Wall Fist

The Beggar Sect has established customary escape techniques that are particularly impressive when employed by a large group. In such situations, they scatter like a crowd, rushing in all directions, as if their movements were choreographed with perfect timing. This makes it difficult for enemies to capture everyone at once; eventually, some will inevitably be caught and can then report back home. These escape methods are passed down through song, with the verse going: Look to the east while running west, nowhere to hide up in a tree's height, three or five together defy ironclad fate, life and death preordained no need to hesitate. Though the words may be simple and straightforward, they contain cunning strategies and also provide psychological preparation for the possibility of being caught.
Eight Desolations and the Road to Escape

The Quanzhen school's Qinggong and leg techniques are derived from the Free and Untrammeled Excursion chapter in Zhuangzi. This technique is also an ancient qin music piece. Every day when Quanzhen disciples practice their skills, they listen to the tune played by their transmission master. They visualize themselves transforming from a giant swallow into a great bird, with wings as vast as hanging clouds, preparing to migrate across the heavens, reaching the blue sky, soaring for ten thousand miles while riding the wind, feeling cool and refreshing, breathing the air of the Northern Sea, overwhelming all things, and circling widely in the broad and harmonious space. Only after completing the nine sections of this melody do they cease their practice.
Carefree Journey Leg Techniques
Dharma King's Asura Path: Casual Notes from His Military Career, the content herein is more about battlefield experiences than martial arts.
Blood Letters of Battle

Qingcheng is renowned for its seclusion. It boasts thirty‑six yin‑yang peaks, backed by the snow‑capped mountains. The forests are dense and verdant, with greenery persisting through all four seasons. Legend has it that in the Tang Dynasty, a wealthy merchant feared death and sought immortality. At the foot of the mountain, he asked a boy. The boy replied: It is among the trees. In the forest, he asked another boy: It's by the stream. By the stream, yet another boy said: It's on the pinnacle. After asking thirty‑six peaks in succession, he once again saw a boy. Realizing the extraordinary nature of this place, the merchant prostrated himself and said: You may instruct me. The boy smiled and said: A child can be taught. Pure cultivation need not involve hardships; humility can lead to enlightenment. After many years of solitary practice, the wealthy merchant took over as the headmaster and wrote this book. Its every word reflects his joyful spirit from leisurely strolls among the thirty‑six peaks, long forgotten now since he first entered the mountain.
Qingfeng Thirty Six Techniques

The Beggar Sect is skilled in handling snakes. The snake‑shaped fist technique of the Beggar Sect not only mimics the movements of a snake but also genuinely fights with live snakes. When executing punches and kicks, it must coordinate with the snakes. Besides striking with beaks, wrapping, and seizing, there is a hidden lethal move. When this technique is perfected, the snakes will suddenly burst from the sleeves to bite their targets unawares!
Snake Style Fist

The Emei Sect's leg technique is the finest, leaping into the sky, lurking amidst the shifting clouds and waves, unpredictable in its movements. When it strikes, it is astonishing; its motion is like the thunder of the heavens, breaking through the clouds, akin to the wrath of the Thunder God, with immense power. This leg technique has no fixed forms or patterns; it is formless yet effective, representing the ultimate manifestation of Xingyi Quan. Its embodiment is the shape of heavenly thunder, known as the Thunder God's Foot.
Thunder God Foot

An ancient manual, written in Sanskrit, lies hidden beneath the Sutra Repository; had it not been for the earthquake, it might have remained unseen forever. This manual pertains to the Buddhist concept of numbers, meaning countless. Kalpa is a general term for time in India, and after the phases of formation, existence, destruction, and emptiness, it constitutes a great kalpa. Therefore, to practice this skill, one must comprehend the essence of Zen, realizing the state of neither birth nor extinction, and enduring countless kalpas with the physical body, before one can attain enlightenment on the Great Way.
Nayuta Calamity Finger

The Wulin Alliance Leader Great Hero Long Yuan is known for one of his seven world‑renowned techniques: Xuan Xuan Ruyi and Miao Shou Kongkong. With bare hands, he can intercept an opponent's weapon, probe a person's pocket, and succeed wherever he goes. Young Long Yuan often used this technique to pilfer others' money during his youth. It was only when he came to realize and mature that he removed the method of stealing from the secret scroll, shouldering the fate of the Wulin on his own.
Xuanxuan Wish Fulfilling Finger

It is said that on a day of leisure, White Monkey Patriarch of Emei Sect went to seek amusement with his mountain friends. Unintentionally, he stumbled upon a scene so shocking and unforgettable that it left an indelible impression. A monkey was holding onto a white rabbit, while a snake encircled the body of the monkey. An eagle descended from the sky to attack the snake. The white rabbit managed to escape and stepped on the eagle's eye. This scene flashed before their eyes in an instant; all four creatures were greatly startled and scattered in panic. Only the White Monkey Patriarch stood there stunned for a moment before returning to his quarters. For three days, he could not eat or drink, lost in thought. Finally, on the third day during breakfast time, he suddenly understood the sequence of events and stood up, demonstrating the Snake Rabbit Eagle Monkey Combat in front of all the disciples. Each disciple tried to understand it based on their capabilities; some grasped more than others. However, only one person mastered the Rabbit Shape Fist.
Snake, Rabbit, Eagle, Ape Combat

Originally named Wind Thunder Divine Foot, it is the famous leg technique of the handsome wanderer Feng Shen, Jie Wuchen. Unfortunately, when he challenged the Dharma King Liu E from the Hungry Ghost Path, he was publicly humiliated by being offended by the sword. Enraged and distraught, Jie Wuchen vomited blood and suffered a defeat, forcing him to rename his Wind Thunder Divine Leg technique to Really Forceful Kick.   Really Forceful Kick is extremely sharp and swift when used. It strikes with such power that it can crack mountains and rocks, sweeping all before it like the wind and thunder. Truly, it is beyond formidable.
Great Forceful Kick

One of the renowned hard techniques of the Songshan Sect, based on the kicking post technique, involves practitioners tying sandbags to their legs and alternating kicks against wooden posts for a hundred times per session. Beginners practice three sessions a day‑morning, noon, and evening. As their skills deepen, it becomes routine to kick ten or even twenty sessions in a single day. After a hundred days, once the sandbags are removed, their legs become light and agile, with power as fierce as before. The foundation is established, and they can then practice techniques such as flicking, stepping, kicking, smashing, swinging, thrusting, lifting, and sweeping, all of which can be executed effortlessly with their feet.
Diamond Leg
Four Directions Spear Manual
Four Directions Spear Manual

The venom techniques of the Five Poisons Sect in Miaojiang are said to be on par with those of the Tang Clan's Venom Classics, each excelling in its own right and employing different pharmacological principles. Borrowing from other disciplines can provide new insights.
Secret Record of Five Poisons

A mysterious martial art technique whose author and name have been lost over time. It is both a palm strike method and a sword technique; one can wield it with or without a sword, as long as the spirit of the sword is within their heart. The moves are exquisite but devoid of any lethal intent, seemingly intended only for personal amusement. Executed, it flows like the bright moonlight, freely and exhilaratingly.
Drunken Profound Sword Palm

The Dao De Jing says: Heaven and earth are not benevolent; they treat all creatures as straw dogs. Bruised Dog Fist refers to the dog not as a real dog, but rather as any enemy in this world. Whoever it is, they are treated equally, beaten like a dog. A mere pup, what should one fear? As long as one believes they will win and their momentum surpasses the other, even wolves or tigers would have to cower and run away from them.
Dog Punch

Named after Emperor Taizu Zhao Guangyin, this martial art emphasizes practical combat techniques with strict routines and agile footwork. Movements are like a cat crouching, shaking the body like a tiger, flowing like a dragon, and swift as lightning. Although it bears the name of the founding emperor, it is actually Songshanquan.
Taizu Long Fist

In the Songshan Temple, the monks engage in meditation and ascetic practices, needing to sever the three unwholesome roots: greed, anger, and ignorance, which are the fundamental causes of all worldly afflictions. These afflictions drive people to commit various evil deeds. To attain liberation, one must understand the five aggregates and distance themselves from inverted dreams, thus achieving ultimate nirvana. However, how many in this world can truly accomplish this? At this moment, the practice of suffering fist serves as a good temporary solution; through practicing martial arts and sweating it out, one becomes so exhausted that there is no energy left for wild thoughts.
Sorrowful Fist

The original Quanzhen sword technique brought by Hao Datong of Tai‑Gu Dao Ren when he established the Quanzhen School on Huashan Mountain is recorded in this book. Written by Wang Zhe himself and transcribed into seven volumes by Ma Yu, Dan Yang Zi, these volumes were distributed to his disciples as a memorial to their revered master. Training in both qi cultivation and swordsmanship is difficult and intricate, profoundly deep and complex.
Quanzhen Heavenly Escape Sword Technique

In his middle years, Li Bai was to serve in the Hanlin Academy, leaving behind a sword technique consisting of thirty‑six forms before retreating from the world. This set of swordsmanship was demonstrated only once in front of his disciple Wu E, and at that time, Li Bai was quite drunk. It appeared to be a casual display, yet every movement was imbued with divine inspiration, exquisite to the point of perfection, resembling a sword yet not quite a sword, breaking ancient conventions and creating something unprecedented. After completing the set, he stood alone atop a tree, his garments fluttering like a celestial being. However, Wu E, who was watching, was drenched in sweat.   It is said that Wu E found certain aspects difficult to understand and wished to ask his master for guidance, but Li Bai replied, Don't ask me; if you do, you won't be able to learn. Wu E suddenly had an epiphany and left in great joy, unaware that Li Bai was merely brushing him off due to his hangover.
Taibai Immortal Footprints

Ye Yunshang took the liberty to alter the stick techniques created in the Diancang Sword Manual. While lacking lethality, it filled in the unsatisfactory gaps of the Diancang Sword Technique. In terms of unexpected tactics and variations, it could be considered a clever move, though it was somewhat underhanded; a normal person would not act this way.
Diancang Staff Technique

The disciple of Diancang Sect, who is one in ten thousand, can enter the Sword Lodge for three days to comprehend the three sword intents left by the Sword Saint of Diancang. Each of the three sword intents has its own profound meaning, with no distinction of superiority or inferiority; mastering even one is enough to stand out in the Jianghu. However, nine out of ten people may spend ten days or half a month without any gain. Driven by curiosity, Ye Yunshang sneaked in to play and was quickly brought out. Although she did not possess martial skills, she was exceptionally intelligent and unconventional. In that brief moment, she seemed to have an epiphany, but her young age left her somewhat confused. Today, as she bids farewell, she finally understands the taste of parting sorrow, and memories surge in her heart, leading to a sudden realization, and she writes down this move. Though it is just one stance, it carries endless lingering thoughts. This sword is the fourth ultimate move of the Sword Saint‑The soul wanders back home, fragrant sleeves full, spring cries at dawn, do not hold back.
Yunshang Sword Technique

After a lifetime of practicing swordsmanship, Ye Yunzhao finally gained enlightenment as he bid farewell to his beneficent master on Fengyu Mountain. His sword moved like a rushing thunderbolt, surpassing all the swift swords of the Diancang clan, revealing the techniques of the Tang Clan.
Sword Manual of the Same Boat

The Diancang Sect's sword techniques focus on lightness, softness, speed, and adaptability. Once unleashed, the sword intent flows endlessly, moving with the grace and fluidity of clouds and flowing water.
Diancang Sword Manual

The Mud Cult's Six Paths Dharma King, 'Judge' Zhao Kui's renowned ultimate technique. Its movements resemble those of spirit summoning, astonishing and unfathomable, unleashing chilling winds and a ghostly aura. Although it is a sword manual, it also contains records of talismans and other strange arts, making it quite eerie. In truth, how can righteousness and evil be judged by appearances? It all resides in one's heart! With my righteous spirit strong, why should I worry about the idle gossip of the world? Unfazed, I exude an aura of authority, like Zhong Kui reborn, wielding a three‑foot Heavenly Master sword, vowing not to rest until I vanquish all demons and evils.
Celestial Master Sword Technique

Fang Zhen Tian, the junior alliance leader of Jining Nine Counties, became famous for a unique skill in blade art. Originally, it was a mysterious martial technique that required the use of an iron hammer and nails together. By chance, Fang Zhen Tian obtained this technique, claiming it was his painstakingly created exclusive martial art. To avoid giving away its secrets, he changed the original mallet techniques into knife techniques, omitting the nail methods altogether. As a result, many of the moves became confusing and had significant flaws.
Pangu Opens Heaven and Breaks the Earth
Pine Wind Sword Technique
Pine Wind Sword Technique

Taiping Dao teachings transmitted by Zhang Ling during the Eastern Han dynasty, Qingcheng School's unique sword technique that combines these philosophical studies. It emphasizes controlling the sword with one's qi and seeking the Way within the sword, following a clear and righteous path to slay demons and suppress evil.
Three Five Demon Slaying Sword

The Qingcheng Secret Manual outlines a solo formation based on the eight gates' directions, celestial phenomena, and terrain as described in Qimen Dunjia. By deconstructing and simplifying this formation and integrating it into blade techniques, it transforms into the Eight Gates Locking Gold Blade, full of exquisite intricacies.
Eight Gates Locking Gold Blade

When Emei was still a sword school, the ancient body cultivation techniques passed down had simplified complex methods into broad and open practices. Though they were straightforward in appearance, their effectiveness lay in the subtle turns and reserved spaces that allowed for flexibility and resilience. The Eight Slash Method might seem ordinary, but it significantly strengthens one's physical constitution and helps to stretch and fortify the muscles and bones.
Chai Dao Eight Slashing Techniques

This set of swordsmanship was drafted by Teacher Kong, incorporating the techniques of mounted archery to be taught to disciples. Later, as Teacher Kong traveled through various states, he gathered sword techniques from the Seven States, continuously refining and improving them. Over the course of several dynasties, he pursued excellence, embodying the hexagram's meaning of As heaven maintains vigor through movement, a gentleman should constantly strive for self‑improvement. With resolute strength and unwavering determination, he never ceased in his efforts. Acting with humility, without contention, without preference, and remaining unyielding in the face of great principles, this is known as the sword of modesty, harmony, and the gentleman's sword.
Sword of Teacher Kong

It requires the simultaneous use of both blades and swords to perform. The name is boastful, but the techniques themselves seem more flashy than practical. Relying on momentum to slash wildly, it surprisingly works for many people.
Heaven Slaying Black Wing Twin Dragon Sword

Emei's joint assault technique developed by practitioners of the Tang Clan through closed‑door research. One uses a fist while the other uses a sword, complementing each other harmoniously like a lute and zither in perfect tune; the more their minds align, the greater the power. You have the secret manual, but you lack a partner.
Mandarin Duck Fist and Sword Manual

Written by the scholar‑heroesman Cheng Wen, this work summarizes the Four Books and Five Classics, discussing how a gentleman should be cautious even when alone, expressing his heart through behavior, manifesting knowledge through rituals, not being arrogant or humble, and having one's words match their actions. The months change as they may, and the rulers of the land can shift to suit you, but I will remain true to my own heart and cultivate myself. No matter how good this world is, I am still just me; no matter how bad it gets, I am still just me. Even if I abandon this physical body, it remains the same.  All those who practice swordsmanship or martial arts should adhere to their true hearts. Use the two‑edged sword blade as a mirror, not being ashamed to ask but seeking improvement within oneself, maintaining humility and self‑improvement without rest, remaining unperturbed in times of hardship, and being cautious during festivities. Face powerful and wealthy individuals with no fear‑this is what constitutes a gentleman's sword.
Gentleman Discusses Swordsmanship

The martial arts practiced by the Cang Gang disciples active in Fujian. The Cang Gang has the Shangguan clan backing them, a secret that everyone tacitly understands. Even their Flap Wave Blade Technique evolved from techniques passed down by the Shangguan family and adapted for use with ship oars and paddles, making it even more obvious where it originated. When this Blade Art is wielded, it resembles the surging waves on the river, continuous and relentless. It presses weak opponents in a series of waves but conserves strength against strong ones, ready to strike when the enemy makes an effort to counter. The technique combines hardness with softness, offense with defense, and vice versa, making it one of the finest Blade Arts. However, if you practice with oars and paddles, you are destined to learn incorrectly.
Surging Wave Blade Technique

The profound sword techniques of the Diancang Sect shine like shooting stars, rushing forth with unstoppable momentum. They do not seek elegance, only instant release. Delving into the essence of the swift sword, body and sword unite, intention and action advance together, so fast that even shadows cannot keep up with their agility. Step, bend the bow to gather strength, release. Regardless of their form, one cannot stray from these three key principles. Their speed is like an arrow leaving the bowstring, arriving in an instant, capable of deceiving the enemy in a heartbeat; if they do not succeed, they will sacrifice themselves for the cause.
Meteor Sword Manual

Created by the great hero Lei Zhan of the previous dynasty, it is named with great power. The techniques are also straightforward and unambiguous, each move wide and expansive, as if truly embodying the momentum of thunder striking from the heavens. At the moment of drawing the blade, it is accompanied by a roar that pierces the air, shattering the enemy's protective energy.
Cloud Sky Thunderbolt Blade

The classic hard qigong of the Songshan School is the specialty of the Eighteen Bronze Men of Songshan Temple. The Golden Bell Shield cultivates both internal and external strength, fortifying the muscles and bones externally while solidifying the organs internally. Those who achieve mastery have bodies akin to bronze and iron; even when struck by fists and kicks, they feel neither pain nor discomfort.
Golden Bell Shield

Renowned across the land, the Songshan finger technique draws from the anecdote of Sakyamuni Holding a Flower and Kasyapa Smiling. Nirvanic wondrous heart, ineffable and difficult to describe in words, formless and shapeless, beyond comprehension. The profundity and subtlety of this martial art can only be grasped by those with wisdom.
Flower Picking Finger Technique

The secret manual of the Flying Stone Gang is a unique hidden weapon technique taught to the gang leader by a master during their youth. It is said that when practiced to perfection, one can strike the surface of calm water with a flying stone, bouncing it eighty‑eight times.
Throwing Stones to Ask Heaven

The Tang Clan disciples each possess a martial arts manual that ranks alongside the 'Poison Classic' as one of the two treasures. Without guidance from mentors to teach the heart techniques and force application, self‑study would be immensely challenging, making progress virtually impossible. You have already memorized the opening section, 'On Forgetting Form.'
Tang Clan Hidden Weapon General Principles

Do your part and leave the rest to Heaven. Didn't the Sect Leader always say that? A xia doesn't let fame or profit sway them; they only seek to hold their head high with a clear conscience. Even if we can already see the end, we must still stand tall and see this journey through.
That was in the past. Who allowed you to treat disciples from other surnames as less than human, ordering me about all the time? Third Senior Brother, why don't you leave?
The person you admired is no longer here. Didn't you always say that if the Tang Clan didn't have the Little Junior Sister, you wouldn't want to stay even for a moment?
......Don't try to talk me into coming down the mountain, hiding my identity, and merely surviving, okay?
I have something to say to you ‑ not as the acting sect leader, but as Third Senior Brother.
What's going on?
‑Junior Brother
Sigh, I'm just deceiving myself, otherwise, what else can I do?
It's great that you can think this way.
Fortunately, the Little Junior Sister has married off, ensuring her safety and that her life is not wasted here.

Indeed, even though this conflict initially arose from a misunderstanding, our sect missed the opportunity to clarify things. In the process, countless good people have been harmed, and we have forged deep enmities with various factions. We are no longer unjust in this matter.

After the Great Assembly of the Wulin, we were completely labeled as a branch of the Demon Sect. No matter how much we jumped into the Yellow River, it wouldn't wash us clean; it was entirely out of our hands.
Exactly
They are gathering strength, preparing to annihilate the Tang Clan in one swift move.

Wulin Alliance...... hmm, I remember, they are the alliance of the Wulin's five sects, three palaces, and two major guilds. Once established, they acted swiftly and resolutely, sweeping through various branches of the Demon Sect across different regions. Last year, they eradicated the Yin Di branch of the Demon Sect; now.......
Disciple, do you still remember the Wulin Alliance? Do you recall what kind of threat our sect is currently facing?

It sounds like a joke; this is clearly the scenario I used to fantasize about every day. When I was still an outer disciple, I often imagined that one day I would stand out and possess great martial skills. But in the blink of an eye, here I am today, and I am not happy at all.

Don't say such discouraging words in front of the junior disciples. You are no longer the outsider you once were; although the Tang Clan didn't teach you martial arts, you have had your own extraordinary experiences. Now, you are already a pillar of this sect.
Jinwu Shangren? Which one from the Kongtong Sect? I actually managed to defeat them; it's simply unbelievable.
One day, not long after you finished your meal, you fell asleep. I thought you were just tired, but unexpectedly, you slept for three days and three nights.

...You recently represented our sect in a battle against Jinwu Shangren from Kongtong Sect. You narrowly won, but he severely injured your head with his unique weapon, the Liyang Hammer. At first glance, you seemed fine, but his True Qi had entered your body, leaving you drowsy and disoriented day after day, as if in a dream or under the influence of intoxicating alcohol.

I remember everything, but it feels hazy, almost like a dream that isn't quite real, as if I am reading someone else's story. It seems that from today onward, I am beginning to take over the life that someone else has lived.
The Little Junior Sister married a rising young hero. On her joyous day, I hid under the quilt and cried like a woman.
The sect leader is paralyzed and bedridden, and Third Senior Brother has been appointed as the acting sect leader in this critical moment.
Eldest Senior Brother and Second Senior Brother are both no longer here.
Yeah, I remember now
After some activity, I feel my blood circulation has improved, and my mind feels much clearer.
Haha, I didn't give in to you
Third Senior Brother, even if you were feeding the move, you went a bit easy on me, didn't you?
It seems you haven't fully recovered yet, Disciple. We'll have to proceed gradually with your rehabilitation.
No problem, no problem. Think of it as a way to flex our muscles and bones. Let's go.

Third Senior Brother, even if you want to guide me in my martial arts, wouldn't it be a bit too conspicuous to do so in broad daylight at the training ground? After all, you know that disciples from outside the clan are not allowed to receive the true teachings.
No, it's precisely because of the current situation that we must do this. Let's go.
Isn't this not the time for such things!
...Disciple, we haven't sparred in a while. Want to go to the training hall and exchange some moves?
Two years ago? Were you pulling my leg back then?
Disciple, that was two years ago. Are you confusing your years?
Deputy Headmaster? Third Senior Brother, you... you became the Headmaster? I remember you said yesterday that you didn't want to be the Headmaster‑‑whoa.
You go out first
Seen the proxy headmaster!
Please remain calm, Senior Brother. You are seriously injured, and if you get too excited, your wounds might reopen.
What! You, what did you say?
Senior brother, what are you talking about? The eldest senior has already passed away.
Yes, marrying Senior Brother is the best she could hope for.
You should let go, after all, it's just your one‑sided wish. Shouldn't you be happy for Little Junior Sister if she marries well?

Right, I must have dozed off. Vaguely remembering, my Little Junior Sister has already been married... Indeed, she's been married for quite some time. That day at the Righteous Heart Hall, the Master said he was arranging a marriage between her and the Eldest Senior Brother, almost as if it were yesterday.
‑Ah
Senior Brother, you forgot? The Little Junior Sister has already gotten married.
Hasten, go and fetch Dr. Li. Say that Senior Brother has gone mad.
No no, it's better not to go find a doctor or the master. Instead, if any kind person could persuade Little Junior Sister to come and check on me, I'd be fine right away.
Brother  seems a bit odd. Hurry and get Dr. Li back.
Outsider disciples......what are they?
Hey? Really? I'm just a humble outsider disciple, and I get dizzy almost every other day. I've never dared to trouble the_master before.
Ah, I'll go report to the Acting Sect Leader first. He'll surely be very pleased to hear that you've awakened.
Are you serious? Stop joking around, senior brother.
Is this true or false?... Speaking of it, who are these senior brothers? I don't seem to have met any of you before.
Senior brother, you've finally woken up. You slept for three days and nights.
Now it's settled; there's no room for negotiation.
Ah... Dr. Li, regarding the consultation fee...
Fine then, cheap stuff. By the way, since the person hasn't died, I'm heading down the mountain now. The consultation fee is settled in full, no room for negotiation.
...It is me
There's a basin of water here. Have a look in it. Do you recognize the ugly person reflected there?
Fourth Senior Brother?
Disciple, you've finally woken up!
Where am I? Who am I?
Rest in peace, Your Highness. I will watch over your dreams. May you find relief from the troubles of this world, may you have sweet dreams. Goodnight, Zhao Jun.
This time, your journey ends here. If there is reincarnation, may this palace bear witness to how far you can travel in your next life.
The journey has been tough. You've worked hard.
Sleep now, and do not wake until I am done with you. I shall be your guardian in dreams. May you transcend the sorrows of this world, may you have sweet dreams. Goodnight, Prince Zhao.
This time, your journey ends here. If there is reincarnation, may this palace bear witness to how far you can travel in your next life.
I wait for you to come
This time, we have no chance to hold hands, but fortunately, I am in good patience. Even if the path is filled with thorns, you will still move forward bravely, won't you?

Then return and witness the conclusion of the story. Struggle if you must. Even though life is like a dream, all that has passed is merely a page in a book. But you still have unfinished business, do you not?
Then let's return and witness the conclusion of the story. Struggle all you want; even if the path is strewn with thorns, you will march forward, won't you?
No matter what, I must return
I might as well give up then
This journey ahead will be fraught with hardship, more than just obstacles. Do you still wish to proceed?
I have unfinished business in the mortal world.
Sure, let's go
If you wish, I could be a fairy, guiding you to escape the troubles of the mortal world. Away from this commotion, neither sad nor happy, without love or worry. What do you think?
...Who are you?
Too bad; this time they couldn't survive this ordeal either.
You fell asleep again and soon drifted off into a dream.
I really am getting soft. At my age, I should not be crying so much. Well, when dreaming, I seem to lack any strength at all.
Awakening, I am not in my disciple's room; the night air is cold and nobody pays me any mind.
Ah... it's already dark after blinking! What hour of the night is it?
How, how about this trivial temptation‑just like me, you could also achieve it with effort! I'll be going now; you should get some early rest!
Heavens above......jomg!
Xiao Zhu tiptoes and gently pecks you on the cheek.
...Hmm!
One day or another, we might as well do it that way.
...O Zhao, it would be best if you could spend your life with me. Let's open a blacksmith shop and a woodworking shop together; we shouldn't fight anymore.
I haven't planned to die yet, so could you hold off on making my arrangements just yet?
Sure, if it's okay, I also want your child. I promise to raise them well.
But I just hope you can give me a place to stay. Behind you, I won't be homeless. I want to have a proper name and be your wife.
Hello...
...would also have the resolve to remain widowed.
No, but if that's what you want to do, I'll support you despite my reservations... .
Uh...

Everyone has a father and a mother. Living to this age and practicing martial arts so diligently‑haven't that been quite difficult? For the sake of fame and just one breath of pride, people die so easily; sometimes many die together, following one after another in their deaths. To me, it seems like a very strange and crazy thing.

The events that took place at the Wulin Conference weigh heavily on my mind. In truth, I have never understood what is so good about Jianghu; I only find it frightening and struggle to comprehend your thoughts.
Oh... turns out it's me being pressured into marriage by a beautiful woman. You never know what the world has in store.
Well, to be honest, I can't wait any longer.
Are they impatient already?
Zhao Huo, when will you marry me?
Oh dear, I spoke out of turn; my lady should not be angry.
Is that called good fortune then? Hmm, hmm.
Do you see any signs of good fortune in my facial features?

I need to practice a bit more and get used to it slowly. Otherwise, my heart feels like it's going to explode, and my legs are weakening. You don't feel the slightest bit nervous at all? Don't you hold many little misses often, so you're very skilled at it?
It's limited‑time only, right?
Well, the reward time is over
I can't feel at ease if the one who's eating doesn't hold the food in their hand.
He was still carrying a hammer
Though I am dressed like this, I came after bathing and changing clothes.
It's so fragrant
How does it feel...? Too hard?
Sure, I agree, I won't tear you apart.
Can you forgive me? I don't want to take advantage of you; I'm just afraid you might tear me apart.
Sure, I have allowed it
Can you understand? I don't want to offend you.
Well, you... do you want to try hugging me? I mean, we are technically husband and wife... right? If you're too cautious with me, it might make me feel uneasy.
So easily satisfied? I am more greedy than you.
You are already good enough by my side.
I'm not used to this kind of thing either. I didn't say no, you just need to be a bit more proactive.
So you don't give me a sweetener to comfort me at all?
...I apologize, Zhao Huo. Even though I am the First Palm Sect Lady, I can't do anything to help, and I feel utterly useless.
Not in a hurry, I'm not hungry yet.
I'll warm the dishes with the food I prepared; it should still be a bit warm. I'll serve your rice for you!
I feared you might wake up hungry, so I brought you food. Hearing you call for me in your sleep, I stayed.
So about an hour would be three hours.

Have you been here for a while?
...Thank you for your hard work
Had a nightmare
...Fool, what doesn't count? This has nothing to do with whether you are brave or not; it's evidence of your sense of responsibility.
It's fine, just had a bad dream. Luckily, this counts as seeing a joke. That's alright.
Ah, sorry, I must have spoken too loudly and disturbed you... It's three in the morning now.... What's wrong with you?
Ah... it's already dark after blinking! What hour of the night is it?
Overdone! This is my room!
Go lie on the desk and sleep there; don't occupy the bed.
Yes
Now you can finally sleep soundly
Good... Let's make a deal.

If you can't walk anymore, just put down the burden on your shoulders and we'll go into hiding, retiring to the Jianghu? I will wait for you, waiting until you have exhausted your youth and given up hope. Then it should be your turn to spend the rest of your life with me. I have many places I want to go, but can't go myself; you have to take me there.

Brother, you've been very good. If it wasn't for you, maybe none of us would have made it down the mountain. Even though I've teased you a lot, I secretly admire you, and I bet everyone feels the same way.
Spare me, please
I see you have no intention of reflecting. Come sit by the bed; I have a lecture for you.
I wouldn't dare
Oh, you're not satisfied even with a beautiful woman throwing herself at you? You've gotten too cocky, haven't you!
Is my reward just to take hits?
I am not unsympathetic; I do give you rewards occasionally. For example, like this.

It can't be done that way. Reaching the pinnacle of life effortlessly would make the journey along the way seem cheap, wouldn't it? The harder the peak, the more worthy it is to challenge. With effort and struggle comes greater accomplishment and satisfaction.
Can we not do this? My life is already hard enough.
We each have our roles: you handle shouldering the burden and protecting your family and friends, while I specialize in causing you trouble.
My little ancestor

You don't need to thank heaven and earth, for they cannot stop me. Shang'er, I will deliberately torment you for all eternity, ensuring that you feel both love and hatred towards me. Held in the palm, you fear it might melt away; yet when you grasp tightly, it slips away. Even at eighty years old, you still have to please me.
You do not deceive me, and Brother Zhao will thank heaven and earth for it; who dares to deceive you.

My brother left me in your hands and didn't think you might change your mind. What am I supposed to do if you betray me? I don't have a maternal family to rely on, and you won't let me hang myself out to dry.
Oh no, we've been discovered
...Could it be that they are feeling lonely?
Brother, you shouldn't worry about me. You've already had enough trouble. Everyone knows that I feel a bit sorry for you.
Stop slacking off~ as soon as you get to the inn, you just sleep the whole time. All you do is talk big.
Actually, I was also worried, but with senior disciples relying on me, I couldn't find a way to extricate myself.
He is like this, there's no help for it.
Too cautious, don't you think?
They said they want to secretly return to Fengyu Mountain to observe the developments following the Wulin Conference. They are worried that after we leave, there may be others with ulterior motives.
Where's your brother? Why aren't you watching over her?
Well, there's nothing you can do. You've just been messing around. You'd better show some respect to your younger sister. Otherwise, I'll make you eat your words!
It's so bad that I even admit defeat to you!
Who made me look so good, after all, being cute means you can do whatever you want. Haven't you figured that out yet? Accept your fate~ Your savings are there for me to spend!
That's excessive! Truly unscrupulous! Isn't this blackmail?

Clearly, you were the one who called me when you were asleep. Originally, I planned to take advantage of your sleep and pour tea on your pants, so that when you woke up, you'd think you had wet the bed. A few days later, I was going to use this secret to blackmail you into buying me something.
What are you yelling about? Keep yelling, will you? Can't we sleep at all? Stinky brother!
You're right...
Well... I didn't know. Since it's dark anyway, we might as well just sleep.
Ah... it's already dark after blinking! What hour of the night is it?
Isn't it too cute?
I ate half of it and fell asleep holding the food.
Why is it half a melon?
I have half a steamed bun, here you are.
It was late at night, and I didn't know if the innkeeper had already slept. I should get something to eat to keep my strength up before going to bed.
This should be something I should say
I really feel that heaven is treating me well.
Otherwise, running a barbecue fish shop could work too. You could still use the public resources for personal gain, eating your fill from morning till night.
Is it really that good?
How about the paper shop? I'll make the paper, and you can use public resources for personal gain, folding paper until your hands ache.
Open the shop
Of course
It seems I have to keep a close eye on you and ensure you don't do anything amiss.
You don't have to be so bad
But I am a bad guy, after all.
